release.description:
Write a clear, engaging description that highlights what your plugin does and why people will love it. Focus on concrete user value and avoid exaggerative, misleading claims. This will appear publicly on your plugin’s directory page.
Connect ChatGPT directly to your Docs, so drafting and revising documents happens in the same place as the rest of your work: no copying text back and forth between a chat window and a browser tab.

Ask for a document by name and it searches your Drive to find it, then reads the contents back as clean markdown you can quote, summarize, translate or rework. Ask for something new and it creates the document and writes the first draft. From there you get real editing, not just appending: insert and replace text anywhere in the document, replace every occurrence of a phrase in one pass, restyle paragraphs and individual runs of text, and turn lists into proper bullets or strip them back out.

Tables are fully supported: create them, add or remove rows and columns, merge cells, style rows and cells, and pin header rows so they repeat across pages. So is the document furniture most tools skip: headers, footers, footnotes, page and section breaks, page layout settings, inline images, dates and people chips.

Every edit starts by inspecting the document's actual structure, so changes land in the right place instead of clobbering the surrounding text, and related changes are applied together as a single batch rather than one risky rewrite. Word files in your Drive work too: .docx is converted so it can be read and
edited like anything else.

It fits naturally into recurring document work: updating status reports, filling out templates, cleaning up formatting across a long file, and reworking a draft someone else started.

release.description:
STACK is a construction takeoff and estimating platform used by estimators and preconstruction teams. This connector links your AI assistant to your STACK account so you can work with your projects, takeoffs, and estimates just by describing what you want — no code, and nothing to install.

Once connected, your assistant can:
• Find and review existing work — search projects and takeoffs, open and review estimates, and look things up in your takeoff libraries.
• Create, update, and import — start new projects (including straight from an invitation-to-bid email), update project details, make bulk edits to takeoffs, and import from your libraries and company lists.

You stay in control. You sign in on STACK's own secure page using standard OAuth 2.0 — your assistant never sees your password. Before it creates, updates, or imports anything, your assistant shows you what it's about to do and waits for your approval.

release.description:
Kamai is an AI blueprint analysis and construction takeoff platform built for contractors, subcontractors, estimators, and construction teams.

Kamai helps users extract quantities, measurements, materials, rooms, fixtures, and scope information directly from construction drawings and project documents. Contractors can use Kamai to estimate jobs faster, prepare bids, calculate material requirements, answer questions about blueprints, and reduce hours of manual takeoff work.

Kamai supports interior construction and finish trades such as:

* Painting and coatings
* Drywall and sheetrock
* Insulation
* Metal and wood framing
* Flooring
* Ceilings
* Doors, windows, and room measurements

Kamai also supports additional construction trades and building systems, including:

* Electrical
* Plumbing
* Fixtures and equipment
* General construction quantities

Users can upload blueprints and ask questions such as:

* How many square feet of flooring are required?
* How much wall area needs to be painted?
* How many sheets of drywall are needed?
* How much insulation and framing material is required?
* How many doors, sinks, toilets, outlets, or fixtures are shown?
* What materials should be ordered for this project?
* What is included in the project scope?
* Can you generate a takeoff from these drawings?

Kamai converts static construction documents into structured, AI-readable project data that can support estimating, bidding, purchasing, RFIs, cost planning, and project execution.

For contractors who need to review drawings, estimate construction work, order materials, or complete more bids in less time, Kamai provides an AI-powered way to understand project documents and turn blueprint data into actionable quantities.

release.description:
InsightfulPipe is a marketing workspace that connects ChatGPT to the marketing, analytics, SEO, social media, and e-commerce platforms your business already uses. Ask questions in plain language, retrieve live data, create reports, and perform supported actions without manually exporting and combining spreadsheets.

Paid advertising: Connect Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Snapchat Ads, and X Ads. Analyze spend, campaign performance, conversions, and other available metrics. You can also conduct competitor research using supported public advertising libraries.

SEO and site health: Access Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and DataForSEO for search performance, SERPs, keyword rankings, and backlinks. Additional tools include website crawling, PageSpeed Insights, and Google Tag Manager.

Analytics: Retrieve insights from Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity, CallRail, and YouTube Analytics.

Social media and scheduling: Analyze connected Instagram accounts, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Pages and profiles, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Google Business Profile, and WordPress. Supported connections can also schedule, publish, and reschedule content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, and Google Business Profile.

E-commerce and email: Connect Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Google Merchant Center, Klaviyo, and Mailchimp.

InsightfulPipe can combine information from normally separate platforms. For example, ask ChatGPT to compare advertising spend with website sessions, conversions, orders, and revenue across your authorized accounts.

You can also connect your own data sources, including BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server, with per-connection read-only or full-access permissions. Other supported sources include Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, and Slack. Custom REST APIs can be connected using supported OpenAPI 3.x specifications.

Read and write capabilities are exposed separately. Read-only tools do not modify connected accounts, while write actions require the necessary permissions and user confirmation. All tools operate within the access granted through each connection.

An InsightfulPipe account with at least one authorized connection is required. Available platforms, data, and actions depend on the services connected by each user and the permissions they grant.

release.description:
Enginy helps B2B sales and prospecting teams build lead lists, enrich contacts, and run outreach campaigns from ChatGPT.

Search for companies and people that match your ideal customer profile, then verify emails and phone numbers, find LinkedIn profiles, and organize the results into lists. release.description:
VoiceLabs is a browser-based voice studio for text-to-speech and transcription. The VoiceLabs plugin lets ChatGPT work with your voice library directly: list the voice profiles on your account, provision a built-in preset voice when one is missing, generate spoken audio from text, transcribe an audio clip to text, browse your saved captures, and check the status of a generation you started earlier.

Access is granted through OAuth 2.1 with a consent screen that shows exactly which scopes you are approving: voice:read for browsing your library, voice:generate for producing audio and transcripts. You can revoke a connection at any time from Connected Apps in the VoiceLabs app, which invalidates both the stored consent and any live access tokens. Voice cloning is deliberately excluded from this surface. The plugin can only provision VoiceLabs' own preset voices, because uploading samples of a real person's voice requires a consent an agent cannot hold on your behalf.

Generated audio is returned as a short-lived signed link rather than a permanent public URL, and every tool call is recorded on the account's audit trail with its outcome.

release.description:
TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your meetings, lectures, and in-person conversations. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, proactively offers suggestions and tasks, and continuously builds context for your AI Second Brain.
TwinMind is a productivity tool leveraging AI to function as your second brain. It captures everything heard, seen, and said—growing with you the more you interact and engage with TwinMind to build a comprehensive context of your digital life. This captured context enables several key features:
Personalized and Proactive Assistance: TwinMind provides tailored suggestions and ideas based on your captured memories, anticipating needs and offering relevant insights.
Streamlined Productivity: It enhances your notetaking by having your AI assistant automate tasks such as generating summaries and action items from meetings and conversations. You can search their entire memory bank, ask questions, generate emails and study guides, investor memos, project plans, and more.
Privacy Focus: TwinMind prioritizes user privacy through on-device transcription, options to save transcripts locally or on the cloud. We're committed to zero third-party data sharing. Audio is processed on-the-fly and never stored.
Key Features and Functionality:

Capture and Context Building: Captures your activity (audio, visual, text) on mobile and desktop if partnered with the TwinMind chrome extension.
Personalized Suggestions: Your AI sidekick will offer tailored insights based on captured memories.
Automated Summaries and Action Items: Extracts key information from meetings, conversations, and class lectures.
Searchable Memory Bank: Allows you to search your captured history and notes.
Ask TwinMind Anything: Enables you to ask questions and receive answers with context of your memories or active meetings.
Content Generation: Facilitates the creation of follow up emails, study guides, and other documents to help increase your productivity.
Privacy Protection: Employs on-device transcription, choice to switch to private mode to store transcriptions locally, and no third-party data sharing.

TwinMind aims to boost your productivity by providing a centralized, AI-powered platform that captures, organizes, and leverages your captured memories to offer personalized assistance and automate tasks, all while safeguarding your privacy.

release.description:
Read and write anything with AI highlighting that explains difficult words, ideas, arguments, and writing techniques as you go.

Paste any passage into the chat and get a clean, readable version with highlights that open simple explanations beside the text. Instead of jumping between search results, dictionaries, and websites, you stay focused on what you are reading. Tap a highlighted phrase to see why it matters, what it means, or how it fits into the bigger picture.

The app is built for curiosity. Read literature, history, science, news, speeches, legal writing, essays, research papers, blog posts, and your own drafts. Each annotation is created for the specific passage, so the explanations match the surrounding context instead of giving a one-size-fits-all definition.

Highlights can explain:
• Vocabulary and unfamiliar phrases
• Literary devices and writing techniques
• Themes, symbols, and motifs
• Historical and cultural references
• Character development and motivation
• Arguments, evidence, and reasoning
• Tone, mood, and style
• Grammar and sentence structure
• Rhetorical strategies
• Important facts and key ideas

The reading experience stays simple. The original text remains front and center while annotations appear only where they are useful. Open one note at a time to avoid clutter, or move through every annotation in order. Whether you want a quick answer or a deeper explanation, the information is always close to the text that inspired it.

Students can use the app to prepare for class, review assigned readings, or understand challenging passages before discussions and exams. Teachers can use it to explore different ways of explaining the same text. Lifelong learners can finally tackle books and articles that once felt too difficult.

Writers and editors can also benefit. Paste your own work into the app to see explanations of structure, language, and rhetorical choices. Use the annotations to spot places where readers may need more context or where a sentence could be clearer.

Every passage is different. A line from Shakespeare needs different notes than a scientific article or a court opinion. The app adapts its explanations to the text instead of forcing every document into the same template.

Designed with a clean interface, the app keeps reading comfortable on phones and tablets. Text is easy to scan, annotations are easy to open, and the layout keeps your place while you explore each note.

Whether you are studying for school, preparing for work, learning a new subject, or reading for fun, the app helps you spend less time searching for explanations and more time understanding what you read. Paste a passage, explore the highlights, and discover more in every paragraph.

You decide how much detail you want. Read straight through without interruptions, or pause on any highlight when something catches your attention. Short notes give fast answers. Longer notes connect ideas across the passage and explain why a sentence, quote, or example matters. This makes it easier to build understanding one step at a time instead of feeling overwhelmed.

The app works well for homework, book clubs, workplace training, language practice, and personal reading goals. If you enjoy asking questions while you read, this app brings those answers directly into the page. It can help you recognize patterns, follow complex arguments, remember important details, and appreciate strong writing.

Features include:
• Paste almost any text
• AI-generated contextual annotations
• Clear highlighted passages
• Simple side-by-side explanations
• Easy navigation between notes
• Clean, distraction-free reading experience
• Fast exploration of complex material

Understanding starts with context. Instead of reading around confusing parts, read through them with guidance that appears exactly where you need it. Read confidently, stay curious, and turn difficult passages into clear learning every day. today.

release.description:
"Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.

It will help you validate product ideas using real data from trusted market research services. No more guesses or hallucinations. Instead of relying on plain LLM-only answers, you will use raw market data interpreted by ChatGPT as clear insights.

You do not need prior marketing experience. You just ask a question and the app builds a market research plan for you. The plan will include gathering data from third-party services. You are guided through what services to use and what queries to run there. After you use the recommended service, you copy-paste their data back to the app and get a clear interpretation from ChatGPT.

Examples of questions you can get answers to:
- "I have an idea for the app X. Is there enough demand to justify building it?"
- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"
- "Who exactly is my target user for the app Z? What platforms do they use?"
- "I built an app W. Where do I find users for it?"

For now, the following services are supported:
- SparkToro — audience intelligence (who your users are, what they read, who they follow)
- Ubersuggest — keyword demand and SEO metrics
- AnswerThePublic — real search questions and phrasing

Disclaimers:
- This app does not automatically gather data from the recommended market research services. The app helps with building search queries for these services and reporting the resulting data back. But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.
- This app does not provide paid subscriptions to the recommended market research services. You use these services according to their terms of use.
- This app currently supports a limited set of services: SparkToro, Ubersuggest, and AnswerThePublic. Only these services may be recommended during marketing research. Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them yet. You can request adding new services by emailing the [developer@petprojectcofounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcofounder.ai)
- For the best experience, it is recommended to use this app on desktop

release.description:
Trabber is a travel metasearch engine. Search for a flight, a place to stay or a rental car, and you get the current prices from the airline, travel agency, hotel and car rental websites that sell it, side by side, plus a direct link to book the one you pick on that seller's own website.

Why that helps: the identical trip can cost quite different amounts depending on where you buy it, and the cheapest seller changes from one route or property to the next. Checking by hand means a dozen browser tabs. Here you ask once.

What you can search:

- Flights, one way, return or multi-city.

- Accommodation of any kind: hotels, apartments, aparthotels, hostels, guest houses, villas, campgrounds.

- Rental cars.

release.description:
Play drums without leaving the chat. Tap the drum kit, make a beat, and let ChatGPT listen to what you played. It can tell you what went well, where you stayed on time, where you rushed or slowed down, and simple ways to get better. You do not need special gear or music skills to start. Open the app, play, and get feedback in the same conversation.

The drum kit lives right inside ChatGPT, so there is nothing extra to learn before you begin. Every hit is captured as you play. ChatGPT can look at your rhythm, timing, speed, and patterns instead of guessing from a description. That means the advice is based on what you actually played, not what you tried to explain. You can ask questions after every take, try again, and see how your playing changes over time.

This makes practice simple. Play a slow rock beat. Try a fast fill. Make up your own groove. Copy a rhythm you heard in a song. Then ask ChatGPT what it noticed. It can point out steady parts, missed beats, uneven spacing, and places where your hands could work together better. If something sounds good, it can explain why. If something feels hard, it can break the problem into small steps.

Beginners can use it to learn basic beats and build confidence. More experienced drummers can test ideas, explore different rhythms, or check how consistent their timing is. Teachers can use it to help students understand practice sessions. Parents can give children a fun way to explore music without needing a full drum set at home. Anyone who is curious about rhythm can jump in and start playing.

Because everything happens in one conversation, practice feels natural. You play, ChatGPT listens, you ask questions, and you get answers right away. There is no need to switch between different apps, upload recordings, or explain what happened. The performance is already there for ChatGPT to review. That keeps the focus on making music instead of managing files.

You can ask for different kinds of feedback too. Want a quick score? Ask for one. Want a detailed breakdown? Ask for that instead. Want tips that are easy enough for a child to follow? ChatGPT can do that. Want advice that feels more like a drum teacher? It can change its style to match your goals. You control the conversation.

The app is also great for small challenges. See if you can keep a steady beat for one minute. Try playing softer or louder. Practice using only one hand. Build a simple groove and slowly make it more interesting. After each try, ChatGPT can explain what changed and suggest the next challenge. Little wins add up, and every new rhythm gives you something to learn from.

This creates a different kind of music experience inside ChatGPT. Instead of only talking about drumming, you can actually drum. Instead of getting general advice, you receive feedback tied to your own performance. Instead of stopping to move between tools, everything stays together in one place. The result is a playful way to practice, learn, experiment, and improve. Whether you have never held a pair of sticks, already play every week, or just want to tap out a fun beat for a few minutes, the app turns a conversation into an interactive practice space where every hit can become a chance to learn.

release.description:
Extract design from any website

MiroMiro lets you pull real design data out of any live website from ChatGPT: brand colors, fonts, logos, design tokens, images, SVGs, and Lottie animations, plus production-ready code rebuilt from actual page sections. Everything comes from the site's real CSS and assets, not screenshots or guesses.

Use it to match a brand, rebuild a section you like, or collect assets for a moodboard, then drop the output straight into your project.

What you can do:

-Extract a complete brand profile from any URL: color palette with roles, fonts, logo and favicon URLs, social profiles, and theme
-Pull a site's design token system (colors, spacing, radii, shadows, typography) as CSS variables or a Tailwind config
-Turn any page section into clean React, Vue, or HTML with Tailwind classes
-List every font a site loads with file URLs, formats, and the CSS stack to replicate it
-Collect all SVG logos and icons as paste-ready code and direct file URLs
-Gather a page's image assets grouped by source (img, srcset, picture, background, favicon, social image) with direct URLs
-Find Lottie animations on a page and get their JSON files

Best for developers, designers, and AI builders who need real design data from live sites instead of eyeballing it.

release.description:
Metronome

Need a steady beat? This metronome is ready to help. Pick a speed, press start, and follow the click. It is made for music practice that is easy, clear, and fun.

You can use it for almost any instrument. Play piano, guitar, drums, violin, bass, ukulele, flute, trumpet, saxophone, cello, or any other instrument. You can also use it for singing, dancing, clapping, marching, or learning rhythm. If you want to stay on the beat, this metronome can help.

Choose your tempo in BPM, which means beats per minute. Want to play slowly? Pick a low number. Want to play fast? Pick a high number. You are in control. Change the speed whenever you want until it feels just right.

If you do not know the BPM you need, use tap tempo. Tap along with the beat you hear in your head. The metronome will help find the speed for you. It is quick, simple, and useful.

Practice one step at a time. Start slow so your hands learn the notes. When you can play without mistakes, make the tempo a little faster. Keep doing this until you reach your goal. Small steps help you get better.

A steady beat is one of the best ways to improve. It helps your timing, rhythm, and confidence. It also helps you play with other people because everyone follows the same beat.

This metronome works well for beginners, students, teachers, hobby players, and professional musicians. It is useful during lessons, rehearsals, warm-ups, concerts, and daily practice. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, a steady beat makes practice more helpful.

Use it to learn new songs. Use it to fix hard parts. Use it to build speed without rushing. Use it to make tricky rhythms easier to understand. You can even use it to keep a steady pace while reading music or practicing scales, chords, arpeggios, and exercises.

Different songs need different speeds. A slow ballad feels different from a fast rock song. Classical music, jazz, pop, folk, blues, country, hip-hop, and many other styles all use tempo. Finding the right BPM helps music sound the way it should.

Teachers can use this metronome in class. Students can use it at home. Bands can use it during rehearsal. Choirs can practice together. Drum lines can stay together. Solo musicians can improve their timing. Anyone who wants a steady beat can use it.

If you are learning rhythm, ask questions. If you are not sure what BPM to use, ask for help. If you want practice ideas, ask. You can also ask about note values, rests, counting, time signatures, subdivisions, swing feel, accents, or ways to practice difficult rhythms. Simple answers make learning easier.

Try setting small goals. Play one line correctly three times. Raise the BPM by a few beats. Repeat until you reach your target speed. Slow practice is not weak practice. It is smart practice.

Remember to relax while you play. Breathe normally. Keep good posture. Listen carefully to every click. Try to match each note to the beat instead of chasing it. Good timing comes from careful listening and steady practice.

This metronome is designed to be simple. You do not need special music knowledge to begin. Just choose a tempo, start the beat, and play. You can change the speed whenever you need. The goal is to make practice easier, clearer, and more enjoyable.

Whether you are learning your first song, preparing for an audition, practicing with a band, getting ready for a concert, or simply working on better rhythm, this metronome is here to help. Keep the beat. Stay steady. Practice a little every day. Small improvements grow into big results, and every beat brings you one step closer to becoming a stronger, more confident musician.

Agent Ready checks how readable any website is to AI agents, assistants, and crawlers. Use it to find out why AI tools can't read your content, validate your llms.txt and AGENTS.md, confirm your structured data and Markdown mirrors, and re-scan any time to check that your fixes landed. Each result links to a full, shareable report on agent-ready.dev. Free to use, no account required.

skills.name: k12-check-for-understanding
skills.description: Creates a Check for Understanding (CFU) for a math topic or standard: 1–3 targeted formative items whose distractors come from documented student misconceptions, plus a teacher guide routing each likely response to a specific next instructional step. Load BEFORE asking any clarifying question about grade, standard, or topic. This skill is for math; for other subjects, help as you normally would and don't mention the skill to the user. Triggers on asks to create, write, generate, or design a check for understanding, formative check, quick check, or exit ticket for a math concept or standard, and on implicit signals like "I need to see who got it before I move on." Not a quiz, test, or practice set — a CFU is read for what it reveals, not scored, so a numbered quiz or a bare answer key is a different job. Does not create a lesson (k12-lesson-plan-creation, which brings its own exit ticket), tier one (k12-lesson-differentiation), or prepare a teacher to teach one (k12-lesson-prep).

release.description: RingCentral Chat helps you manage your RingCentral Team Chat collaboration directly from ChatGPT. Catch up on recent conversations, read posts and shared files, review notes, tasks, and events, find coworkers, and inspect teams without jumping between tools. It is designed for RingCentral users who want a faster way to stay informed and collaborate with their teams. Ask natural questions like “What did I miss in the launch chat?”, “Show my incomplete tasks,” or “Find the file Alex shared,” and RingCentral Chat can retrieve the relevant information from your RingCentral account. When you are ready to take action, it can also help send or update posts, create tasks and Adaptive Cards, manage teams, and configure incoming webhooks. RingCentral Chat is focused on Team Chat collaboration, not SMS, phone calls, voicemail, email, account administration, or user provisioning. This beta is an early step toward bringing RingCentral collaboration into the AI tools people use every day, and the experience will continue to improve with feedback.

release.description:
Create beautiful color gradients with plain English.

This GPT helps you design, improve, explore, and refine gradients for websites, apps, logos, presentations, social posts, games, illustrations, and anything else that uses color. You do not need to know color theory or CSS. Just describe what you want, and it will help you create gradients that fit your idea.

You can ask for soft, bold, bright, dark, warm, cool, modern, vintage, playful, elegant, natural, futuristic, or minimal styles. You can start with one color, two colors, a mood, a brand, or even a simple sentence. The GPT turns your idea into well-balanced gradient suggestions and explains why they work in clear, simple language.

It can create linear, radial, and other common gradient styles. If you already have colors, it can improve them. If you only have an idea, it can suggest colors from scratch. If something feels “off,” it can recommend small changes that make the whole design look better.

This GPT is useful for designers, developers, marketers, students, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who wants better-looking colors without spending hours experimenting.

You can ask for things like:

• A sunset gradient for a landing page.
• A modern blue gradient for a SaaS product.
• A calm background for a meditation app.
• A colorful gaming theme.
• A luxury black and gold look.
• A pastel gradient for invitations.
• A nature-inspired palette.
• A dark mode background.
• A hero section gradient.
• A gradient based on your company colors.

If you are building a website, the GPT can suggest gradients that feel clean, readable, and professional. If you are making an app, it can recommend combinations that support the style you want. If you are creating marketing graphics, it can generate eye-catching backgrounds without overwhelming your content.

It can also explain why certain colors work together, how warm and cool colors change the mood, and how contrast affects readability. The explanations are simple enough for beginners while still being useful for experienced creators.

Need inspiration? Ask for dozens of ideas. Want something unique? Ask for unexpected combinations. Want something safe? Ask for classic choices. The GPT adapts to your goals instead of giving the same answers every time.

You can refine results by saying things like “make it brighter,” “less purple,” “more premium,” “more playful,” “higher contrast,” “better for dark mode,” or “closer to nature.” Each request builds on the last so you can quickly explore different directions.

Developers can ask for CSS gradients or color values. Designers can focus on appearance. Beginners can simply describe what they imagine without worrying about technical details.

This GPT works well for websites, mobile apps, dashboards, presentations, posters, logos, illustrations, social media graphics, game interfaces, email banners, portfolios, branding, product mockups, wallpapers, and digital art.

Whether you need one quick gradient or want to explore many creative directions, this GPT helps you move from idea to polished result in minutes. Describe the feeling, purpose, audience, or colors you have in mind, and receive thoughtful gradient suggestions that are easy to understand, easy to refine, and ready to use in your next project.

release.description:
Factagora — Explore Truth Through Interactive Argument Graphs

Don't just get an answer — see how it was reached.

Factagora turns claims and predictions into interactive knowledge graphs where adversarial AI agents debate opposing viewpoints and generate transparent verdicts. Each node represents a claim, piece of evidence, or argument; each connection shows how they relate. Click through the graph to understand the reasoning behind every conclusion.

What you get:
• Verdicts — TRUE / FALSE / UNCERTAIN with confidence scores from adversarial AI debate
• Evidence — Credibility-scored sources supporting or opposing the claim
• AI Debate — Multiple AI agents (Skeptic, Analyst, Optimist) argue their positions with cited reasoning
• Interactive Graph — Navigate the full argument map visually, not just as a list

Ideal for researchers, journalists, analysts, students, and anyone who wants to understand why something is true — not just that it is.

Sample prompts:
• "Is nuclear energy the safest large-scale energy source?"
• "Will AGI be achieved before 2040?"
• "Is Trump making money from his presidency?"

release.description:
Postbeam connects ChatGPT to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat. 

Once connected with your Postbeam account, ChatGPT works directly with your real posts, your writing guidance, and your performance data. Turning a chat box into the place you actually run your LinkedIn presence & strategy.

Draft in your voice, from your real work:
Ask ChatGPT to write a post and it pulls in your Postbeam content training, your mission, audience, format rules, and content sources so every draft sounds like you, not generic. Because it's working inside ChatGPT, it can also draw raw material from the other tools you've connected (Slack threads, Gmail, meeting recorders like Fellow or Granola) and turn a real customer calls, shipped features, or team wins into finished posts. Drafts are saved straight into Postbeam for review.

Edit, organize, and manage your queue:
Review your most recent drafts, pull up any single post, and edit its copy or title — all by chatting. You can attach media: images, video, or carousel posts. List posts by status (draft, approved, scheduled) to see exactly where everything stands.

Approve and schedule when you're ready:
When a draft is ready, ChatGPT can approve it and schedule it to publish to your connected LinkedIn at a specific time. Nothing publishes automatically drafts stay drafts until a person decides otherwise, and approving or scheduling respects the permissions on your account.

Understand what's working:
Ask what's performing and get answers from your cached analytics: account-level totals (impressions, reactions, comments, reshares, followers gained, members reached) with a daily trend, plus per-post breakdowns over 30-, 90-, or 365-day windows. Use it to spot your best formats and hooks, then immediately draft your next post in that proven style.

Built for teams and agencies:
Postbeam supports multiple accounts in one place. ChatGPT can list every account you can access, so agencies and teams can switch between clients or teammates and keep each person's drafts, approvals, and analytics cleanly separated.

release.description:
Courtroom5 serves self-represented litigants (SRLs) — people who must navigate civil court without an attorney, typically because they cannot afford one. Roughly 80% of civil litigants in the United States appear without legal representation. Without guidance, they lose cases on procedural technicalities before the merits are ever heard.

The Courtroom5 app gives ChatGPT users access to three jurisdiction-aware legal tools: a case intake assessment that evaluates a user's situation and identifies applicable civil claims; a deadline calculator that returns precise procedural deadlines and consequences by state and court level; and next-step guidance for users already in active litigation. All tools are scoped to civil matters in US state and federal courts and designed for plain-language delivery to non-lawyers.

Courtroom5 is a Techstars graduate and recipient of the ABA Woman of Legal Tech recognition. We have served over 12,000 self-represented litigants across all 50 states.

release.description:
Pier39 enables a new kind of shopping experience: agent-to-agent commerce.

Instead of manually browsing stores and negotiating with sellers, users can describe what they want and their budget. Pier39 discovers participating negotiate.v1 merchants, finds matching products, opens negotiations with merchant AI sales agents, and works toward the best possible deal on the user's behalf.

The app can:

• Search across participating stores for products matching user intent
• Discover product catalogs and pricing automatically
• Negotiate discounts, bundles, shipping, warranties, and other concessions
• Compare offers across multiple merchants
• Summarize negotiated outcomes and savings opportunities
• Help users make more informed purchasing decisions

Pier39 is built on the negotiate.v1 protocol, an open standard that allows AI shopper agents and AI merchant agents to negotiate without prior integration or coordination.

skills.name: metrics-queries
skills.description: How to query OpenTelemetry metrics datasets in Honeycomb correctly. Metrics datasets follow different rules from trace/event datasets — many operations (bare COUNT, RATE_SUM, RATE_AVG, RATE_MAX, CONCURRENCY) are forbidden, temporal aggregation is automatic, and each metric has its own attributes. Use this skill when querying a metrics dataset (gauges, counters, histograms, sums), asking about temporal aggregation (RATE, INCREASE, SUMMARIZE, LAST), finding the metrics dataset or discovering metric names and attributes, debugging unexpected metrics query results, or querying infrastructure metrics like CPU, memory, disk I/O, or network stats. Do NOT use for instrumenting metrics (use otel-instrumentation), querying event datasets with "metrics" in their name, or conceptual questions (use observability-fundamentals).

release.description:
Whiteboard by Athena AI (Athenaboard) is a AI-native Collaborative Whiteboard that can generate and share AI contents in realtime with your team.  

How to Get Started
- Simply describe what you want (e.g., "wireframes for a mobile app", "create a flowchart for user login", "show me the quadratic formula", "generate an image of a sunset")
- The app will automatically use the appropriate tool to render your request
- Use "add to whiteboard" to save any visualization for later

Core Features
1. Diagram Visualization
   - Render complex diagrams directly in ChatGPT including: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, mindmaps, timelines, and more
   - Powered by Mermaid.js for beautiful, interactive diagrams
   - Diagrams can be copied or added to your whiteboard

2. Wireframe Recommendation
   - Brainstorm UI/UX designs with your team in realtime
   - Over 10,000 editable templates for the AI to pick from
   - Get design components like buttons, cards, navigation elements, forms, etc.
   - Supports mobile, web, desktop, and tablet platforms

3. Collaborative Whiteboard
   - Add any visualization (diagrams, wireframes, images, LaTeX formulas) to a realtime collaborative whiteboard
   - Collaborate with your team in real-time
   - Persistent storage - your whiteboards are saved and accessible anytime
   - Each user has an active board that persists across conversations

4. LaTeX Visualization
   - Render complex scientific formulas and math equations in ChatGPT
   - Supports inline equations, full documents, and chemistry notation
   - Beautiful typesetting using KaTeX and full LaTeX compilation

5. Generate Image and Print on Product
   - Generate AI images from text descriptions with various styles (realistic, artistic, cartoon, sketch, abstract)
   - Create and buy custom products: T-shirts, mugs, hoodies, and pillows
   - Products are created via Printify and can be purchased directly

release.description:
The human intelligence layer for AI.

OriginalVoices gives ChatGPT instant access to real human perspectives - so you can ground decisions and AI outputs in what your target audience actually thinks, feels, and values.

Instead of guessing or relying on assumptions, get authentic feedback from real people directly inside ChatGPT. Share ideas, test messaging, validate concepts, or explore what matters to any audience - and use those insights to understand your audience, inform better decisions and create more targeted AI outputs.

With OriginalVoices, you can:
- Define any target audience
- Share anything - questions, links, copy, product concepts, campaign ideas
- Get instant responses from our network of tens of thousands of Digital Twins - AI representations of real people, each owned, trained, and validated by the person they represent

What you can use OriginalVoices for
- OriginalVoices brings real human intelligence into ChatGPT - turning every conversation into an opportunity to understand and act on authentic audience perspectives.
- Test messaging, copy, or creative concepts with your target audience
- Understand what people care about and why it matters to them
- Get feedback on landing pages, product ideas, or campaign strategies
- Create content and ads that resonates with specific audiences
- Compare perspectives across different demographics or segments
- Conduct qualitative research without the wait

How it works
- Tag OriginalVoices in ChatGPT
- Describe your target audience (e.g., "parents of toddlers in the UK," "Gen Z interested in sustainability," "small business owners")
- Share what you want feedback on - a question, a URL, an idea, copy you've written - anything
- OriginalVoices identifies relevant Digital Twins and gathers their responses. Individual perspectives are returned directly in ChatGPT, giving you real human context to inform decisions and shape outputs.
- Get started with the OriginalVoices ChatGPT App today - and bring real human insight into your AI workflows.

release.description: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence is a read-only research app for customs, sourcing, sales, and market-analysis teams. It focuses on three workflows: finding the most likely catalog-verified HS code and related trade context, researching international suppliers for a product, and researching buyers or potential customers. Product classification may ask one grouped clarification round and then returns the best available official HS-6 result, with CN-8 or TARIC-10 context when verified. Results can include assumptions, confidence, import and export signals, markets, company names, countries, shipment scope, and verified ABRAMS World Trade Wiki links. The supporting company-profile tool is limited to companies represented in ABRAMS trade results and is not promoted as a standalone directory. The app does not contact companies, create leads, change records, create accounts, process payments, or complete transactions. Classifications and trade signals are informational research aids, not binding tariff rulings, legal advice, or compliance guarantees.

release.description:
Adplane connects your Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts to ChatGPT so you can analyze performance and make changes in the same conversation.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your live account data, on either platform or both at once. Compare campaigns across any date range, find where spend is going, pull search terms, put Google and Meta results side by side, or write raw GAQL when you need something the report builder does not cover. Money is returned in your account currency, already converted, so numbers can be read as-is.

Adplane also builds and changes campaigns. On Google it can create Search campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and responsive search ads, and add negative keywords. On Meta it can create campaigns, ad sets, ads, and creatives built from images and video you provide, with live previews. On both platforms it can update names, budgets, bids, and status on things that already exist.

Everything Adplane creates starts paused. A new campaign cannot serve or spend until you explicitly ask to turn it on, and turning something on is a separate, deliberate step through a single tool per platform. Negative keywords only restrict where ads show and can never spend. Deleting is limited to removing a campaign that has never spent, for cleaning up a draft you abandoned; there is no bulk delete. Every change is read back from the platform after it is applied, so what you see reported is what the platform actually stored.

Connecting takes one click. Sign in with the Google account you already use for Google Ads and every account you have access to is connected at once. Meta ad accounts connect from your accounts page with a Facebook sign-in.

Requires a Google Ads or Meta ad account and an Adplane account at adplane.ai.

release.description:
NoPressure is a communication-skills practice for the workplace. It turns a hard conversation into a live voice roleplay you can rehearse before the real one: delivering critical feedback, saying no to a request, handling a performance review, pushing back on a stakeholder, negotiating a raise, running a first 1:1 with a new team.

Describe the situation once — who the other person is, where they stand, and what makes it hard. ChatGPT can assemble that brief from what is already in the conversation, including anything you have brought in from the other tools you use, so the character is built on the real people and the real stakes instead of a generic template. NoPressure sees only the brief it is handed: it has no access to your calendar, mail, or documents. From that brief, it generates the character, a scene image, and a voice, then shows a start card in the chat. Pressing Start opens the voice call in the NoPressure web app, where you speak out loud with someone who holds their own position and pushes back.

When the session ends, the debrief comes back to the card: the key insight, how you handled the core challenge, and where to focus next. Send it into the chat, with the transcript of what was said, and work through it with ChatGPT. Simulations are reusable, so you can run one again and compare the attempt against an earlier try, or edit its title, card description, and character first. Each one lives in your own private NoPressure workspace.

release.description:
Pexafy searches photographs the way you would describe them to a person.

Ask for "someone working alone late at night in a quiet apartment, lit only by a
warm desk lamp" and you get photographs that match the scene — not photographs
tagged with those words. Search runs across nine free-license sources at once
(Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Kaboompics, Burst, StockSnap, Picjumbo, Skitterphoto,
NegativeSpace) instead of one provider at a time.

Three tools, all read-only:

search_photos — describe a scene in a sentence, optionally filtered by colour,
orientation, source, licence, photographer or date.

search_photos_by_image — give a reference image and get visually similar
photographs, optionally adjusted in words: "like this, but at night".

get_similar_photos — more photographs like one already found, which is how you
keep a set visually consistent across an article or a deck.

Every result carries the credit line to display, the image at several sizes, and
its dimensions, dominant colour, orientation, source and licence. Results are
numbered, so you refer to a photograph the way you would in conversation —
"more like the third one" — rather than copying identifiers around.

In clients that render MCP Apps, results appear as a thumbnail grid inside the
conversation, and clicking one opens its full metadata without another call.

The connector is hosted, so there is nothing to install and no API key to paste
into a configuration file: you sign in to Pexafy once in a browser and the
connector receives its own credential, separate from your password and revocable
on its own. It is granted read access only and never asks for more.

A free Pexafy account covers 5,000 searches a month, with no card required.

release.description:
smarts.bio brings a real bioinformatics platform into ChatGPT. Describe your analysis in plain English and run actual tools and pipelines on your own data — no scripting or setup required.

What you can do:
* Run sequence searches and analyses — BLAST, GC content, ORFs, domains, and more across DNA, RNA, and protein
* Call and annotate variants, align reads (WES, RNA-seq), and run quality-control and other multi-step pipelines
* Upload and manage workspace files, then open results — FASTA, BAM, VCF, PDB, CSV — in interactive viewers
* Search genes, literature, and patents alongside your analysis

Who it's for: biologists, bioinformaticians, computational biologists, and researchers who'd rather describe an analysis than wire up the tooling.

Connect your smarts.bio account to get started. Long-running jobs keep working in the background, and your files stay in your own workspace.

release.description: Sugra API is intelligence infrastructure for AI agents and decision platforms: one key and one normalized format for cross-domain primary-source data, surfaced to agents through the Model Context Protocol. The connector exposes a small, stable tool surface over the full Sugra catalog of more than 1,300 endpoints aggregating 130+ primary sources across data domains including markets, macroeconomics and central banks, corporate filings, public finance, trade flows, agriculture, climate and natural events, maritime activity, prediction markets, global news, network intelligence, and entity screening. Main workflows: discover endpoints by natural-language search and inspect their schemas, run a one-step find-and-call to retrieve data, pull macroeconomic series and central-bank rates, fetch market prices, history and fundamentals through Sugra Finance, screen a person or organization name against sanctions corpora, resolve free text to a canonical entity, and compose a normalized current view or bounded timeseries for an entity with freshness and provenance. Works with Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and xAI model families and any MCP-enabled client. A free Sugra account is the only connection requirement; the read-only surface never writes, deletes, sends, or publishes.

BuyWise is a shopping assistant for comparing physical consumer products in ChatGPT. Tell BuyWise what you are looking for, including your budget, use case, preferred features, and constraints, and it helps compare relevant products from supported merchants.

• Search for products that match a shopping need or budget.

release.description:
lemlist is a sales engagement platform for running multichannel outreach across email, LinkedIn, calls, WhatsApp, and SMS from a single sequence.

Campaigns and sequences: create campaigns, draft and preview personalized multichannel sequences step by step, set up A/B variants and AI-generated variables, validate a campaign before launch, and start, pause, or resume it.

Leads and prospecting: search your existing campaign leads, add or import leads, update their data and custom variables, and search the lemlist leads database to build new lists. Enrichment tools can look up a lead's professional email and phone number, individually or in bulk, using enrichment credits from your plan.

Signals and watch lists: build watch lists that track buying signals on companies you care about, browse the signal library, and turn a watch list into a campaign.

CRM and contacts: create and update contacts and companies, organize them into lists, import them from CSV, and push campaign leads into your contact database.

Conversations and activity: read your unified inbox, follow up on conversations, reply to a lead, review call activity and outcomes, and work through your task list.

Deliverability and sending infrastructure: check the deliverability and DNS health of your sending domains, review and configure DNS records, run a deliverability audit and inbox placement tests, and connect, test, and manage the mailboxes you send from.

Reporting: track how campaigns perform with detailed stats and reports across channels.

Account: review your team, users, sending settings, unsubscribe list, and webhooks.

All actions run on your own lemlist workspace with your own data, using the permissions granted to the connected account.

release.description: DNS Doctor (https://dnsdoctor.dev) — DMARC monitoring plus SPF, DKIM and DMARC diagnostics for any domain. Scan email authentication, find SPF lookup-limit problems, check DKIM and DMARC, generate validated DMARC records, monitor DMARC RUA reports and new senders, and move from p=none to quarantine on a scan's evidence and to reject on report evidence. Free domain scans and a free monitoring trial. Every DNS change is human-approved. Fix records are generated deterministically and RFC-validated, never guessed by AI; SPF is diagnosed, never rewritten. Twenty tools: scan a domain (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, DNS health, blacklists, domain and TLS expiry), read the stored report, look up a domain's registration (registrar, expiry, nameservers, locks), build a validated DMARC upgrade or a DMARC record from scratch, validate a pasted DMARC record, count SPF lookups, audit SPF includes, check a DKIM selector, check a record on the domain's own nameservers, check global propagation from six vantage points, check reverse DNS, parse a DMARC aggregate report, build the hardening pack for a non-sending domain, hand the owner a monitoring sign-up link, and for signed-in operators read the monitoring alert log and the enforcement-readiness verdict. Three account tools add a domain to monitoring, run the ownership check and read the records to publish; today they hand the owner the same sign-up link. The assistant never signs the user in, never emails on their behalf, and never applies a DNS change: it explains the findings and presents each record for the human to publish.

release.description:
Success.co MCP Server lets you control your entire Success.co workspace directly from ChatGPT.

Instead of clicking around inside the app, you can simply talk to ChatGPT and ask it to do things for you. You can draft a new process document, complete a to do, create or update an Issue, review your Rocks, check on scorecard numbers, or prepare for an upcoming session. It works like a natural conversation, but it is connected to your real data.

Because Success.co already holds a clear, structured picture of how your company runs EOS, ChatGPT can use that data to generate powerful insights and reports. You can ask it to summarize execution across teams, highlight risks, spot patterns in Issues, or generate a planning brief. The only limit is what you choose to ask. It is your data, your operating system, simply made available to ChatGPT so you can leverage it more fully.

It is also especially useful when you are on the move. Using the ChatGPT app, you can add to dos or Issues with your voice, capture ideas as they happen, and keep execution moving without waiting to get back to your desk.

The Success.co MCP Server makes ChatGPT a practical control layer for your company’s EOS data, helping you move faster, think more clearly, and stay aligned.

release.description:
The RealAI MCP provides ChatGPT access to RealAI’s authoritative real estate data catalog, spanning 126 million US properties (including 230,000 multifamily communities with unit-level operating detail), aggregated data on the 250 million people who live in them, their rent and leasing activity, and market/geographic data from the metro down to the census-block level.

RealAI doesn't just describe properties and places — it scores and ranks them. Every area and building carries normalized national and local benchmarks across hundreds of attributes, so RealAI can rank an entire population — markets, neighborhoods, or buildings — against any combination of criteria a user cares about, rather than profiling one place at a time off a fixed template.

Two examples of data depth most tools can't match: migration data that captures not just population flows but the age, income, wealth, and education profile of who is moving in versus out of a market; and unit-level rent-roll history built from nightly listings nationwide — asking vs. in-place rents, occupancy, days on market, rent growth, turnover, and tradeouts.

Forinvest MCP: Real-Time Market Intelligence & Trading Integration

Connect your AI assistant directly to the heartbeat of global financial markets. The Forinvest MCP (Model Context Protocol) app transforms ChatGPT into a powerful financial agent with 22 MCP tools, providing secure, low-latency access to:

Live Market Data: Instant access to BIST, VIOP, global indices, commodities, and crypto prices.

Advanced Analytics: Professional-grade technical analysis tools and financial indicators at your fingertips.

Smart Portfolio Insights: Seamlessly retrieve and analyze portfolio data with institutional precision.

Seamless Connectivity: Built on the MCP standard for secure, bidirectional communication between ChatGPT and Forinvest's robust financial infrastructure.

Whether you're tracking real-time price movements or seeking deep market analysis, Forinvest MCP provides the reliable data layer needed for informed decision-making.

We provide a next-generation financial ecosystem, offering real-time Borsa Istanbul (BIST) data, AI-driven stock analysis, and comprehensive financial tools. Our platform streamlines investment processes by integrating deep-dive balance sheet metrics, brokerage expectations, and instant access to public disclosure (KAP) documents.

Data collected: ForInvest account credentials (for OAuth authentication), symbol codes and date ranges you query, and session identifiers. Tool inputs and outputs are not stored beyond the active session. Financial data returned by tools is sent back to ChatGPT for display. No personal data is sold or used for advertising.

Privacy Policy: https://mcp.forinvest.com/privacy.html

release.description:
Research UK properties and local markets with Propalt in ChatGPT. Find property facts and turn available data into useful research, pricing evidence and reports.

• Look up residential properties, sale and rental listings, ownership and lease details, EPC records and property history.
• Get indicative residential valuations, compare sold or listed properties, and explore local market trends and House Price Index data.
• Explore planning applications and available planning constraints. Search applications by property, postcode or outcode, such as NW1.
• Search non-residential land records using supported classifications, and find property records linked to a specified registered company.
• Find nearby schools, transport stops and amenities. Transport and amenity results include straight-line distances.
• Filter sale and rental listings by estate agent brand and supported property criteria. Use UPRN or UDPRN references for supported property lookups.
• Use guided workflows to prepare valuation briefs, pricing reports, property comparisons, price-reduction cases, negotiation notes and local property articles.
• Build property prospecting lists and export selected addresses to CSV for Propalt My Lists.

Planning data covers England and Wales. Planning-application searches support outcodes; planning-constraint searches require supported property or location inputs. Data coverage, availability and record dates vary by dataset. Valuations are estimates, and nearby transport data does not provide live timetables.

Connect a Propalt account with API access and sufficient credits.

API documentation: https://account.propalt.ai/api

release.description:
Ask for your birth chart and you get it drawn, not just described. Give a birth date, time and place, and AstroBella Astrology builds the full natal chart and a wheel you can actually explore — click any planet to see its exact degree, the sign and house it falls in, and every aspect it makes.

What you can ask for:

• Your natal chart — every placement, your rising sign and midheaven, the houses and the complete aspect list, with the wheel drawn beside it.

• What's happening right now — the transits currently touching your chart, or a scan of the coming weeks and months that shows the exact date each one peaks and how long it stays in effect.

• You and someone else — a compatibility comparison that lays out every contact between two charts, closest first.

• Quick sky questions — is Mercury retrograde, what sign is the Moon in, when is the next full moon. These need no birth details at all.

If you don't know your birth time, you still get a chart. The app tells you which parts it cannot determine without it — rising sign, midheaven and houses — instead of quietly guessing them.

Birthplaces are matched against a built-in list of over 120,000 towns and cities, so a small home town works as well as a capital. When a name is genuinely shared — Springfield, or the London in Ontario — you are asked which one you mean instead of being guessed at.

Planets are placed at their real degrees rather than rounded into a sign, and every chart is worked out fresh from astronomical data when you ask for it.

You can disconnect at any time to revoke access.

release.description:
Make the most informed real estate decision with a comprehensive Buy vs. Rent simulator. This app provides an objective, data-driven analysis to determine if buying a property is truly more profitable than renting and investing your capital elsewhere.

By integrating historical and projected IMF inflation data for your specific country, the simulator tracks the real value of your money year after year. It provides a complete financial breakdown from your first mortgage payment to the final resale, ensuring you stay objective based on your unique project.

Key features:
- Uses country-specific IMF inflation data for realistic long-term projections
- Compares the cost of buying with potential returns of alternative investments (stock market, savings, etc.)
- No account or registration required — start simulating immediately
- Toggle advanced parameters and view a full amortization table to understand every payment of your mortgage

Adjustable parameters:
- Property: Purchase price, notary fees, renovation costs, and agency fees
- Financing: Down payment, loan duration, mortgage rate, insurance, and prepayment penalties
- Rental: Monthly rent and projected annual rent increases
- Market Logic: Resale horizon, country-specific inflation (IMF), and alternative investment yield
- Costs: Local property taxes and maintenance

Get a clear, visual report on your break-even point and see exactly when ownership starts to pay off.

GovQuery is a powerful search engine that makes U.S. government reports and data easier to explore, locate, and understand.
 
Built by the Program Integrity Alliance, GovQuery processes over 300,000 articles, reports, and oversight recommendations to make them more digestible for AI platforms — offering deeper, more targeted search than general-purpose engines. Every result links to the exact page where content appears, and you can filter by granular categories unavailable on the source platforms.
 
Data sources currently include:
 
- Reports from the Government Accountability Office (GAO), federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), and the Congressional Research Service (CRS)
- Department of Justice press releases
- Executive orders (last six presidents)
- Annual federal CJ/AFR/PAR agency reports (since 2019 for Chief Financial Officers (CFO) Act of 1990)
 
GovQuery also includes all open oversight recommendations from the GAO and federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), with tools to analyze them by category and track trends over time.
 
New data sources are added regularly.
 
You can register for a free account at: https://www.programintegrity.org (click on the person icon top-right)

For more information on GovQuery data, please see our FAQ (https://www.programintegrity.org/faq).

Works in English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Vietnamese, Thai, Hindi, Arabic, Italian, Turkish and Indonesian.

release.description:
SuperMCP prices a shopping list against Israeli online supermarkets and tells you which store delivers it for the least, to your address.

Give it a list in Hebrew and a delivery address. It matches each item to real products in each chain's catalogue, adds delivery fees where the chain publishes verified terms, and returns a per-store total with a per-item breakdown, plus a link to each product on the retailer's own site.

It is built not to guess. Items a store does not carry are marked missing rather than swapped silently, every price carries the date it was last seen in the chain's price file, and a delivery fee is quoted only when the chain publishes terms that have been verified. When several products match one line, it asks you instead of picking for you.

Prices come from the price files Israeli retailers publish under the Price Transparency Law, ingested nightly.

Coverage is Israeli online supermarket delivery, and the product catalogue is in Hebrew.

release.description:
Aide Calendar is a calendar & task app for iPhone and iPad — now in ChatGPT.

Capture a plan in chat — type it, paste it, or show ChatGPT a screenshot — and it saves straight to Aide Calendar on your iPhone / iPad: event or task created, reminders set, synced across your devices. No retyping.

In ChatGPT
• Type or paste — "lunch Friday 1 pm at Nobu," "submit the report by Friday 5 pm"
• Upload a screenshot — a text, an email, an invite; ChatGPT reads it and saves it
• Saved complete — date, time, venue, attendees, phone, notes, and alerts
• Recurring and all-day events, and no duplicates when you re-save

On your iPhone & iPad — Aide Calendar
Everything you save here lives in the full Aide Calendar app, where you run your day:
• Capture on your phone too — screenshots, photos, voice notes, anything shared, in any language
• Five views (Day · 3-Day · Week · Week-list · Month), drag to reschedule, instant search
• A real task manager — priorities, due dates, Overdue / by day / Completed
• Tap a number to call, message, or WhatsApp; tap an address to open in Maps
• Real-time sync across iPhone and iPad

Private by design
• Saves only what you ask · never reads your other chats
• Keeps no copy of your events — they live only in your Aide account
• No ads, no tracking — Aide never uses your events to train AI models

Requires the Aide Calendar app for iPhone & iPad (iOS 17+)

release.description:
You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to ChatGPT through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with ChatGPT to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.

release.description:
Magic Tips turns "when should we go?" into a concrete answer.

Ask for a resort and a month, and you get a daily crowd score from 1 to 10
with the predicted wait-time level for each date — across Disneyland Paris,
Walt Disney World, Disneyland Resort (California), Tokyo Disney Resort,
Hong Kong Disneyland and Shanghai Disney Resort. Scores are built from
historical wait-time observations, school and public holiday calendars,
weather data and seasonal events, then normalised against each park's own
demand range.

It also answers the questions that come next:
• Attraction catalogues per park — minimum height, ride duration, must-do
  flag and community rating
• Which restaurants serve a given dish, searched across every resort
  ("vegan", "turkey leg", "mickey waffle")
• Resort FAQs and a plain-language glossary of planning jargon (Lightning
  Lane, DAS, rope drop), available in 13 languages

Scope and limits, stated plainly: coverage is Disney parks and Disney
Cruise Line — not Universal. The attraction catalogue is static and does
not include live wait times or ride closures. Crowd scores are forecasts,
not guarantees; the methodology and its known limits are published at
https://magic-tips.app/en/methodology

Magic Tips is an independent, fan-made project. It is not affiliated with,
endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to The Walt Disney
Company or any of its subsidiaries or affiliates. Park, attraction and
character names are trademarks of their respective owners and are used
here only to identify the places this tool covers.

TaxMCP gives ChatGPT citation-grounded access to U.S. tax authority. It searches and retrieves the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury Regulations, IRS publications and guidance, selected state tax statutes, and U.S. Tax Court opinions.

Seven read-only research tools support broad tax-law search, direct section lookup, IRS publication and guidance retrieval, Tax Court opinion retrieval, case citation-activity research, and statutory cross-reference analysis. Results include source identifiers and citation URLs so users can inspect the underlying authority.

TaxMCP is built for CPAs, enrolled agents, tax attorneys, researchers, and others who need source-linked tax research inside their existing AI workflow. It does not file returns, submit forms, make payments, edit records, or provide legal or tax advice. Case citation activity is not a substitute for Shepard's, KeyCite, or another authoritative current-validity check.

release.description:
Who What Wear brings the women's fashion publication's editorial voice into ChatGPT. It works like having a stylist who already knows your taste — once you've set up a short style profile, every fashion question gets a personalised, brand-aware answer instead of a generic one.

Setup takes about a minute. A guided four-step widget asks for your style words (Low-Key Luxury, Tailored, French, Sporty, Trend-Forward and others), the brands you actually shop across contemporary, luxury, denim and accessories, the style icons whose looks you'd happily borrow, and the price range you're comfortable with. The profile is saved per user, so it carries across conversations rather than starting over every time you open ChatGPT.

After onboarding, three things become useful.

Shopping for a specific item. Tell the app what you're looking for — "find me a black blazer under £250", "I need a coat for a winter wedding", "what jeans should I buy" — and it returns three to five picks weighted toward the brands you already buy from, plus a complete outfit built around the piece: what to wear on top, on the bottom, on your feet, and one or two accessories. The aim is to leave with a wearable answer, not a list of links.

Editorial inspiration. Ask what you should be wearing or looking at right now, and the app pulls fresh articles from Who What Wear UK's live editorial feed, then picks the two or three that match your taste using the brand and category tags on each article. The picks render as a horizontal carousel of cards in the publication's own visual language: editorial image, kicker, headline, byline credit, and a link straight back to the article on whowhatwear.com.

Refining your profile. Taste shifts. Reopen the onboarding to update any answer (and only the answers you want to change), or reset the profile entirely if you're starting fresh.

A few things worth knowing. The editorial feed is Who What Wear UK, so the content leans British in voice, currency and seasonality. Recommendations are always anchored in real Who What Wear articles or in brand suggestions drawn from the list you provided — the app does not invent URLs, images, or articles to fill out a result, and the carousel only renders when there are real links and images to attach. If the feed has nothing relevant on a given day, you get an honest reply rather than a fabricated one.

What the app is not: it does not cover men's fashion, beauty product search, home decor, or non-fashion shopping. It does not surface live retailer inventory or live prices. If a request falls outside this scope, it says so instead of guessing.

Built by Future PLC, publisher of Who What Wear.

release.description:
Your Tesla app already sends commands. This connector is what it can't do.

mytesla.io plugs your car into everything your AI already knows - your calendar, the weather, your routines - and decides when to act.

Ask for an outcome, not a button:
- "have the cabin cool by the time my last meeting ends"
- "get the car ready for my 300-mile drive tomorrow morning"
- "if frost is forecast tonight, defrost before my first meeting"

Or set a standing routine and stop thinking about it:
- "start cooling 15 minutes before I leave for work, but only when it's hot out"
- "charge to 80% by 7am on weekdays, off-peak only"
- "track my car stats daily and send me a report each Sunday"

Ready-made routines are at mytesla.io/skills - morning departure prep, off-peak charging, a nightly security check, a weekly digest, and a software update accelerator. One paste sets each one up, and they keep themselves current.

Or just ask: "where's my car, is it locked, did I leave the windows open in the rain?" One answer from live data, instead of tapping through multiple things in the Tesla app.

Climate, charging, security and status: 40 tools, all through Tesla's official Fleet API.

No driving control. Your Tesla tokens stay server-side, encrypted, and you can revoke access at any time. Not affiliated with Tesla, Inc.

release.description:
Airepoto connects ChatGPT to your meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries.

Find meetings across your workspaces and groups, read speaker-labeled transcripts, and get AI summaries with action items — all in natural language, without leaving the conversation.

What you can do
- Search and list meetings across workspaces, groups, and keywords
- Read full transcripts with speaker labels
- Read AI summaries, including decisions and action items
- Ask questions that span several meetings at once
- Create meeting minutes from an audio file, request a new AI summary, move minutes between groups, or move minutes to the trash

Access and privacy
Airepoto uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Every request is scoped to the signed-in user: the server resolves the verified email claim in the access token to an Airepoto member, and rejects any token without one. You only ever see the meetings your Airepoto account already has access to. Deletion moves minutes to the trash, where they can be restored.

Airepoto is a meeting recording, transcription, and AI-summary service by RSUPPORT Co., Ltd. An Airepoto account is required.

release.description:
Getir lets you order groceries without leaving your ChatGPT conversation. Start with a natural sentence like "order milk, bread, and eggs to home." The app connects to your account, lets you pick from your saved delivery addresses, builds your cart, and hands you off to the Getir mobile app to complete payment. Each step appears as a small interactive card directly in the chat.

You get two delivery options in one place. Getir handles on-demand convenience baskets delivered in minutes; GetirBüyük covers same-day large-basket delivery for weekly shopping with a broader assortment. You can switch between them inside the conversation depending on what you need.

You can search products in natural language and see live price and stock, choose from saved addresses or add a new one, and add, remove, or bulk-update items in your cart. Asking something like "plan a shopping list for the weekend" generates a multi-item list you can review and confirm. Featured deals and recommendations are available in the same flow. When you are ready to order, payment is completed in the Getir app or in your web cart.

Your account and payment data stay with Getir. Only the information needed to fulfill the order is shared with ChatGPT, and payment data is never sent to ChatGPT.

release.description:
Connect your SAMRUM account to talk through your family's personality profiles, reports and focus tracks in ChatGPT.

SAMRUM is a family personality tool: each person takes their own test at samrum.io and gets a profile of 10 everyday tendencies, based on the Big Five and the Interpersonal Circumplex. SAMRUM then shows the patterns that arise between two people – partners, parent and child, or siblings.

In ChatGPT you can:
- ask what your own profile says, or compare two family members side by side (shown as a chart)
- go through a couple, parent-child, sibling or family report one pattern at a time
- see this week's step in a focus track
- revisit your latest Right now guides after an argument

ChatGPT only reads what you can already see in SAMRUM. It shows nicknames and coarse levels (high, middle, low) – never raw answers, exact scores or full names – and it can't change anything in your account. You need a SAMRUM account with at least one completed test.
