release.description:
PocketSmith is a leading personal finance software, trusted by over 380,000 users in 190 countries. We help Household CFOs around the world take control of their money and achieve their financial goals. With powerful forecasting, multi-currency support, and flexible budgeting tools, PocketSmith offers a highly customizable approach to money management.

This connector lets ChatGPT have full secure access to your PocketSmith data, so that you can work with your finances in plain language.

Understand your money: search, filter and categorize your transactions in plain language. Investigate patterns across all your accounts, check balances, and review your categories, labels and saved searches.

Go beyond "what did I spend?": uncover unusual merchant and timing patterns, see what your spending reveals about your priorities and turn years of financial data into answers, stories and decisions that feel relevant to your life.

Get answers to questions like: "why does my cash flow dip next month?", "what changed our net worth most this year?" and "what does our spending suggest we valued, and which choices bought us the most joy, ease or security?"

Keep your budget in check: review budget performance, analyze spending trends across periods, find recurring expenses, plus access monthly reviews and financial health snapshots.

Plan ahead: use PocketSmith's forecasting engine to predict future cashflow and net worth, and manage the budget events that map out your future.

Keep things tidy: categorize your transactions, create new category rules, manage files and sync bank feeds.

Seamlessly jump to PocketSmith: describe the report you need to see in PocketSmith, and you'll get a deep link to that exact report in PocketSmith.

ChatGPT connects to PocketSmith via OAuth - when you connect, you sign in with PocketSmith and can revoke access any time. A read-only version of this connector is also available, if you don't want Claude to ever modify your data.

release.description:
The Evernote MCP server connects your Evernote account to your AI tools, so they can work from the notes, documents, and files you've already collected. Search across years of captured material, edit and organize what's there, and file new work straight back into your notebooks.

Key features:
• Search by keyword or by meaning - Use Evernote's search grammar to filter by notebook, tag, and date, or search semantically to surface notes by what they're about, even when you can't remember the words you used.
• Find what you never typed - Search reaches text inside scanned documents, photos, and images, and inside transcribed audio and video — so handwritten pages, whiteboard shots, receipts, and recorded meetings are all searchable alongside your written notes. Attached files can be downloaded and new ones uploaded.
• Read, write, and edit real notes - Fetch a note's full content, tags, and attachments; create new notes in the right notebook; update titles and bodies; and restore anything that ends up in the trash.
• Keep your account organized - Move notes between notebooks, add and remove tags, rename and re-parent tags, and create notebooks and Spaces as your work grows.
• Manage tasks inside your notes - Create tasks, update status and due dates, and find the ones you own or have been assigned, filtered by priority.
Everything happens inside your own account, under your existing permissions.

release.description:
ScalperIntel AI answers questions about ScalperIntel's indicators and lets verified customers manage their own licenses without leaving the chat.

Connecting takes one step: enter an email and the 6-digit code sent to it. With any email it answers from ScalperIntel's official product knowledge base — what an indicator detects and plots, what each setting does when you change it, installation and setup on NinjaTrader 8, chart and bar-type compatibility, pricing and license types, and which indicator suits a given style of trading. Answers are grounded in that knowledge base and cited rather than improvised.

Sign in with the email used to purchase and it also acts on that account: list licenses and their status, diagnose a license problem against the real license state rather than a guess, submit a new machine ID, switch between Named User and Machine ID activation, and log an issue for the support team with a reference number.

Scope is enforced in code, not by instruction. It gives no trading advice and makes no performance or profit claims; it answers about the software only. The signed-in email is read from the verified session and never from text typed into a prompt, so the license tools can only ever act on the account that signed in.

release.description:
Omphalis is the place where what you read, hear, and note begins to cohere. You save an article, and Omphalis shows its structure. You listen to a podcast on your commute, and Omphalis helps you come back to what mattered. You watch a two-hour talk, and Omphalis shows you the shape of it in seconds. You record a voice note at midnight, and Omphalis places it beside the article, talk, or paper that belongs with it.

The paper you read last spring meets the book you are reading now, and your voice note from a walk last month sits beside both. What changed in the field, what changed in your understanding, what still holds: all part of the same library, still in reach, still connected. Not a pile that grows heavier. A place that gets clearer.

It is for people who need what they consume to stay usable later — in writing, teaching, decision-making, research, or reflection — where understanding can compound over time.

Omphalis is a companion for long content: a map for structure, a margin for meaning, and a way back to the moments that matter.

release.description:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery"). It
ranks with the same engine imqueue.org's own search uses, so the site and this
server agree about which page answers a question, and licensing and pricing
questions answer from imqueue.com rather than the framework docs. A result can
point at a section rather than a whole page, and get_doc follows that anchor:
give it a URL with a #fragment and it returns just that section, with the heading
path above it and its position on the page, so you can see what was left out and
ask for the rest. Without a fragment it returns the whole page as plain markdown
for reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

package_status answers the version question outright: the current version,
licence, minimum Node version and release date of one @imqueue package or of all
of them, read from imqueue.org at the moment you ask rather than recalled. It
also answers for the framework as a whole — the Node and Redis floors, and a
licence note that states the licence terms in a sentence.

scaffold_service generates an idiomatic service — an IMQService subclass with
@expose()d, JSDoc-typed methods plus a bootstrap that starts it — from the method
signatures you describe. A custom return type comes back with the @classType() and
@property() decorators it needs, which matters because a field that lacks them
reaches the generated client typed any and still compiles. scaffold_client shows
how to generate and use the typed client for a service. Both return source text
for you to review and paste; neither writes a file.

All seven tools are read-only. The server has no accounts, no authentication and
no storage: each request is handled statelessly, and the only data it sees is the
argument you send — a search query, a doc URL, a package or service name. Nothing
is retained, and no conversation content is collected or used for training.

Tools that would act on your own machine — driving the imq CLI, creating projects
on disk, starting and stopping your services, reading their logs — are
deliberately not part of this server, because a hosted server cannot reach your
machine and should not claim to. They ship in the local install instead
(npx -y @imqueue/mcp), and local_install_guide returns the setup steps for it.

signatures you describe. A custom return type comes back with the @classType() and
@property() decorators it needs, which matters because a field that lacks them
reaches the generated client typed any and still compiles. scaffold_client shows
how to generate and use the typed client for a service. Both return source text
for you to review and paste; neither writes a file.

All seven tools are read-only. The server has no accounts, no authentication and
no storage: each request is handled statelessly, and the only data it sees is the
argument you send — a search query, a doc URL, a package or service name. Nothing
is retained, and no conversation content is collected or used for training.

Tools that would act on your own machine — driving the imq CLI, creating projects
on disk, starting and stopping your services, reading their logs — are
deliberately not part of this server, because a hosted server cannot reach your
machine and should not claim to. They ship in the local install instead
(npx -y @imqueue/mcp), and local_install_guide returns the setup steps for it.

release.description:
The Allianz Direct Spain Car Insurance Explorer offers a transparent way to visualize and understand Allianz Direct car insurance options within ChatGPT. This tool helps you see how a car insurance policy could be structured, focusing on clarity and customization. Use this app to design a potential policy configuration, learn about protection details, and get an estimated price without any commitment.

Key Features:
• Detailed Coverage Analysis: Receive detailed breakdowns of what is included and what can be included in an Allianz Direct policy for a specific type of car.

• Clarified Terms: Request immediate definitions of insurance concepts (e.g., "additional coverage" or "exclusions") to ensure you fully understand the terminology used.

• Interactive Customization: Understand policy parameters, such as liability limits or specific coverage inclusions, to see how they influence the insurance estimate.

How it works:

Simply describe your car's characteristics and what you need (e.g., "A basic third-party car insurance for a Seat Ibiza"). The app will generate a corresponding non-binding policy outline. You can then ask the assistant for information about the coverage, request modifications to the details, or ask for explanations of specific clauses to see how the coverage adapts to your needs and what options are available. If you wish to proceed, the app will request the necessary details and provide a price estimate. For an official quote or policy issuance, users are directed to Allianz Direct's official purchasing channels.

Note: This tool is for informational and exploration purposes only, providing estimates based on the details shared in the chat. Official policy issuance requires verification through Allianz Direct Spain's official website. The insurance part of the Service that Allianz Direct operates is subject to human oversight by Allianz; you may contact human advisors at any time through Allianz Direct's official channels. 

Please bear in mind that AI systems may produce outputs that are inaccurate, incomplete or not fully adapted to specific circumstances, and the accuracy of any indicative quotation depends directly on the accuracy and completeness of the information provided.

Important: Do NOT provide payment data (bank account numbers, IBANs, payment card details), national identity documents (DNI/NIE), passport numbers or any other sensitive personal identification data through this chat. Such data should only be provided through Allianz Direct's secure contracting environment. 

Data required for quotation: To generate an indicative quotation, the Service will request the following information: date of birth, driving license details, vehicle data (registration plate, date of first registration and type of use), postcode, estimated annual mileage and payment frequency preference. The Service does not collect national identification documents or any special categories of personal data.

release.description:
Get NHL scores, schedules, standings, team details, player information, and game updates without leaving your chat. This app brings hockey information right into your conversation. Ask a question in plain English and get a clear answer. You do not need to search many websites or open another app. Everything stays in one place, making it fast and easy to follow the NHL.

Want today’s scores? Just ask. Want tonight’s games? Ask that too. Need the latest standings? The app can show them. You can check team records, player stats, game times, and much more. If you want to know who won, who is playing next, or how your favorite team is doing, simply ask.

The app works like a hockey helper. You can ask short questions or longer ones. You can say things like “Who plays tonight?”, “Did the Oilers win?”, “Show me the Eastern Conference standings,” or “When do the Rangers play next?” The app understands natural language, so you do not have to learn special commands.

Follow one team or every team. Keep up with the regular season, the playoffs, and important games. Find schedules, scores, and standings in seconds. Whether you watch every game or only check in once in a while, the information is easy to find.

Player information is also simple to explore. Ask about a player and learn which team they play for, their position, and other useful details. Compare players, check team matchups, or look up game information before the puck drops.

Need a quick answer during a game? Ask for the live score. Want to know what happened after the game ends? Ask for the final score. Looking ahead? Check upcoming games and schedules. Looking back? Review recent results. The app helps you stay connected all season long.

Everything happens inside your conversation. There is no need to jump between tabs or search through many pages. Just ask another question and keep going. It feels like talking with a friend who always knows what is happening around the NHL.

The app is built to be clear and easy to use. Answers are organized so they are simple to read. Whether you ask one question or many, the goal is to help you find hockey information quickly.

Great for longtime fans. Great for new fans. Great for people learning about hockey. If you know every player, you can dive into detailed information. If you are just starting to watch the NHL, you can ask basic questions and learn as you go.

Use the app to check scores before work, during lunch, after school, or before bed. See who is winning, who is climbing the standings, and what games are coming next. Keep track of your favorite team throughout the season without extra searching.

You can ask about today’s games, tomorrow’s games, team records, conference standings, division standings, schedules, results, matchups, and more. The app is made to help you find hockey information in a simple and friendly way.

Whether you want a fast score check, a full schedule, the latest standings, player information, or answers to everyday NHL questions, this app keeps everything together inside ChatGPT. Ask, explore, and stay up to date with the National Hockey League from one easy conversation.

ChatGPT can preview the result and, when you ask it to, publish live. Everything it makes appears in Softr Studio exactly like work done by hand, so you and your team keep editing in the visual builder afterward - nothing is locked into the chat.

Day to day, ChatGPT can also work with your data directly: search, filter, and aggregate records, and create or update them in bulk.

Every action runs with your own permissions, and you choose the access level per workspace when you connect: read-only, edit, or full access.

Databases: create tables and the fields to match your project, structure and import records, and browse data sources you have already connected.

Applications: generate an app on top of your data, add and arrange pages and blocks, configure sign-up and login, set user groups and page permissions, and manage app users. Extend any page with a custom code block that ChatGPT writes for you, with every version saved so you can roll back.

Workflows: build multi-step automations with triggers, actions, and branching logic, test each step against real data, and publish when it works.

ChatGPT can preview the result and, when you ask it to, publish live. Everything it makes appears in Softr Studio exactly like work done by hand, so you and your team keep editing in the visual builder afterward - nothing is locked into the chat.

Day to day, ChatGPT can also work with your data directly: search, filter, and aggregate records, and create or update them in bulk.

Every action runs with your own permissions, and you choose the access level per workspace when you connect: read-only, edit, or full access.

release.description:
Pendar gives you the shape of a research field, not a summary of it.

Point it at a topic and it reports how many papers exist, whether output is growing or flattening, which disciplines and countries produce them, and which papers to read first. Every figure is counted across the whole corpus rather than estimated from a sample, so you can plan around it.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each reference against the published record: whether the paper exists, whether the citation describes it accurately, and whether it has been retracted. A reference it cannot find is reported as unverified rather than swapped for the nearest real paper, which matters when the citations came from a model.

Every tool is read-only. Pendar looks things up and reports what it finds.

release.description:
Draft, revise, and organize the scripts you read on camera, without leaving the conversation. Connect your Teleprompter.com account and ChatGPT can write a script with you, then save it straight to your workspace, filed in the right folder and ready for your next take.

What ChatGPT can do:

- Create scripts with playback settings applied as they're written: font size, scroll speed, timed-speed mode, text alignment, and estimated duration
- Revise existing scripts in place. Updates touch only the fields you ask for, so the rest of your setup stays as you left it
- Read your library: list scripts newest first, pull the full text of any script, and see what's inside each folder
- Organize: create folders, rename them, and move scripts between folders or back to the root

Because ChatGPT can read what you've already written, you can work from your own back catalogue: ask for a tighter cut of last month's intro, a 30-second version of a product explainer, or a consistent sign-off across everything in one folder.

You'll need a Teleprompter.com account; the integration is available on every account tier. Connecting uses OAuth, so there are no keys to copy or store, and you choose which permissions to grant: reading and writing scripts and folders are separate approvals, so read-only access is a valid choice. ChatGPT only ever sees your own personal workspace.

Scripts saved here are the same scripts your Teleprompter apps read, so anything drafted in a conversation is waiting for you the next time you open one up.

release.description:
Moody's Credit MCP powers AI applications and analytics workflows with GenAI-ready data and research needed for comprehensive credit analysis.

Moody's Credit MCP provides a unified layer across core credit data categories commonly used in risk assessment, offering financial analysis, default risk metrics, and qualitative insights. It combines comprehensive entity information, such as financials, ownership, and management, with Moody's Ratings proprietary ratings and research, and probability of default metrics, all enhanced by unstructured data like company filings, earnings transcripts, news, and macroeconomic trends.

By bringing structured and unstructured credit inputs together in a single interface, Moody's Credit MCP enables faster data-to-insight workflows, supporting more rigorous, consistent credit assessment and continuous monitoring of entities, markets, and portfolios.

Data includes:
- Global entity firmographics and identifiers
- Entity hierarchies and ownership structures
- Detailed global entity financials
- Moody's Ratings credit ratings and research
- Expected default frequency
- Economic data and research
- News and media
- Annual reports

Use Moody's Credit MCP for:
- Credit Analysis - access comprehensive credit risk data and research to assess creditworthiness and compare risk across issuers and instruments
- Risk Management - monitor credit risk through forward-looking measures and scenario analysis
- Relationship Management - quickly evaluate credit health to support informed engagement and credit structuring
- Ratings Advisory - align issuer details with ratings methodologies and peer benchmarks
- Investment Research - get data-driven assessments to evaluate relative value and risk
- Market Analysis - analyze sector trends and credit risk signals to assess broader market conditions

release.description:
SmartSpectra is a contactless vital signs SDK from Presage Technologies. It measures heart rate and breathing rate from standard smartphone and webcam video using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), on any device with a camera. No wearables, no contact sensors.

Developers use SmartSpectra rPPG for remote vital signs monitoring, telehealth intake, contactless health checks, employee wellness screening, driver fatigue detection, clinical trial screening, and digital biomarker collection across iOS, Android, and web.

Use this connector to retrieve SDK credentials and API keys, inspect plan usage, manage registered mobile applications, locate application configuration files, and search SmartSpectra rPPG integration documentation.

Also measured: heart rate variability (HRV) and electrodermal activity, with ongoing work in contactless blood pressure.

The SmartSpectra SDK is built by Presage Technologies, who in 2026 received FDA 510(k) clearance (K254169) for heart rate and breathing rate in its SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0. Presage serves healthcare, government, and wellness markets from Leesburg, Virginia, USA.

a decision, an idea, a code snippet, research notes — and the AIs you connect

assistant, it follows you across the tools you already use — ChatGPT, Claude,
and other MCP-compatible apps. Save something in one, recall it in another.

There's nothing to organize: no folders, no tags. You just save, and a short
bit of context surfaces the closest match when you ask. Use it to keep working
decisions, team conventions, preferences, and anything you'd rather not explain
to your AI twice.

release.description:
SRS (Spaced Repetition System) is a personal learning and revision app designed to help users retain knowledge for the long term instead of forgetting it after a few days. It lets users organize content into subjects and topics, store detailed lessons, summaries, notes, coding examples, and reference links, and mark topics as either "to learn" or "learned." Once a topic is learned, the app automatically schedules future reviews using a spaced repetition algorithm based on the user's confidence and previous performance.

The app is aimed at students, software developers, and lifelong learners, with a strong focus on technical subjects such as DSA, programming, algorithms, and interview preparation. Each day, it generates a personalized review queue so users know exactly what to revise, helping them strengthen their understanding over time while spending less time reviewing concepts they already know well. The goal is to serve as a personal knowledge base and long-term memory system that makes learning more efficient and consistent.

release.description:
Padlet is a visual board platform used by teachers, students, and teams to collect, organize, and share content on collaborative boards called padlets. The Padlet app for ChatGPT connects the user's own Padlet account via OAuth so they can work with their padlets directly in conversation.

With this app, users can:
- Create padlets and organize them with sections, layouts, wallpapers, and appearance settings.
- Add, edit, arrange, pin, and sort posts, and draw connections between posts on Freeform boards.
- Read, search, and summarize board content, including AI analysis of images, videos, audio, and document attachments.
- Comment on posts and moderate discussion.
- Manage sharing settings by modifying permissions, passwords, collaborators, and email invitations.
- Schedule automations such as timed freezes, and freeze or unfreeze boards on demand.
- Grade student submissions and sync grades to a connected LMS (e.g. Canvas or Schoology) via LTI.
- For school and team library admins: manage membership and invitations, per-role permissions, SSO configuration (OAuth providers and SAML), approved email domains, content safety, and allowed attachment types.

The app does not yet fully support Padlet's Sandbox (whiteboard) format; it works with Padlet's other board formats.

All actions run against the authenticated user's Padlet account and respect Padlet's permission model — the app can only see and change what the signed-in user could see and change in Padlet itself. Deletions of posts and sections are soft-deletes that can be restored with a dedicated restore tool, and the small number of irreversible operations (deleting comments, automations, or custom fields, removing collaborators, invitations, or approved domains) are annotated as destructive so the assistant confirms with the user before proceeding.

release.description:
Bring an AI-powered visual design workflow into ChatGPT and Codex. Create, refine, review, and export polished, editable designs through natural conversation.

What you can create: AI presentations and pitch decks, posters and flyers, social media graphics, infographics, diagrams, cards, email designs, web concepts, UI mockups, and visual documents.

Create presentations: Turn a topic, outline, brief, or existing content into a polished, editable presentation. Create posters: Design event posters, promotional graphics, flyers, and visual art in any supported format. Create social media content: Produce editable designs for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other channels. Create infographics and diagrams: Transform complex ideas, processes, and data into clear visual stories.

Recreate designs: Provide an image, screenshot, website, document, or design.md file as a visual reference. StarryKit analyzes its composition, typography, colors, hierarchy, and visual language, then recreates the direction with editable elements—without requiring a template.

Edit and refine: Rewrite complete pages or request focused changes to text, layout, colors, imagery, hierarchy, and formatting while preserving the rest of the design. Review generated page drafts in StarryKit before accepting them into your document.

Export designs: Download your finished work as PowerPoint, PDF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, or HTML, or export an editable presentation to Google Slides.

Once installed, describe what you want in plain language or invoke StarryKit directly with @StarryKit.

Try prompts like:
- @StarryKit, create a 10-slide investor pitch deck for a sustainable urban farming startup.
- @StarryKit, design a bold poster for an electronic music festival in Tokyo.
- @StarryKit, turn this report into a clear, visual infographic.
- @StarryKit, recreate this website screenshot as an editable visual design.
- @StarryKit, make the headline larger, highlight the key metric, and preserve everything else.
- @StarryKit, export this presentation to PowerPoint and Google Slides.

release.description:
Facile.it Energia helps you compare gas and electricity offers in Italy. Instead of visiting each provider's website or deciphering confusing rate sheets, you can see the best available offers based on your actual consumption and location, all in one screen.

Tell Facile.it Energia what you need - electricity, gas, or both - and it shows you a simple form to enter your city and household consumption. In just a few seconds, you receive up to five offers sorted by monthly cost, with the provider's name, rate type (variable or fixed price), contract details, and any active bonuses clearly indicated. Each offer links directly to the provider's page on Facile.it, so you can proceed whenever you're ready.

If you want a more precise estimate, Facile.it Energia can redirect you to the section of Facile.it where you can upload a recent bill for a tailored comparison. Facile.it Energia covers exclusively the Italian residential energy market - it does not handle business contracts, insurance, mortgages, or other Facile.it products, and it does not process payments or manage existing contracts.

release.description:
Need to know if a website is down? Type its address and I’ll check it for you. 

I quickly test if the site can be reached and tell you what I find in clear, simple words. If the site is working, I’ll say it is online. If it is not working, I’ll explain that too. You do not need special computer skills. Just ask, and I’ll do the checking.

This is helpful when a page will not load, an app will not connect, or a service seems broken. Many problems look the same, but they can have different causes. A website may be down for everyone. It may only be blocked for you. Your internet may have a problem. The site may be slow. I help you understand what is most likely happening so you know what to try next.

Using me is easy. Tell me the website you want to check. You can paste a full web address or simply type the name of the site. I will test whether it can be reached and share the result in plain English. If there is useful extra information, I will explain what it means without lots of hard words.

You can check almost any public website. News sites, shops, games, schools, blogs, company pages, and online tools can all be checked. If a page is public on the internet, I can usually test whether it is responding. If a site cannot be checked for a technical reason, I will tell you instead of guessing.

If a website is online, I can help you think about why it still is not working for you. Maybe your browser needs to refresh. Maybe your internet connection has a problem. Maybe a VPN, firewall, or network setting is getting in the way. Sometimes waiting a few minutes is enough because a busy service starts working again.

If a website is down, I explain that in a simple way. I will not make up reasons or pretend to know something I cannot see. If there is not enough information, I will say so. Clear answers are better than confusing ones.

This tool is useful for everyone. Students can check school websites before class. Families can see if a favorite game or video site is having trouble. Workers can test company pages before reporting a problem. Developers can quickly check a public site before spending time looking for bugs. Support teams can use it as a fast first step when helping customers.

You can ask things like “Is this website down?”, “Can you check example.com?”, “Why won’t this page load?”, “Is the server online?”, or “Can anyone reach this site?” I understand many different ways of asking the same question, so you do not have to use special commands.

My goal is to save you time. Instead of trying many different things, start with a quick check. Knowing whether a website is online or offline helps you decide what to do next. That can stop wasted time, reduce worry, and make fixing problems much easier.

I focus on giving short, useful answers first. If you want more detail, just ask. I can explain what the result means, what you can try next, and which common problems might fit the situation. I keep the language simple, avoid unnecessary jargon, and stay honest about what I know.

Whether you are checking one website or many, I aim to make the process fast, clear, and easy. Paste a web address, type a site name, or ask if a service is down. I’ll check its reachability, explain the result, and help you understand what to do next.

release.description:
Bites is an AI-native ordering platform that lets people discover restaurants, browse full menus, and place direct orders from local restaurants — all from ChatGPT, without switching to a delivery app.

Customers get the convenience of AI-powered ordering while seeing in-store menu pricing, with no markups or hidden fees. They can search by cuisine or location, ask for recommendations, customize meals, and build group orders in natural language.

Examples:

"Order from Popeyes in San Jose."
"Order 2 Not So Fried Chicken sandwiches from Mendocino Farms, no sauce, with gluten-free bread."
"Build a vegetarian-friendly office lunch order for 10 people from Boltiful Santa Clara under $20 per person. Add few desserts for the team to share."
"Show me the menu for Curry Up Now and help me pick something spicy."

For restaurants, Bites enables direct, AI-powered ordering with no commissions, no markups, and full ownership of customer relationships. Restaurants can reduce reliance on third-party delivery apps while preserving margins and serving customers through the channels they already use.

In short, Bites combines the convenience of delivery apps with the economics of ordering directly from restaurants.

All Ten – Beast Academy is a daily math puzzle families can solve together. Using only basic math operations and each of the four digits provided in the puzzle, your goal is to create every number from 1 through 10.

The challenge reflects Beast Academy’s approach to building number sense and problem-solving skills through playful, thought-provoking puzzles rather than rote practice.

With the ChatGPT app, the experience goes a step further. When families get stuck, they can use the conversational nature of AI to ask for hints, explore strategies, and work through ideas together without simply revealing the answers. It’s a simple, engaging way to turn math time into shared discovery and get a feel for Beast Academy’s problem-solving philosophy.

Think of it as Wordle, but for mathematical thinking.

release.description:
Scribble sends real handwritten cards. A machine holds an actual pen and writes each card and envelope in ink, then we stamp it and put it in the post anywhere in the United States. Nothing is a printed font.

Connect this and you can ask ChatGPT to look someone up in your address book, draft the card, and send it — and it shows you a picture of the card first, written in the handwriting that will actually be used, alongside the printed front. Ask to see the handwriting styles and it writes you a real specimen of each. You can also load a spreadsheet of contacts, send a personalised batch where every card says a different name, and set up a rule that sends birthday cards every year on its own.

Cards are paid for with credits bought in advance on scribblecards.com, so nothing here takes a payment or links to a checkout. Sending is marked as an action that cannot be undone, so ChatGPT asks before it posts anything. A batch is prepared first and shows real examples of the merged cards before you confirm it. A recurring rule is always created switched off, and reports how many people it can reach, so a person decides before it ever fires.

Requires a Scribble business account with credits.

release.description:
Priority Guardian — Your priorities deserve more than good intentions.

Protected Time, Flexible Planning: Priorities don't fail because you stopped caring. They fail because everything else is loud and your most important work is quiet. Priority Guardian makes the quiet work visible — so you can protect it.

Built for people who do entrepreneurial work and juggle more than one thing at a time.

HOW IT WORKS:
Priority Guardian connects your priorities to your Google Calendar so you can see where your time is actually going and stay accountable to what matters. 

Two modes:
Deadline work — hours invested, pace against deadline, where effort is going
Ongoing commitments — weekly hour targets, streaks, monthly results check-in


1. Kick off with: "Set up my priorities in Priority Guardian."
2. Name your priorities and assign a keyword (P1, P2, P3) to tag your Google Calendar events
3. See your priorities dashboard anytime — current progress at a glance. → "Show me my priorities."
4. Get your first weekly report  → "Show me my weekly report."
5. Inspect and adjust weekly → "Let's dig into what helps me progress/ hinders my progress"
6. Discover patterns over time  → "How was I keeping up with my priorities over the last weeks and months?"

The AI guides setup, narrates your data, and asks the questions worth sitting with. You decide what to do with it.

Live data for 470+ U.S. national parks, monuments, and historic sites — plus day-by-day trip planning. release.description:
A complete legal research and firm-management toolkit inside ChatGPT.

Connect ChatGPT to CiteLaw’s U.S. legal database of millions of court opinions, statutes, regulations, court rules, standing orders, agency materials, and other legal authorities. ChatGPT retrieves CiteLaw’s source text instead of relying solely on model memory, producing answers grounded in identifiable authorities with direct citation links.

Legal research:
Ask legal questions in plain English and search cases, statutes, regulations, and rules across jurisdictions. Run Boolean, exact-phrase, metadata, and keyword searches. Retrieve an authority’s text and metadata, investigate how later courts have treated a case, and review a judge’s standing orders and practices. Paste a brief or citation list to verify authorities and identify possible, missing, or mismatched citations. Search documents and revisit prior research stored in your CiteLaw matters.

Firm management:
Review clients, contacts, tasks, deadlines, notes, documents, discovery, clauses, matters, saved workflows, team members, invitations, and workspace activity. Create and update leads, contacts, tasks, calendar events, discovery sets, clauses, matters, team workspaces, and reusable workflows. Run saved workflows in ChatGPT to follow your firm’s standardized research, review, and document processes. Use AI-assisted bulk imports to migrate contacts, matters, leads, tasks, deadlines, and notes from an existing case-management system in batches of 50, with source IDs that make reruns safe. Invite colleagues, manage workspace and matter access, assign roles, and set billing rates. Save notes and drafted Word documents to the active matter. Switch workspaces and matters so work remains in the correct team context.

Built for attorneys, law students, and legal scholars. CiteLaw retrieves and explains legal information; it does not provide legal advice, and using it does not create an attorney-client relationship.

Windsock estimates the market value of general aviation aircraft and provides the supporting market data behind that estimate. Enter an aircraft's tail number (N-number) to get an estimated current market value, comparable aircraft, and recent price trends for that make and model.
You can ask follow-up questions in plain language — how avionics, engine time since overhaul, damage history, or location affect value; how long similar aircraft typically take to sell; and how the broader segment is moving. release.description:
Beamtrace is an AI visibility platform covering your visibility metrics, prompt tracking, website optimization, and reputation management in AI search. It's built to show how your business holds up when people turn to AI for recommendations.

The app puts your data into a conversation ChatGPT can work with: cross-reference numbers, explain what's behind a drop, and turn scores into something you can act on or hand off.

What you can do with it
#1 Spot the pattern behind your visibility
- "Why don't AI assistants recommend my business?" 
Reads across every prompt you're missing from and names what they have in common.

#2 Find your competitor's edge
- "Why did my competitor jump ahead this month?"
Pulls the competitor leaderboard, then narrows it to what they did or what changed to cause it.

#3 Prioritize your next content fix
- "I can fix only one thing this month, what should I do?”
Ranks your content improvements by impact rather than listing every gap flat, so you know exactly where to start and what to do.

#4 Understand what moved your score
- "What changed in my AI visibility this month?" 
Checks the score trend against the topic and prompt movement to tell you whether it's a real shift.

#5 Build a client-ready report
- "Build this month's AI visibility summary for my client" 
Draws the score, competitor standing, and top fixes, and writes it up as a report that you can paste anywhere.

#6 Know what a metric actually means
- "What does [metric] mean for my visibility, and should I care about it?"
Explains what a metric measures or gives a read on your visibility state in simple words.

How to get started
- Sign in with a Beamtrace account.
- The app reads live data from your connected website.
- No setup beyond that; start the conversation.

Ask a question in plain language and get an analysis scoped to your business.

Requirements
Your business needs an active subscription or trial. A website must be connected to the service. If it isn't, ChatGPT points you to Beamtrace's setup page instead of guessing at your data. 

It doesn't change your Beamtrace settings, tracked prompts, or account data. It reads your dashboard and hands the numbers to ChatGPT for analysis, reporting, and Q&A.

release.description:
Atlas Red is a workspace for structured mind maps. A map is a tree of topics, and every topic in a map shares the same author-defined fields — plain text, or typed ones like a select with its own options, a number or a date — so a map behaves like a small database you can see.

Connect your account and you can create maps, read a single topic's neighbourhood without pulling in the whole map, add and reorganise topics, fill in typed fields, link topics across branches, and import or export maps as Markdown, OPML, YAML and other formats. Every change is saved to your account, and anything you do here can be undone — from this conversation or later in the app.

The maps persist and stay yours: the same map opens in the Atlas Red web app on any device, on a visual canvas where you can rearrange it, colour it by one of its fields, attach images and share a read-only link.

release.description:
RIFO Home makes it easy to search homes for sale and rent through conversation.
Simply describe what you’re looking for — location, budget, commute, schools, neighborhood, lifestyle, or nearby places — and explore listings that match your needs.

Go beyond standard home search filters with location-aware discovery. Find homes near parks, schools, supermarkets, cafes, restaurants, and other points of interest, or search based on preferences around transit, highways, railways, and surrounding infrastructure. You can also search by school boundary, nearby places, and intersections to discover homes in the areas that fit your daily life.

Try asking things like:
• Find 2 bedroom detached house for sale near schools and parks in Markham under $2M.
• Show me 1 bedroom condo rentals near a subway station under $2,500 in Yonge and Finch.
• Are there any 3-bedroom townhouses in Richmond Hill under $1.2M that are located away from highways and power lines?

release.description:
1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.

It is an "external memory" tool for people whose work depends on stacking one-on-one conversations — sales professionals,
community builders, managers, founders, advisors, and anyone who runs recurring 1:1s.

CORE FEATURES

・Member management: Structured storage of each person's goals, values, skills, referral needs, background, and tags
・AI meeting notes: Automatic transcription of meeting audio with AI-generated summaries and action items
・Dashboard: Chronological view of who you met, when, and what you discussed
・Profile import: Extract member information from business cards or web pages
・Referral matching: AI suggests who to introduce to whom based on past conversations

Note: the above are features of the 1to1 Mate app itself. Audio transcription, new meeting note creation, and member
registration all happen inside the 1to1 Mate app. The MCP / ChatGPT integration only provides read-only access to data already
 recorded through those features.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH CHATGPT

Once you connect 1to1 Mate to ChatGPT, you can ask things like:

・"Draft the next agenda for my 1:1 with Tanaka based on what we discussed last time."
・"Find members who are struggling with marketing."
・"Who on my member list would be a good introduction for Yamada, given her goals?"
・"Summarize the action items I committed to across last month's 1:1s."

The AI reads your data on a strictly read-only basis. Nothing is modified or deleted through this connection.

PERMISSIONS & DATA HANDLING

・Available on all plans, including the free plan
・Authentication via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; sign in with your Google account
・Raw contact details (phone numbers, email addresses, messaging IDs) are never exposed to the AI. Not even the channel type label is returned — the MCP layer simply omits all contact-related fields
・You can disconnect the integration at any time from your account settings

See https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp for the full connection walkthrough and the exact fields each tool returns.

It allows users to search and retrieve real public luxury property listings from the HOUSE ’N’ STARS structured dataset, including Monaco, the French Riviera, Dubai, Abu Dhabi and selected international luxury destinations.

The app helps ChatGPT access public property data such as title, location, property type, Sale/Rent status, price display, bedrooms, bathrooms, surface, features and public listing URL.

Listings are supplied by professional real estate agencies admitted to the HOUSE ’N’ STARS platform. The platform applies a curation and quality-control layer to support reliable discovery, structured presentation and a consistent user experience.

The connector is strictly read-only and public-data-only. It does not create, edit, delete, reserve, buy, sell or publish properties. It does not request or process sensitive personal data, payment details, identity documents, financial documents or precise user location. It also does not provide legal, financial, valuation or investment advice.

release.description:
Hausmann Immobilien Makler is a modern real estate company specializing in Norderstedt, Hamburg, Dresden, and other regions across Eastern Germany. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, sell, or rent properties.

Instead of browsing through long property lists, users can explore available houses, apartments, land plots, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand a property's location, neighborhood, and surrounding infrastructure at a glance, creating a faster and more efficient property search experience.

With extensive regional market expertise and innovative digital solutions, Hausmann Immobilien Makler helps buyers, sellers, investors, and renters find the right property throughout Northern and Eastern Germany.

Key Benefits

* Interactive property search with a modern map-based interface
* Faster navigation across Norderstedt, Hamburg, Dresden, and Eastern Germany
* Better understanding of neighborhoods, infrastructure, and local amenities
* Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties
* Easy comparison of different cities and residential areas
* More efficient property search through visual navigation
* Direct access to experienced real estate professionals
* Modern, user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for a condominium in Hamburg, a family home in Norderstedt, an investment property in Dresden, or real estate in one of Eastern Germany's emerging regions, Hausmann Immobilien Makler provides a modern, transparent, and convenient way to explore the regional property market.

release.description:
Schedule and publish social media posts from ChatGPT. PostSyncer connects ChatGPT to your Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Telegram and Mastodon accounts - 11 networks from one app.

Ask ChatGPT to write a caption, attach an image or video (including ones it just generated), and post now or schedule it across several networks at once, with per-platform variants. Ask how a post or an account performed and get views, likes, comments and shares back in the chat. Sync and reply to comments, hide spam, group posts into campaigns, and keep a media library - all without opening a dashboard.

Setup is one click: install the app and sign in to PostSyncer. Publishing goes through PostSyncer's official platform integrations, so ChatGPT never sees your social logins.

Try: "@PostSyncer schedule this video to TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts for tomorrow at 9am" - "@PostSyncer draft a week of LinkedIn and X posts about our launch and schedule them" - "@PostSyncer which of my posts got the most views this month?"

release.description:
Write the perfect replies to your online reviews.

This app helps business owners write clear, personal, and polite replies to customer reviews. Copy a review, paste it into the app, and get a response that sounds friendly and professional. Save time, keep your customers happy, and build a better online reputation without staring at a blank page.

Good review? Bad review? Short review? Long review? This app can help. It creates thoughtful replies that fit the customer’s message instead of giving the same answer every time. You stay in control and can edit every reply before you post it.

Customers notice when businesses reply. A simple thank you can make a good review even better. A calm and caring answer to a bad review can show that you listen and want to help. Taking time to reply builds trust, but writing every response can take hours. This app does the hard part for you.

The app is made for busy business owners, managers, and teams. It works well for restaurants, cafés, shops, hotels, plumbers, electricians, salons, gyms, dentists, doctors, real estate agents, law firms, cleaners, contractors, and many other businesses. If people leave reviews about your business, this app can help you answer them.

Every reply is written to sound natural. The app looks at what the customer said and writes a response that matches the situation. Happy customers get warm thanks. Customers with questions get helpful answers. Customers who had a bad experience get a calm and respectful reply that shows you care.

You can change the reply before you use it. Add your own details, adjust the tone, or make it shorter or longer. The app gives you a strong starting point so you spend less time writing and more time running your business.

Replying to reviews can help your business grow. People often read reviews before they choose where to spend their money. When they see helpful replies from the owner, they know someone is paying attention. That can build confidence and encourage more people to visit, call, or buy.

The app is easy to use. Paste a review, choose the style you want, and generate a reply in seconds. There is no need to search for templates or wonder what to say. The app helps you find the right words quickly.

Use it for positive reviews, negative reviews, five-star reviews, one-star reviews, first-time customers, regular customers, complaints, compliments, questions, and everything in between. Every review is different, and every reply should feel personal.

Keep your brand voice consistent. Whether your business is fun, formal, warm, or simple, you can create replies that match your style. This helps customers recognize your business and builds a stronger connection over time.

The app also helps reduce stress. Many business owners worry about saying the wrong thing, especially when responding to unhappy customers. Instead of starting from scratch, you get a thoughtful draft that you can review and adjust before posting.

Fast replies can make a big difference. Customers like knowing they have been heard. A quick response shows that your business cares about feedback and wants to improve. Even a short reply can leave a lasting impression.

Whether you receive a few reviews each month or many every day, this app helps you stay on top of them. Save time, reply with confidence, and give every customer the attention they deserve. Better conversations lead to better relationships, stronger trust, and a better reputation. Start writing smarter review replies today and spend less time typing while making every customer feel heard.

release.description:
Fraghab is a fragrance collection manager. It tracks the bottles and decants you own, how much is left in each, what you wore and when, and what you are saving up for.

Connect it and you can work with your own shelf in plain language. Ask what you have not worn since spring and it reads your collection. Say you wore the Santal 33 decant today, four sprays, and it logs the wearing and deducts the millilitres. Add a bottle you just bought in a sentence instead of a form, correct a rating or a note on one you already have, group bottles onto shelves, and save the layering combos you actually wear.

It also prices your wishlist. Ask for the best price on something you are saving for and Fraghab searches fragrance retailers for the cheapest current offer, tells you which shop has it, and gives the entry a product photo.

You authorize the connection on a Fraghab screen and approve each permission. Nothing can be deleted through it. Editing replaces what was there, so ChatGPT asks before it changes something you already had. Changing your Fraghab password revokes access immediately. Fraghab is free and takes no payment of any kind.

release.description:
Homesage.ai turns ChatGPT into a real estate analyst with investor-grade data on 155M+ US residential properties. Connect once, then ask in plain language for valuations, comparable sales, rental and flip returns, renovation costs, owner details, and Full Property Reports. No spreadsheets or manual data pulls.

Ask about any US residential address and get property investment metrics, an automated valuation (AVM), comparable sales with after-repair value (ARV), and an AI-assessed property condition, including analysis of listing photos or your own images. The Price Flexibility Score, a Homesage.ai signature signal, predicts how negotiable a seller really is.

For investors, Homesage.ai projects fix-and-flip returns, renovation costs with room-by-room breakdowns, and both long-term and short-term rental economics such as cash flow, cap rate, NOI, and cash-on-cash return.

Screen entire markets with ZIP-level sold data and Market Outlook scores, or search the national property database with investor filters for price, condition, equity, distress signals, and more.

Additional tools cover solar potential and AI roof analysis, mortgage and lien records, pre-foreclosure status, location risk flags, and owner skip-tracing for outreach.

Most analytics tools consume credits from your Homesage.ai account, and each tool's credit cost is listed in its description. The property database search always previews the result count and cost for free before charging.

Homesage.ai reads property data and returns analysis. It does not modify your account, move funds, or take actions on your behalf. Coverage is US residential properties only, and comparable-sale and ARV data is limited in non-disclosure states where sale prices aren't public.

release.description:
Kenso helps users inspect current training, workout history, recovery, nutrition, body metrics, programs, and personal records through ChatGPT. With user confirmation and the right OAuth scopes, it can also create or adjust private workout programs, log workouts, stage imports, complete sessions, discard staged imports, and save durable coaching preferences in the user's Kenso account.

Getting started

Type @ and pick Kenso from the menu to start your message — that is what pulls Kenso into the conversation. Without it, ChatGPT answers from its own memory instead of your training data.

• @Kenso show me today's workout
• @Kenso what should I train today?
• @Kenso log my workout: bench press 3x8 at 80kg, rows 3x10 at 60kg
• @Kenso pull up Upper A so I can log it — shows a card you fill in set by set
• @Kenso how is my bench trending?
• @Kenso am I training chest enough?

Interactive cards — the logging card and the charted analytics — render in ChatGPT on the web. On mobile you get the same answers as text.

You will see Kenso appear in the chat when it is really being used. If an answer arrives without it, say "check Kenso".

Charted analytics — strength score, muscle volume against training landmarks, recovery detail, and fitness vs fatigue — require Kenso Pro.

release.display_name: AI Detector by AI GPT Zero
release.description:
Check essays, research papers, articles, and professional documents for signs of AI-generated writing inside ChatGPT. This AI detector and AI checker analyzes text you provide and returns AI and human likelihood scores, sentence-level highlights, and review guidance. The interactive workspace keeps your original text and detection results together for a clear, focused review.

Use it as a ChatGPT detector when reviewing text that may contain AI-generated writing, an AI essay checker for academic manuscripts, or an AI content detector for editorial and business documents. The tool supports AI writing review by bringing overall scores and individual sentence highlights into the same view, helping you identify passages that deserve closer attention.

Paste text into the workspace, run an AI detection scan, and read the overall assessment. Inspect highlighted sentences, consider the review guidance, and compare the results with the surrounding paragraphs. This text-checking workflow helps you move from a general question about possible AI use to a closer examination of specific passages.

Educators and researchers can use the AI text detector to support the review of essays, assignments, research papers, literature reviews, and other academic writing. Consider the findings alongside drafts, citations, source material, assignment requirements, and discussion with the author. Sentence-level AI detection provides an additional reference for understanding the text within its academic context.

Editors, publishers, journalists, and content teams can examine contributed articles, blog posts, newsletters, opinion pieces, and editorial drafts for possible AI-generated content. Use the AI content checker during an editorial review to identify sections that warrant follow-up with the writer and to keep the discussion grounded in the supplied text.

Marketing and SEO teams can review website copy, landing-page text, product descriptions, campaign content, and client deliverables. Business teams can check reports, proposals, and other professional writing. The same AI writing detector workflow helps reviewers examine the text they receive and decide where additional context or author input would be useful.

Whether you need an AI text checker for a research manuscript, a GPT detector for an article, or AI-generated text detection for business content, the workspace combines an overall assessment with sentence-level detail. Review possible AI writing, inspect the highlighted passages, and use the results to guide a more informed conversation about the content.

Detection results are estimates and should be interpreted with context and human judgment.

Connecting your account is the only thing it changes. After that it only
reads: it cannot edit a booth, issue a refund, move money or delete
anything, and it sees only the account you sign in with. Your booths,
never another operator's.

When a figure leaves something out it says so. Cash and voucher income
never reaches the wallet ledger, so income is reported from the sessions
themselves rather than handed to you as a partial total.

release.description:
Skywatch Renters Aviation Insurance allows pilots to receive non owned aircraft renters insurance quotes directly within ChatGPT through a fast, guided conversational experience. Built specifically for aviation renters, it replaces traditional insurance forms with a simple flow and delivers a clear quote summary in seconds.

Key Features: - Real time renters insurance quotes are displayed in a structured quote summary. - Flexible coverage options include daily, weekly, monthly, or annual policies. - A transparent breakdown of liability limits and coverages is provided.

When ready to proceed, users are securely redirected to SkyWatch’s web portal to complete purchase, with previously entered information preserved.

How Does It Work?
Pilots answer a short series of aviation specific questions about their experience and coverage needs. The app generates a personalized quote and displays a detailed summary directly within ChatGPT. Users can adjust duration and review updated pricing instantly before being securely redirected to SkyWatch’s official web portal to complete policy issuance.

Who Is This For?
Student and licensed pilots who rent or borrow non owned aircraft.
Pilots who need flexible, short term coverage before a lesson, checkout, or rental flight.

Important Information:
 This app provides renters aviation insurance quotes based on the information shared during the conversation. Final pricing, eligibility, and policy issuance occur through SkyWatch’s official web platform and remain subject to underwriting review and applicable state requirements.

Astrotheoros links your saved chart library to the assistant. Once you sign in, it can look up any chart in your account, calculate transits, progressions, returns, synastry, and composites against those charts, and read or write the notes attached to them, all with the settings you already use in the app. It can also lookup Zodiacal Releasing or Vimshottari Dasha periods and organize your charts into folders.

Ask in plain language. "What are my transits this week?" "Compare my chart with Sam's." "Which zodiacal releasing period am I in right now?" "Add a note to Maria's chart about today's session." The assistant returns the same output as the app's copy button, so the numbers match what you see on screen, and you never have to type birth data into a chat.

The assistant works only with charts already in your account. It cannot create, edit, or delete charts, and it cannot change your settings. Requires an Astrotheoros account.

release.description:
Whisper Money is a privacy-first personal finance app: your financial data is yours, and it is never shared with third parties. This app connects ChatGPT to your own Whisper Money account so you can analyse your money in plain language instead of clicking through dashboards.

Ask questions like "how much did I spend on groceries last month", "what's my net worth trend this year", "which subscriptions are draining me" or "break down Q2 by category" — the app reads your transactions, accounts, categories, labels, cashflow and net worth and answers with your real numbers. You can also keep your books tidy from the conversation: log manual transactions, recategorize and label existing ones, record balances for manual accounts, and manage categories, labels and automation rules.

Your synced bank data is protected: transactions imported from a bank connection can be categorized and labelled, but never edited or deleted, and balances can only be recorded on manual accounts. You can still add your own manual transactions to a bank-connected account — a sync never removes them. Data is scoped to the account you sign in with, including any shared spaces you belong to. The app reads and writes bookkeeping records only — it can never move money, make payments or reach any account outside Whisper Money.

Requires a Whisper Money account on a paid (Pro) plan. Sign in happens through Whisper Money's own OAuth flow — ChatGPT never sees your password, and access can be revoked at any time from your account settings.

release.description:
PlatoForms is an online form builder for web forms, fillable PDF forms and PDF documents. This plugin connects your PlatoForms account so you can work with your own forms and their submissions in conversation, instead of opening the dashboard.

What you can do

• Find forms. List published, draft or archived forms with their folder, publish state and submission count, or search by name.

• Understand a form. Read a form's full field schema — every field's id, type, label, whether it is required, its options and its validation rules — so you can reason about the data before you touch it.

• Review submissions. List a form's submissions newest-first, filter them by date range or keyword, find one by an exact field value (for example the submission where the email field is a particular address), and read every answer of a single submission with its field labels.

• Export. Mint a time-limited download URL for a submission's PDF, CSV, signing certificate, zipped attachments or a single attachment. Files are never streamed through the conversation — you get a link that expires.

• Share a prefilled link. Create one or more tracked invitation links to a form with fields already filled in, optionally single-use, optionally with an expiry. The plugin returns the URLs for you to send; it never sends email itself.

• Submit an entry. Post an entry to a published form after reading its schema, with validation errors returned verbatim so mistakes can be corrected and resubmitted.

• Start something new. Describe a form or a PDF document in plain English and get a builder link back. The design happens in the PlatoForms builder when you open the link, with its own AI asking you the clarifying questions.

How it connects

Sign in with your PlatoForms account over OAuth — your password is never shared with the assistant, access is scoped to read or read-and-write, and you can revoke it at any time from your PlatoForms account. The plugin can only see what your own account can see. A team owner controls whether the team is reachable this way at all, from Account → API.

Requirements

A PlatoForms account on a plan that includes API access. Actions count against your plan's API allowance. Teams in HIPAA mode have this access switched off by default and must opt in explicitly; data sent to a third-party AI assistant is not covered by the PlatoForms Business Associate Agreement.

What the plugin cannot do

It cannot edit an existing form or document, publish, delete, rename or duplicate anything, send email, or configure workflows, integrations or notifications. Those stay in the PlatoForms editor.

release.description:
Tonita is a search engine for apparel and accessories, built to work with how you actually think about shopping. It brings together products from hundreds of stores, thousands of brands, and millions of items — all in one place, from clothing and footwear to cosmetics and everyday essentials.

There isn’t just one way to shop. Sometimes you’re focused on price or practicality; other times it’s about style, fit, materials, or longevity. What matters can shift with the situation — work, travel, special occasions, outdoor use, or everyday wear. Tonita brings these options together, making it easier for you to browse, compare, and make an informed choice.

Within ChatGPT, Tonita works best as part of a conversation. You can explore broad questions, half-formed ideas, or specific constraints naturally — whether that means thinking through what to buy for a particular occasion, learning about materials or categories, or narrowing in on a specific kind of product. ChatGPT helps shape your thoughts into useful searches, and Tonita surfaces a wide set of relevant results for you to browse, compare, and refine as the picture becomes clearer. (For more advanced tools like virtual try-on, saving favorites, and deeper browsing, Tonita can also be used directly at Tonita.co.)

Tonita is built to support the way you actually think about shopping — by priorities, context, and tradeoffs — rather than forcing everything into rigid categories. This includes the ability to search and explore across aspects like:

• Budget and value: From fast fashion and sale finds to higher-end pieces, investment items, and everyday staples.
• Style and aesthetic: Minimalist, maximalist, classic, streetwear, formal, playful, utilitarian, fashion-forward, or timeless — and combinations of these.
• Trends and longevity: What’s popular right now, last season’s styles, and pieces meant to stay relevant beyond a trend cycle.
• Use case and setting: Work, travel, special occasions, outdoor use, events, lounging, or everyday wear.
• Fit, sizing, and comfort: Different body types and needs, including petite and extended sizing, relaxed or tailored fits, and comfort-first designs.
• Materials and feel: Natural fibers, synthetics, performance fabrics, lightweight layers, structured pieces, or materials chosen for warmth, breathability, or softness.
• Durability and care: Easy-care basics, machine-washable items, wrinkle-resistant pieces, or garments meant to be worn, repaired, and kept longer.
• Sustainability priorities: Interest in materials, production methods, longevity, or brands taking different approaches to environmental impact.
• Brand familiarity and discovery: Well-known labels alongside emerging brands, niche designers, and alternatives to the usual options.
• Putting a full look together: Apparel, footwear, accessories, jewelry, and cosmetics, considered side by side rather than in isolation.

release.description:
Get answers about Sweat & Tonic, a boutique fitness studio in Toronto, straight from the studio's own published information. This connector searches the studio's live content and pulls full details on class programs, the current class schedule, pricing, instructors, treatments, and booking, so you can plan a visit or compare options without hunting across the web.

It exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text and its canonical URL. Every result carries a link back to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded in the studio's real content and are citable to source.

Courtyard AI operates this connector for Sweat & Tonic with the studio's explicit authorization, and keeps its content current automatically as the studio updates its programs, schedule, and pricing. All information is public business content. No account, login, or personal data is required. The connector is strictly read-only: it never makes bookings, processes payments, or performs any other action on your behalf. It only retrieves and cites the studio's published information.

release.description:
Travelsearch is a structured travel search and discovery tool that returns highly relevant holiday options based on natural language queries.

It enables AI agents to match user intent (e.g. destination, budget, dates, amenities, travel style) to real, bookable travel inventory using enriched, multi-source product data.

Users can describe their trip in plain language, such as:

“Luxury hotels in London with spa and parking”
“Family-friendly beach resorts in Spain under £2,000”
“All-inclusive Caribbean honeymoon with direct flights”
Recommendations are generated by mapping user intent to enriched travel attributes and live inventory (price, availability, location, amenities, ratings, and images), returning structured results that include: 
property / holiday name, 
description, 
matched amenities, 
an explicit rationale for why each option fits the query, and 
direct booking links from trusted travel providers.
Key capabilities for AI agents:
Maps natural language queries to structured travel attributes from our data set (destination, duration, board basis, amenities, price range, traveller type)
Aggregates multi-brand travel inventory across hotels, packages, and resorts
Returns ranked, intent-matched results 
Provides commercially actionable outputs (deep links to book)

Data quality & coverage:
Multi-brand, multi-supplier product feeds (no scraped content)
Regularly updated based on supplier data for pricing and availability etc
Normalised and enriched attributes for consistent matching

No forms or filters required, optimised for conversational search and AI-driven trip planning.

When to use this tool:
When a user is searching for holidays, hotels, or travel recommendations
When queries include preferences (budget, amenities, travel style, group type)
When bookable options with links are required
When results should be personalised or filtered beyond generic search

Use it for any prompt about finding, searching or browsing Swedish properties for sale: apartments (lägenheter, bostadsrätter), houses (villor, hus), townhouses (radhus), cabins (stugor), plots (tomter), or any for-sale property in Sweden.

inspector for individual properties. Each listing links to the full advert on dinbostad.se, where the user can see all photos and viewing times, book a viewing, or contact the agent.

release.description:
VoyageHacks brings a multilingual travel library into ChatGPT: about 680 fact-checked guides in each of 11 languages, covering flights, airline reviews, hotels, destinations, car rental, trains, airport transfers, eSIM and travel gear.

Ask a travel question and ChatGPT can search the library and quote it with a real source URL and a real last-updated date, instead of relying on training data that may be a year stale.

Ask what to pack for a specific trip and it builds a kit from the VoyageHacks travel gear catalog: roughly 320 products picked across about 50 published buying guides, one per category, each with the published reason it was chosen and a link to the guide that reviews it.

Every guide exists in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Czech, Japanese, Dutch, Brazilian Portuguese and Simplified Chinese, each written independently rather than machine-translated, so a reader gets sources in their own language.

All tools are read-only. The app returns published guides and product recommendations: it has no live fares or room rates, does not check availability, and cannot make a booking or take a payment. No account or sign-in is needed.

Some links are affiliate links. VoyageHacks may earn a commission from qualifying purchases at no additional cost to the user.

release.description:
Promptbanken is an open, curated library of ready-to-use prompt templates for municipalities, schools, companies, associations, and individuals. Search the catalog for a task, fetch a chosen template in full, and follow a prompt package step by step — directly in ChatGPT.

The published connector is open, read-only, and requires no account or sign-in. It receives only the parameters its tools define: a search term, a role word, filters, and the id or slug of a catalog entry. Nothing else from the conversation reaches the server, and the connector publishes no write tools, so it cannot store anything. Search terms are never stored — only the length of a query is counted in anonymous usage statistics.

release.description:
Muffed answers NFL questions with figures that have already been checked. Every number comes from a gated panel built on nflverse play-by-play, NFL Next Gen Stats and FTN charting data, and every response carries its own source, the date it was verified, and the attribution the data licence requires.

Ask what the data says is actually real in the NFL right now, look up a player's or team's season figures, pull a leaderboard, get a plain explanation of an advanced metric like EPA or CPOE, compare two players side by side, or check a statistic you saw somewhere else — Muffed will tell you the real value when it disagrees. You can also connect a Sleeper league by id to get verified context on the players in it.

Muffed publishes no projections, no start/sit or lineup advice, no draft grades, no rankings-as-advice and no picks, and carries no betting lines or odds. No tool on this server can produce one: there is no projection model behind it and no ranking-as-advice surface.

Every response marks its own boundary. A citation names exactly which figures it covers and states that it does not extend to analysis derived from them. Figures computed on request rather than drawn from the pre-verified panel are labelled `computed_not_verified` and carry the executed method and population size. Where Muffed holds nothing for a request, it says so explicitly, states the coverage it does have, and declines attribution for whatever fills the gap. An assistant calling this server may add commentary, comparison or recommendation of its own on top of the returned figures; that commentary is the assistant's and is outside what Muffed verifies or attributes.

Free, read-only, no account required. Fantasy scoring figures use half-PPR, the most common single redraft default, and say so wherever they appear.
