release.description:
Keenable SELECT answers a research question with one query instead of ten page reads.

Ordinary web search hands the model a list of links and leaves the reading, the extraction and the de-duplication to it. SELECT does that work inside the search. The model writes one read-only SQL statement in a DuckDB dialect; the server runs the searches in parallel, fetches the pages, pulls out the fields the query asks for with a per-row model call, removes duplicates, and returns a table.

One query can cover more than a thousand pages, filter them with ordinary SQL at no extra cost, and group them into the answer. The rows arrive as a table, not as a wall of page text, so the answer is grounded in a lot more sources than the context could hold.

Every result is saved as a result set for 30 days, so the next question can be asked of the same pages without searching again. A finished table can be published as a single HTML report, charts and all, at a link you can hand to someone.

Use it for a survey, a comparison or a ranking across many sources. It is not the tool for a quick look at one page: a query runs from seconds to minutes, because it really does search, fetch and read.

Connect your Keenable account once to enable it. Searching and fetching bill that account.

release.description:
Socra Cortex helps people and teams stop repeating the same preferences, requirements, and decisions to ChatGPT and Codex. It keeps that knowledge and its reasons in a single source of truth that agents can retrieve before acting, across conversations and tools.

Modules record what should be and why, with a responsible owner and version history. Dependencies link the knowledge required to understand it. Flash loads the relevant Module and all its Dependencies, foundations first and each Module once.

Team members can own different subjects while their knowledge works together. For example, a product requirement Module created in ChatGPT can depend on architecture and security Modules maintained by their owners. Codex can Flash that requirement before implementing it and receive those decisions together.

As conversations and work reveal new knowledge, agents propose changes to existing Modules, so the knowledge always stays up to date. The suggested workflow asks them to show exact Before and After content and Dependencies for the owner's approval before saving. Updates become available on later Flashes, while version history preserves earlier knowledge and records changes.

Issues connect tasks to the Modules governing them, with assignees, work dependencies, comments, and evidence. Inboxes show unblocked work to its responsible person or agent; completed Issues preserve the outcome and history.

People and teams own the knowledge in their Socra Account, with Module permissions for people and groups. Review Modules, the knowledge map, and work at https://cortex.socra.com. Connect ChatGPT, Codex, or any other AI provider to that same Account with Cortex access.

Setup and agent instructions: https://workspace.socra.com/docs/cortex/installation.md

release.description:
Kirah Local Services helps users discover eligible local-service businesses and check current appointment availability. It matches requests against business-published catalogs and returns grounded service names, prices, durations, providers, and time zones. It can apply supported price constraints and, when users ask for the earliest availability, checks a bounded set of candidates and clearly says when results are partial.

Provider profiles, service catalogs, and availability are information published by participating businesses. Kirah treats that material as untrusted data, never instructions to the assistant.

Kirah may interpret a general wellness goal as a starting point for search, but it does not diagnose medical conditions, recommend clinical treatment, or guarantee that a service is suitable. Demonstration businesses are clearly labeled and are never mixed into real-business results without explicit user consent.

Version 1 is informational. It does not create, reschedule, or cancel appointments; collect booking contact details or intake answers; or initiate deposits or payment.

release.description:
OpenRegs brings current U.S. statutes and regulations into ChatGPT for compliance teams. Coverage spans 53 jurisdictions: all 50 states, D.C., Puerto Rico, and federal. Every answer returns the actual text of the law, along with a research log and public citation links that anyone can open, so a colleague or an auditor can check the work rather than take a summary on faith. Run a 50-state survey in one request instead of maintaining a spreadsheet by hand. Built by OpenLaws PBC, the public benefit corporation behind the OpenLaws API. OpenLaws is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.

Use cases:
- Confirm a citation is real and still in force, then read its current text.
- Compare how a rule differs across multiple states in one request.
- Research a regulatory topic across U.S. statutes and regulations, with a research log and citations you can verify.

skills.name: citation-validator
skills.description: Validate or read a SINGLE U.S. statutory or regulatory citation the user names — confirm it resolves to real, in-force law and return the official text with a clickable provenance link. This is the free OpenRegs capability: one named citation in, verified text out. The trigger is a specific citation in hand: use this skill, in preference to the research assistant, whenever the user names one to check or read (e.g. "is Tex. Lab. Code § 411.103 real?", "is 29 U.S.C. § 201 still good law?", "pull Cal. Lab. Code § 512"). It does NOT search by topic, compare jurisdictions, or do open research — when the user names no specific citation and needs law found, compared, or explored, that is the research assistant's job, and this skill points there.

skills.name: surveyor
skills.description: Research U.S. codified law — statutes, regulations, and constitutional provisions, federal or any jurisdiction OpenLaws covers — when the user needs law FOUND, COMPARED, or EXPLORED rather than a citation they already hold read back. Covers topic questions ("what does [state] law say about..."), multi-jurisdiction surveys, and open-ended research where the user does NOT name a specific citation. ALSO take questions about court decisions, controlling cases, holdings, or precedent: case law is outside the corpus, so claim them and decline with discipline — name the boundary, cite the governing statute, point to case-law sources — rather than leave them to an unverified answer. Same for pending rule changes or past-date rules. If the user hands you one named citation to confirm or read back, that is citation-validator's job. Ground every claim in the OpenRegs MCP tools FIRST (never training data; web only via the official-source exception), produce a research log, and refuse when a claim can't be grounded.

•  Access member-facing guides and resources published in your network.

This plugin is read-only today: it's built for retrieving and analyzing data, not making changes to your Spacebring account. Future updates will expand coverage further and eventually support write actions (like updating records or triggering workflows) directly from ChatGPT.

release.description:
Medeloop Grants helps researchers and program teams move from “What should we apply for?” to a credible first draft without switching tools or starting from scratch.
Inside ChatGPT, it combines curated grant data, your professional context, and purpose-built drafting workflows into a single experience. You can ask for relevant funding opportunities, quickly understand whether you’re a good fit, and begin drafting a proposal in the same conversation.
What makes it useful in practice is how the pieces connect. Instead of returning a long list of generic results, Medeloop matches grants to your background and research focus, helping you prioritize opportunities that are actually feasible. It also surfaces key constraints like eligibility and deadlines early, so you spend less time chasing grants that are unlikely to work.
When you’re ready to write, the platform guides you through structured inputs and generates a solid first-pass draft that you can refine. The drafting process builds on the same context used for discovery, so you don’t have to repeat yourself or reframe your work each time.
People tend to value Medeloop Grants because it reduces the overhead around grant work. It helps them focus on the substance of their research instead of navigating fragmented tools, reformatting information, or second-guessing fit. Over time, as it learns from your inputs and past work, it becomes more tailored to how you search and write.
The result is a more continuous workflow from discovery to draft, with less friction and fewer wasted cycles.

release.description:
magicplan is a field app for measuring, documenting, and estimating on site, widely used in property restoration, insurance, and construction. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to a magicplan workspace, so you can review and reason over project data directly in the conversation.

Once connected, ChatGPT can:
- List and open projects, and read the field data captured on each floor plan
- Retrieve measured areas and volumes, broken down by floor and room
- Read the custom forms filled out on site, and the drying history recorded by moisture instruments
- Browse project photos and files, matched to the part of the building they document
- Open estimates down to individual line items and cost totals

A connection is authenticated at the workspace level with your magicplan Customer ID and API key, and acts on behalf of that whole workspace. The connector is read-only: it never creates, changes, or deletes anything in magicplan, and your API key is never shared with ChatGPT.

Typical uses: preparing a scope of work from a restoration project, checking which rooms still need documentation, summarizing an estimate, or answering questions about a plan's measurements.

release.description:
Amok gives ChatGPT direct access to Cambodia's banking, fintech, and technology regulation — as verbatim evidence from official sources, never paraphrased.

Ask about bank licensing and prudential rules, technology risk management, liquidity risk, payment systems and Bakong, AML/CFT, or fintech policy. Amok searches a corpus built from Cambodia's official sources — the National Bank of Cambodia's laws, prakas, and guidelines, and the Securities and Exchange Regulator of Cambodia — and returns the exact provisions: precise Article citations, current validity, and an official source link on every result so you can verify the original wording yourself. When something is missing from the corpus, Amok says so instead of guessing.

The corpus is in English. Ask in any language — ChatGPT translates and answers grounded in the official text. Results support research and compliance work; they are not a substitute for legal counsel. Free, no account needed.

release.description:
Vocaneo connects ChatGPT to the French careers and training reference data: over 1,000 job profiles (missions, skills, salaries, labour-market tension, AI exposure), RNCP diplomas and certifications, and more than 135,000 training programmes with the establishments that deliver them across France.

Ask career questions in plain language: « how do I become a nurse in Lyon? », « I am a developer, which jobs could I move to? », « which jobs are hiring without long studies? ». ChatGPT queries the reference data, cross-references jobs, entry routes, training programmes and providers, and cites the matching public vocaneo.com page for every answer.

The connector is read-only, with no account and no configuration: the data served is the public data of vocaneo.com. It collects nothing and gives no individualised advice — it serves verifiable facts from the French national reference data (ROME 4.0, RNCP), kept continuously up to date.

Vocaneo is a French mission-driven company (SAS, ESUS-accredited) building career guidance tools on open data and psychometric assessment.

release.description:
Quotient is an AI-native platform and intelligent agent in one; built to plan and execute campaigns across email, social, blog, and events, without the fragmented tools you've outgrown.

At its core, Quotient is an AI demand marketing platform. It brings everything that attracts customers: blogs, social posts, email, webinars and events, and brand-building, into one integrated workspace. You work with Quotient like a coworker. Describe what you want in plain English, and it takes it from there.

Campaigns organize your marketing around a central goal, like a feature launch or event. Each is a coordinated set of tasks and deliverables moving through a clear workflow. Deliverables are the real assets Quotient creates and ships: blog posts, email broadcasts, marketing events, automated flows, and social posts for X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Ask Quotient to build a campaign end to end: it writes the brief, breaks the work into tasks, sets the timeline, and produces each deliverable.

Quotient gets smarter over time, drawing on a Knowledge Store of brand information, recording memories of your preferences, and using tools to search the web and pull from your audience of people and companies.

The result is a single platform where strategy, content, and execution live together, replacing the patchwork of disconnected marketing tools with one AI that plans, writes, and ships.

release.description:
**Subtext is session replay built for agents instead of humans.**

Connect Subtext, and your Codex agents can open real production sessions and investigate them directly—no scrubbing a timeline, no video to watch.

Hand your agent a Subtext link from wherever it already connects—a Sentry issue, a Linear ticket, a support thread, a PR—and it uses Agentic Session Review to jump to the right moment, inspect screenshots and accessibility trees, diff DOM state, and read console and network activity to find the root cause. Then it files the fix or hands you the finding. You review the answer, not the replay.

What your agent gets:
* **Session tools it calls directly**: open a session, jump to a moment, inspect and compare state—purpose-built so agents traverse dense session data efficiently, with fewer tokens than pointing a general agent at raw replay.
* **Best-in-class capture from Fullstory**: Fullcapture behavior, pixel-perfect screenshots on demand, DOM diffs, and windowed console and network context.
* **Privacy built for production**: precision tools for agents to mask or exclude sensitive fields, plus agent-friendly DLP scanning tools over MCP.
* **Cost-effective**: Capture every session without sampling and never miss a critical user experience or bug report. Agents review the ones that matter most.

Works with Codex or any MCP-compatible agent. Code-first install, self-serve signup, generous free tier, usage-based pricing. Bring your own agent harness—Subtext is the session context it was missing.

release.description:
Hardline MCP connects your notes from your phone calls and site meetings to ChatGPT.

Use this MCP when you are looking to connect real time data from the jobsite into your tools and workflows.
- Writing the daily log: Pull the decisions, commitments, and delivery updates from today's calls straight into the log, instead of backfilling from memory hours later.
- Drafting an RFI or change order: Pull the field context behind it. What the architect approved, what the sub flagged, what changed on the call, all in the draft.
- Settling a "you told me to" dispute: Find who committed to what and when, with the exact call it came from. The contemporaneous record, on demand.
- Prepping an OAC or your three-week look-ahead: Combine what came up across the week's calls with your other project docs so nothing walks out the door.

How it works:
Your assistant can search your captured calls and site notes by project, person, trade, or timeframe, then cite the exact call in its answer. No more digging through your phone log to find "what the sub agreed to" or "when we approved that change."

The difference:
Instead of a messy notebook or storing all the important to-dos in your head, Hardline captures the phone calls you're already making, keeps the transcript (not the audio)  and turns them into structured records that you can use in all your workflows.

release.display_name: OPEN - what is open right now
release.description:
OPEN answers one question: is this business open right now, and until when.

Opening hours tell you how a place usually is. OPEN tells you what is true at this moment, because the answer comes from the business owner, who updates it from their phone. A shop that closed early today says so. A place with no fresh information reads UNKNOWN, and UNKNOWN is never presented as CLOSED.

Ask in plain language - "what is open near Machane Yehuda right now?", "find a coffee shop that stays open at least another hour" - and the answer arrives with an interactive map inside the conversation. Service professionals are covered too: plumbers, electricians, handymen and locksmiths report whether they are available for work right now.

Four read-only tools: open_now, search_businesses, get_business and list_categories. No sign-in, no writes, no personal data, no advertising.

Coverage: OPEN is in pilot in Jerusalem, Israel, and the catalogue grows through in-person recruitment of business owners. A query about another city will return little or nothing. Hebrew and English.

release.description:
Tripuck is a flight meta-search and trip-planning service. This connector
lets you search live flight prices, explore a route's cheapest days of the
month, browse popular destinations from any origin city, and open full
segment / baggage details for any result — all without leaving the chat.

Tripuck's signature feature is **Meeting Point**: given 2-5 travelers flying
from different cities, it computes the cheapest and fairest common
destination, along with a per-person price breakdown and a fairness score.
It's ideal for coordinating trips where the group is spread across several
countries.

Every result deep-links back to tripuck.com for booking review and
checkout. The connector itself is read-only — it does not book, charge,
modify accounts, or hold any user payment information.

Supported user languages: Turkish, English, Arabic, Azerbaijani, German,
Georgian, and Uzbek. The tool infers the user's language from the
conversation and returns responses in that language, including right-to-
left layout for Arabic.

release.description:
WisdomAI is the enterprise data harness inside ChatGPT, for the complex analytical questions where the answer has to be deterministic, traceable, and consistent.

Connectors provide access. Catalogs and semantic layers provide definitions. The WisdomAI harness applies both at runtime by selecting the right context for each question, enforcing row- and column-level security for the person asking, optimizing execution for the underlying platform, verifying results, and repairing failed queries.

Business context strengthens continuously as WisdomAI learns from documents, query logs, catalogs, semantic layers, dbt, and BI metadata, proactively identifies where it lacked sufficient context, and routes proposed changes through expert review and versioning. Corrections become governed organizational knowledge rather than one-time fixes buried in individual conversations.

WisdomAI works across data platforms, sources, and deployment environments, including fully on-premises for regulated data that cannot leave your environment. The harness, the context, and query execution stay behind your firewall; only the answer crosses.

Every answer is grounded in governed definitions, enterprise data, and visible sources making it trustworthy enough to run your business on.

Use WisdomAI in ChatGPT to:
- Ask questions of governed business data: "How did Q3 net revenue track against plan in EMEA?"
- Follow up in the same line of analysis: "Break that down by segment and show the last 4 quarters"
- Investigate an open-ended question end to end: "We missed plan in EMEA last quarter. What drove it, which segments and accounts moved most, and what should we watch going into Q4?"
- Trace an answer to its definitions and sources: "Which definition of net revenue was used, and what data did it come from?"
- See what's available to you: "What data do I have access to, and which metrics are defined for finance?"

release.description:
Beglaubigt sets up a German company — a GmbH or UG (haftungsbeschränkt) — directly in the conversation. Tell the assistant you want to incorporate and it collects the details one step at a time: company name and purpose, share capital, the shareholder(s) and managing director, and how you'd like to notarize. When everything's ready it returns a secure checkout link you open in your browser — the assistant never processes payment itself.

On the back end, Beglaubigt coordinates the notarization, the commercial-register (Handelsregister) filing, and your formation documents, so you can start a German company without assembling the paperwork yourself. It's built for founders in Germany and for international entrepreneurs incorporating there.

Currently supports GmbH and UG formation. After the checkout link, you complete payment and your notary appointment through Beglaubigt.

release.description:
This plugin exposes a public register of measured conduct for MCP servers.

Five conditions are measured on a schedule: the server speaks MCP, it publishes an A2A agent card, it declares who pays it, identical input returns identical output, and the verdict itself can be recomputed by a third party. A condition that could not be measured is recorded as not measured. It is never counted as a pass, and that rule is not relaxed for the operator of the register.

The register does not rank servers. It does not recommend one server over another. It returns what was measured, when it was measured, and the SHA-256 of the record so that the reading can be checked by someone who does not trust the party that issued it.

An endpoint that is absent from the register has simply never been measured here. Absence is reported as absence and is not a negative verdict.

Determinism is not measured unless the owner of the checked server has recorded consent, because measuring it requires executing a tool on someone else's server.

Free, read only, no account and no key. The register is a build artefact of a scheduled script with no editorial step, and it is archived with a DOI so a citation survives the repository moving.

release.description:
Duckhub QR Menu is restaurant software that digitizes dining with QR code menus and integrated ordering. Diners scan codes to view digital menus on their phones without apps or paper. An AI assistant generates dish descriptions, translates menus into 14 languages, and creates item images. Reservations are managed via the menu or apps like WhatsApp, with confirmations handled through a dashboard. Online ordering lets restaurants create websites with menus and ordering features. Table ordering allows diners to scan QR codes, select items, and send orders to the kitchen with table identification. Delivery management and staff access controls are included. Analytics track trends and peak hours, while customization options include templates, fonts, and logos. Smart promotions automate discounts based on times or days.

With this plugin, a restaurant owner connects their Duckhub venue to ChatGPT and manages it by conversation: read the current draft menu, create or edit categories, dishes, prices, ingredients and option groups, upload dish photos, translate the menu into any enabled language, adjust venue info, working hours, design and ordering settings, manage tables and their QR links, run promotions and banners, then publish the menu live (or roll a bad publish back). Paid plans can also read guest orders and move them through their lifecycle. Every change is scoped to the single venue the owner authorized, is written to a draft first, and only becomes visible to guests after an explicit publish.

release.description:
Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP supports AI-driven sales, marketing, and revenue operations by providing GenAI-ready data, analytics, and insights to inform go-to-market execution. It brings together firmographic, ownership, relationship, and market datasets into a unified intelligence layer to help teams identify opportunities, prioritize accounts, and support more effective customer engagement. 
 
The solution combines comprehensive Moody’s entity intelligence, including global company profiles, hierarchies, and ownership linkages, with augmented signals such as news, market activity, and risk indicators. This integrated view helps organizations gain additional visibility into total addressable markets, identify whitespace opportunities, and align sales and marketing strategies around high-value prospects. 
 
By bringing together structured company data and contextual insights into a single interface, Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP helps streamline data-to-insight workflows and supports improvements in targeting precision, pipeline quality, and revenue outcomes. 
 
Data includes: 
- Global company firmographics and identifiers 
- Corporate hierarchies and ownership structures 
- Industry classifications and segmentation 
- Financial indicators and company scale metrics 
- News, market signals, and company events 
- Risk indicators and early warning signals 
- Economic data and research 

 Use Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP for: 
- GTM Planning – define and size target markets with comprehensive company coverage  
- Account Prioritization – identify and prioritize high-value prospects and customers and support more sophisticated opportunity scoring by combining company-level data with market-level indicators. 
- Territory Design – support geographic and account planning by highlighting industries, regions or countries with stronger growth prospects 
- Pipeline Acceleration – surface in-market signals and help support timely engagement based on macroeconomic trends, investment activity, hiring trends or sector-level forecasts 
- Cross-Sell & Upsell – help identify whitespace within existing customer portfolios and support AI-generated account briefs that incorporate industry outlooks, economic scenarios, and strategic talking points 
- CRM Enrichment – enrich account and lead records with company data and insights 
- Marketing Segmentation – develop data-driven audience segments using company, market, and relationship insights

Data247 brings real-time contact and identity data into ChatGPT, for identifying and verifying contact information,  fraudulent activity, TCPA compliance, and more. 
 
Ask in plain language and ChatGPT runs the lookup for you: confirm whether a phone line is active and what carrier and line type it is, check whether an email is deliverable, validate a postal address, or find the person behind a phone or email. It's handy for keeping a CRM clean, validating and enriching leads before outreach, staying compliant with calling rules, and reviewing flagged accounts.

release.description:
Agnic Gifts buys one real, physical gift and ships it — inside the conversation you are already having.

Tell ChatGPT who the gift is for and what you want to spend. It searches vetted shops in the US, UK, Canada and Australia and comes back with real items that are in stock, within budget and shippable to your address, not links to go and read later.

Two ways to use it.

Pick your own: see the candidates named and priced, ask about any of them — delivery cost, materials, size, whether it is still in stock — and choose the one you want.

Or be surprised: ChatGPT sees the options as anonymous descriptions with no brand, no product name and no shop attached. It ranks its top three, and the item stays sealed until it arrives at your door. You approve the spend without knowing what it is, then reveal it when it lands.

No purchase happens from a chat message. Every buy stops at a link to Agnic's own site, where you approve it with your passkey against a spending limit you signed in advance. That limit is enforced in code and cryptography rather than by instruction, so a £20 limit cannot become a £40 purchase no matter what is typed into the chat. Your card never enters the conversation: it is held in a PCI DSS certified vault and the model never sees a number.

Agnic never holds your money. The shop is the seller, the shop ships the order, and returns and refunds go through the shop under its own policy.

Physical goods only, one gift at a time, and any gift that has not been bought yet can be cancelled.

release.description:
Qualisend verifies email addresses and cleans lists so your messages reach real inboxes and bounces stay low. Ask it to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list — you get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable- and role-address detection.

It runs the full check: syntax, domain and mail server (MX), disposable and role detection, catch-all, and a real mailbox (SMTP) check. Large lists run in the background and return a result summary you can review.

On the Pro plan it also checks whether a sending domain is set up correctly (SPF/DMARC), generates the DNS records you need (SPF, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS), and analyzes raw email headers to diagnose deliverability. With the Blacklist Monitoring add-on it can check whether a domain or IP is on major blacklists.

Each verification uses one Qualisend credit, and you connect your own Qualisend account.

release.description:
Dial in better espresso, one informed adjustment at a time.
Set up your beans, grinder, espresso machine, and scale once. After each shot, log the dose, yield, brew time, and how it tasted. ShotPulled considers the full context—including the coffee’s age and the way your grinder is calibrated—then recommends the single most useful adjustment for your next shot and explains why.
ShotPulled also keeps your coffee inventory accurate automatically. Every logged dose is deducted from the bag, so you can see the grams remaining and an estimate of how many shots are left based on the dose you actually use. It tracks the bag’s peak window too, showing how many peak days remain and the date that window ends.
When a recipe works, lock it in and return to it anytime. ShotPulled supports grinder settings across clicks, numbered collars, compound ring positions such as 1.2.2, and named settings, with built-in specifications for 67 grinders, 124 espresso machines, and 24 scales.
Your ShotPulled account stays in sync across ChatGPT, the web dashboard, and the iPhone app. Register a bag here, and it’s already waiting on your phone when you’re ready to pull your next shot.

Your assistant does the thinking. Alizé gives it the real law to think on.

release.description:
Structured decision-making using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) , a proven framework for comparing options and resolving trade-offs.

Whether you're evaluating cars, comparing job offers, choosing a vendor, or weighing any set of alternatives, decisionpoint.io guides you through the process step by step. You define the goal, identify the factors that matter, list your options, and then compare them two at a time. AHP derives ranked results from your comparisons, showing which option best matches your priorities and why.

The app provides:
- A visual overview of your decision structure
- An interactive comparison interface within the conversation
- Ranked results with scores and criteria weights
- Consistency analysis to identify contradictory judgments

Decisions are saved to your decisionpoint.io account and can be revisited, refined, or continued at any time.

release.description:
GadgetOS is the retail-management system a Bangladeshi phone, laptop and electronics shop runs on — point of sale, stock by IMEI and serial number, a warranty and repair desk, suppliers, and VAT-compliant receipts. This connector gives the owner and staff of one shop a plain-language way into their own live records.

Ask what sold this month and get the real figure. Ask what is running out and get the items below their reorder level with a suggested quantity. Ask about one IMEI and get that exact handset: in stock or sold, its cost and its price, when it arrived and when it left, and the warranty left on it. Ask what is on the repair desk and get every claim with its status, customer, device, days open and estimate. Ask whether a customer's phone is still under warranty and get the determination from the sale date — or, where no warranty period was ever recorded, that fact stated plainly instead of a guess.

With the owner's opt-in it also writes: ring up a sale — a real invoice with a receipt number that takes the payment and moves stock (the assistant confirms the devices and the amount with the owner first; voiding or refunding a sale stays in the app, behind a manager PIN); open or close a branch's cash drawer against the cash counted; create a device, change a price, a rack location or a reorder level; add a product photo through a single-use upload link, or arrange and remove product photos; receive stock or one serialized unit; log an expense; add a supplier; raise a draft purchase order; record a customer's payment against what they already owe; book a device in for repair; and move a claim along to inspecting, estimate pending, approved, repairing, ready or delivered.

Only two actions can reach anyone outside the shop, and only if the shop has switched SMS on (it is off by default): a sale that names a customer can send that customer one receipt SMS, and a claim moved to ready or delivered can send the claim's customer one SMS. No tool accepts a phone number or message text from the chat.

It searches a shared reference catalog of phones, laptops and accessories, so adding a product inherits the right brand, category, specifications and official image rather than starting from a blank row.

Everything is scoped to the single shop the signed-in user belongs to. There is no parameter on any tool that could reach another business's data.

Rejecting or refunding a warranty claim needs a manager PIN, and there is no tool for it — that stays in the app on purpose.

Amounts are in Bangladeshi Taka, held as integer paisa. Dates are Asia/Dhaka. Bangla and English both work.

skills.name: sql-optimization
skills.description:
**Required reading before writing or running any SQL.** Patterns for Snowflake
query performance and chain-specific pitfalls.

Covers: default time ranges, partition-pruning rules, CTE filtering, `QUALIFY`
for dedup, `UNION ALL` over `UNION`, `APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT` for exploration,
pre-aggregated `*.metrics.*` tables vs raw aggregation, EVM address lowercasing
(and when not to), per-chain vs `crosschain.*` tables, verifying guessed
categorical filter values with `SELECT DISTINCT`, and Solana voting/non-voting
optimized views.

Call `get_skill(name="sql-optimization")` before writing SQL —
especially for large tables, long time ranges, or crosschain queries.

release.description:
Ask about your product analytics, and get answers you can verify.

Fullstory MCP connects Codex and ChatGPT to your product's behavioral data. Ask how many users adopted a feature, where checkout is leaking, or whether yesterday's release broke something, and Codex and ChatGPT build the segment, computes the metric, and explains the result with a link back to Fullstory.

Analytics connectors can give you numbers. Fullstory shows you what happened. Metrics unpack into real session replay, so "conversion dropped 12%" becomes "the coupon field errors for logged-out users."

And because Fullstory autocaptures clicks, page views, errors, and frustration signals, many questions need no instrumentation at all. Ask about rage clicks on pricing or errors in checkout without shipping a single event.

What Codex and ChatGPT can do:
(1) Build and save segments and metrics.
Describe the users or behavior you care about in your own words; Codex and ChatGPT create segments or metrics in Fullstory where your whole team can reuse it.

(2) Compute on demand.
 Counts, rates, trends, and breakdowns by device, browser, geography, or user property, over any time window.

(3) Speak your product's language. 
Codex and ChatGPT discover your pages, named elements, and defined events, so questions map to your real product vocabulary instead of guessed selectors.

(4) Analyze conversion.
Read your saved funnels and measure where users drop and why.

(5) Back every number with sessions.
Retrieve the sessions and events behind any metric, including frustration signals like rage clicks and dead clicks.

(6) Read sessions at scale.
Ask Codex and ChatGPT to review dozens of sessions behind a drop-off or an alert and report the patterns, including failures that never reached your error tracker.

Teams use it to let PMs, support, and engineers self-serve answers that used to queue behind an analyst, and to settle "why did this number move?" with evidence instead of theories.

release.description:
O OnePro conecta sua conta ETF1 ao ChatGPT e dá acesso à mesma base de dados e
aos mesmos motores de análise que você usa na plataforma.

Consulta de ativos: fichas completas de ETFs brasileiros e globais, ações, BDRs,
FIIs, fundos CVM, debêntures, renda fixa pública e privada e índices,  custos,
patrimônio líquido, retornos históricos, alocação e composição. Screener com
filtros por classe, look-through da carteira de ETFs (inclusive ETFs de ETFs) e
lookup reverso ("quais ETFs carregam NVDA?").

Análise de carteira: seus portfólios salvos no OnePro, ou uma carteira informada
na conversa, avaliados por retorno, volatilidade, Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown
máximo, tempo de recuperação e correlação, contra benchmarks como CDI, IBOV,
IFIX, IMA-B e S&P 500. Inclui ranking entre carteiras, consistência em janelas
móveis de 10 anos e heatmap de CAGR real por ano inicial.

Motores de simulação: fronteira eficiente e carteira de máximo Sharpe;
probabilidade de atingir uma meta de patrimônio (goal-based investing); projeção
prospectiva de patrimônio por Monte Carlo; e plano de retirada da aposentadoria
com taxa segura (SWR), taxa perpétua (PWR) e estratégias clássico,
rebalanceado, bucket e dynamic spending com guardrails.

Todos os resultados vêm de um snapshot diário de dados, com a versão do dado
declarada em cada resposta, e os motores raciocinam em termos reais (R$ de hoje e dólar).
O conector é somente leitura: nenhuma operação altera dados da sua conta, e
nenhuma ordem de compra ou venda é executada. As análises são informativas e não
constituem recomendação de investimento.

Requer assinatura ativa do OnePro em etf1.com.br.

release.description:
Genesys gives your AI a causal memory graph — not a list of remembered facts, but a living network where every memory is a node, every relationship is a typed causal edge, and every retrieval can be explained. Ask why a memory surfaced and Genesys shows its relevance score, causal connectivity, and reactivation history. Trace how memories connect and follow full causal chains from decision to consequence.

Your memory graph is yours: it lives outside any single AI vendor, works identically with ChatGPT, Claude, and any MCP-compatible model, and travels with you when you switch. You control it directly — pin what matters permanently, inspect graph health at any time, and delete anything, anytime, with hard erasure.

Built on neuroscience-inspired scoring (relevance × causal connectivity × reactivation), Genesys forgets safely: only memories that are irrelevant, causally orphaned, and unpinned are ever pruned.

release.description: Interestnaut grounds recommendations in what you have actually reacted to and rated — across films, TV, books, games, music, podcasts and creators — instead of guessing from genre labels. ChatGPT can read your reaction history, your 1-10 ratings, and your computed taste profile, and search the catalog by title across all seven media types. Ratings carry the most signal: they are sparse and deliberate, so a 9 means considerably more than a like. Reactions are not interchangeable either — "meh" means you consumed something and felt nothing, while "skipped" means you passed without engaging and carries no opinion at all. With your permission it can also record reactions and ratings, so you can keep your library current without leaving the conversation. Sign-in is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and a consent screen listing exactly what you are granting, and you can disconnect at any time. Results render as interactive cards showing cover art, with one-tap buttons that record a reaction or save something for later without leaving the conversation. Plot summaries and adult titles are never sent, and every card links back to app.interestnaut.com. Nothing here is locked to this conversation. Everything ChatGPT reads or writes is your own Interestnaut account, and the same library is open in the app on the web, iPhone and Android — where you can review what was saved, change or remove any reaction, add things ChatGPT never saw, build lists, and watch your taste profile update. Ratings are recorded through the assistant and feed the same taste profile. Start something here and finish it there, or the other way round; the account is the same either way, and it outlives this connection.

release.description:
Rovyn lets your assistant curate what you listen to. Ask ChatGPT for anything — "an hour on the chip war for my commute, one skeptical take included" — and it builds a ready-to-play plan: every episode grounded against Rovyn's catalog (playable, or honestly reported why not), one tap-to-play link, a one-line "why" under each pick in the Rovyn iOS player.

The loop closes after you listen. ChatGPT reads compact receipts — what you finished, what you dropped, and anything you wrote in your own words — so the next plan starts from what the last one actually did.

The exchange is scoped by design: ChatGPT sends a brief (goal, time, level), Rovyn returns receipts. Each assistant connects with its own revocable grant, speaking Cueback, an open MCP convention.

release.description:
PKB Immobilien is a locally focused real estate company specializing in Baunatal, Kassel, the Kassel district, and the Schwalm-Eder district. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties throughout the region.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, plots of land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand location, infrastructure, and the surrounding neighborhood at a glance, making the property search simpler and more efficient.

Combining in-depth local market knowledge with personal advice, PKB Immobilien connects modern digital solutions with regional real estate expertise. Buyers, sellers, and investors gain transparent and convenient access to the property market in Baunatal, Kassel, and the surrounding region.

Key Benefits

* Interactive property search with a modern map view
* Quick orientation across Baunatal, Kassel, and Northern Hesse
* Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and surroundings
* Focus on selected residential and investment properties
* Easy comparison of different locations and municipalities
* More efficient property searches through visual navigation
* Local market expertise and personalized real estate advice
* Modern and user-friendly access to the regional property market

Whether you are looking for an apartment in Kassel, a family home in Baunatal, a property in the Kassel district, or an attractive investment property in the Schwalm-Eder district, PKB Immobilien offers a modern, transparent, and regionally focused way to access the local real estate market.

release.description:
DRAIV is keyless car rental in Zurich, Switzerland. Ask for what you need — an SUV for the weekend, an electric car tonight, a seven-seater for the family — and DRAIV shows what is actually free, with real prices in Swiss francs and a direct link to book.

There is no rental counter, no key handover and no deposit blocked on your card. You unlock the car with your phone, so pickup works at any hour, including after a late flight. Cars stand at fixed locations across Zurich (City, Altstetten, Oerlikon) and at Zurich Airport, where you collect the car right at the terminal parking on rentals of two days or more.

Booking finishes on draiv.ch in your browser. No app to install.

release.description:
Ad Superpowers connects ChatGPT to the advertising and analytics accounts a marketer already runs: Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center, LinkedIn Ads and TikTok Ads.

Read workflows: pull campaign results across platforms and compare them, find which creatives are fatiguing, check why a campaign stopped spending, reconcile conversion numbers that differ between a platform and GA4, compare paid keywords against organic Search Console queries, and audit a Tag Manager container before a release.

Write workflows: pause or adjust a campaign that is overspending, fix a wrong landing-page URL on a live ad without losing its social proof, duplicate a winning ad into a new variant, upload creative assets, and build a new ad. Write tools that publish are gated behind an explicit plan-and-confirm step, so the user reads what will change and confirms it before anything is created.

Every account is connected by the customer through OAuth in the Ad Superpowers dashboard. The app only reaches accounts that customer has connected, and tools for platforms they have not connected are not offered at all.

release.description:
Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down. Ask in plain language and OptionsAhoy returns the answer with the year-by-year schedule behind it.

1. Which incentive stock options (ISOs) to exercise in which year, to hold down AMT and recover the credit later. We optimize across multiple years, with your tax status in mind.

2. Whether to sell restricted stock units (RSUs) at vest or hold for long-term capital gains, and what the twelve-month cliff is actually worth. We show you the optimal solution.

3. Which vested RSU lots to sell and in what order, and what that saves against selling oldest-first (the default order your broker's UI will offer). This sounds like a minute optimization. On a $725,000 sale from a concentrated position, the gap between the optimal order and your broker's default could be over $100,000 in tax.

4. Whether non-qualified stock options (NSOs) are better exercised and sold, or exercised and held.

5. Whether your shares pass the six statutory tests for qualified small business stock (QSBS). Best to check early for potential tax savings, the rules just changed.

6. How exposed a single position leaves you, and what selling down, holding, or hedging each cost. We calculate and compare different strategies across three years, with your taxes in mind.

7. What a protective put or a zero-cost collar prices at. If you need to protect your holdings, you're probably considering a hedge. But which one? We make it easy to decide.

8. How to convert some of your holdings to a target amount of after-tax cash by a deadline with the smallest tax bill. We optimize against your inputs and risk tolerance, then you choose, the way an investment firm would.

Every result is computed against the federal tax code plus all fifty states and the District of Columbia. The 2026 federal constants match IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32. Federal cases reproduce to the cent against the independently maintained PSL Tax-Calculator, and state results reproduce to the cent against OpenTaxSolver across California, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Massachusetts. That proof recomputes live in your browser at optionsahoy.com/verification.

This matters because language models are confident and wrong at exactly this task. In a published benchmark, five frontier models were given the same multi-year ISO problem, three runs each. All five overstated the after-tax value of their own proposed schedules, by 1.6x to 17.6x against the provable optimum. One model claimed $3.9M, $5.2M, and $13.0M on three runs of identical input. The prompt and full transcripts are public at optionsahoy.com/benchmark. The arithmetic here is deterministic instead: the same inputs on the same date give the same answer every time, with no model inference anywhere in the number.

Free, no account, no API key, and your figures are not retained. United States tax logic only. This is a planning calculator, not tax advice.

release.description: Go! lets you play Go against AI directly inside ChatGPT, with no separate login required. Games use the professional and international tournament standard 19×19 board by default, while 13×13 and 9×9 boards are available whenever you request a shorter match. Choose to play Black or White, select from three AI difficulty levels, and use a handicap of 2 to 9 stones when you want to balance the game. Go! handles legal move placement and captures while enforcing the prohibition on suicide, ko, and repeated positions. During a game, you can pass, resign, or undo a move. When play ends, the board is scored using Chinese area scoring. The result clearly identifies the winner and uses standard notation such as B+12.5 or W+R. A detailed breakdown shows stones, territory, komi, and totals, with territory marked directly on the board so you can understand how the result was calculated. The complete interface is presented in English. Whether you search for Go, Baduk, Weiqi, or simply want to play Go without leaving ChatGPT, Go! provides a convenient, rules-aware way to start a match at your preferred board size and difficulty.

Decionis is an execution-authority layer for AI agents. Before an agent takes a consequential action, Decionis evaluates the proposed action against organization policy and determines whether it may proceed, must be held, or requires additional authority.

release.description:
Maakrop is a teaching assistant that makes everyday classroom management simpler and more convenient. Teachers can access important information and handle common tasks through conversation in one place, without spending time navigating multiple pages, searching through menus, or gathering information manually.

Maakrop can help teachers review teaching schedules, find classes, subjects, and students, check and summarize attendance, review scores, track missing work, and quickly understand what is happening across their classes. It can also assist with tasks such as adding or updating student information, creating assessments, recording scores and attendance, and importing student rosters or teaching schedules.

For tasks involving several steps, Maakrop can gather the relevant information, prepare a clear plan, and present the details for review before any changes are saved. This helps reduce mistakes in repetitive administrative work while keeping teachers informed and in control.

Whether teachers are preparing for the day, checking absences, following up on missing assignments, reviewing class performance, or organizing classroom information, Maakrop reduces the time spent on administration and searching for data. This gives teachers more time to focus on lessons, planning, and supporting their students.

release.description:
Better Design gives AI coding agents a design-engineering layer for frontend work.

Design Intelligence mode loads UI principles before the agent writes UI code, then asks the agent to self-review against accessibility, visual design, motion, content, and comprehension rules. It helps catch issues like weak hierarchy, inaccessible controls, distracting motion, unclear copy, and missing reduced-motion behavior before code is presented.

Scaffold mode lets an agent install a complete shadcn-compatible visual system: tokens, globals, and component source. Better Design can also generate a new custom design system from a natural-language prompt and return a shadcn install command for the resulting registry.

The MCP server exposes tools for finding and generating design systems, loading UI/UX and React Native guidance, reviewing interface quality, extracting existing CSS tokens, and installing icon components. Tools are served from a public HTTPS endpoint and authenticated with OAuth for hosted ChatGPT and Codex use.

release.description:
Nowlun turns a Bill of Lading into a live shipment view. Upload the document, or just paste a BL, booking, or container number, and get the current status back in the chat.

Beyond tracking identifiers, it reads the full contents of the BL — shipper and consignee, notify party, cargo description, container numbers and sizes, ports of loading and discharge, vessel and voyage, and commercial terms. So instead of retyping details from a PDF into a portal, you can ask questions about the document directly.

Once the shipment is identified, you get:

Current status and last known milestone
Vessel, voyage, and carrier details
ETD and ETA, with schedule changes when the carrier updates them
Container-level breakdown for multi-container shipments
An interactive map showing the route and where the vessel is now

Useful for freight forwarders, importers and exporters, and anyone who handles shipping documents and wants an answer without logging into three carrier websites.

Nowlun is a digital freight forwarding platform covering sea freight, air cargo, customs clearance, and inland trucking. No account is required to track a shipment.

O Controlle é uma plataforma de gestão financeira para pequenas e médias empresas brasileiras, com foco no setor de serviços.

Com este plugin, você acessa o financeiro da sua empresa direto na conversa. release.description:
Cargo is GTM infrastructure for AI assistants. Connect this MCP server and ChatGPT can operate your Cargo workspace: discover and run actions across 130+ integrations, execute tools and agents, query CRM and revenue models, and read the playbooks and ICP context your team already wrote.

Sign in with OAuth — no API key to paste. Your session binds to one workspace, so ChatGPT sees your integrations, your models, and your credits.

What you can do from chat:
• Search the action catalog and see credit cost before anything runs
• Enrich people and companies, look up CRM records, and call native platform ops
• Run a single action or a batch across many records
• Query workspace models (selects, joins, aggregates)
• Read workspace context — ICP definitions, playbooks, rubrics — before guessing

Ask in plain English. ChatGPT finds the right action, confirms cost when it matters, and brings results back into the conversation.

Best for RevOps, sales ops, and GTM engineers who want research-to-action without leaving chat. Building multi-step workflows or workspace-as-code stays in the Cargo CLI — this connector is the runtime for in-conversation work.

Learn more: https://www.getcargo.ai/mcp

release.description:
Riveter turns web research into structured data. Give Claude a list of companies, people, or URLs and ask for new columns: product descriptions, revenue, deep analysis, company headcount, link traces, pricing, tech stack analysis, contact details, a classification, a summary, etc. Riveter runs an AI agent per row that searches, reads pages, and fills in each cell with a sourced answer.

What you can do

- Enrich rows you already have. Paste a list or point at a saved enrichment and get the new columns back. Up to 10,000 rows per run.
- Build a list from a description. "Every lawfirm in Indiana", "every YC W24 company in healthcare", "competitors of Stripe". Riveter generates the rows, and can enrich them in the same run.
- Scrape a page. Clean text or markdown from any URL, including JavaScript-rendered pages.
- Search the web. One-shot search results, or a research agent that answers a question with a structured, schema-shaped response.
- Extract records from a site. Define the fields you want and pull them from listings, directories, or catalogs as JSON.
- Monitor for changes. Run a saved enrichment daily, weekly, or monthly and get alerts or webhooks when values change.

How it works

Long runs are asynchronous. Claude starts the run, checks status, and fetches results when they are ready. Every run has an id you can come back to later, and results stay available in your Riveter account.

release.description:
The Tessun Immobilien app makes property searching in Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley clearer and more locally focused.

Instead of browsing through long property lists, users can see available properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easier to quickly understand which location best fits their daily life — whether in Munich, Wolfratshausen, Geretsried, or the surrounding areas.

Faster geographic orientation
Users can immediately see where a property is located and what the surrounding area looks like.

Better understanding of the location
Especially in regions like Munich or the Isar-Loisach Valley, the micro-location is often crucial. The map view helps users better evaluate distances, infrastructure, and the surrounding environment realistically.

Focus on relevant regional properties
Instead of thousands of random listings, the app focuses on selected properties from a regionally specialized real estate agency.

Easier comparison of different locations
Users can directly recognize how residential areas differ — for example, between urban Munich and quieter surrounding towns.

Less time wasted on unsuitable listings
Many users choose based on location first. The visual search makes this step much faster.

Direct contact with a local expert
Interested users can easily send inquiries or arrange viewings without having to switch between multiple platforms.

More enjoyable mobile experience
The search feels more intuitive because users can browse the map and actively explore different regions.

The app is designed not to make property searching more complicated, but more understandable — with a clear focus on location, regional expertise, and easier navigation through the real estate market around Munich and the Isar-Loisach Valley.

Sphere is a calorie and nutrition tracker for iOS. Connect it here and you can log what you ate, check your calories and macros, and search a verified food database without leaving the conversation.

Describe a meal in plain language and it becomes real entries with real nutrition data. Ask how many calories you have left, what your protein looks like today, or what you ate last Tuesday. Change a portion, move an item to a different meal, or delete something you logged by mistake.

Everything writes to the same account as the Sphere iOS app, so a meal logged here appears on your phone and your streak keeps counting. Your food log persists across conversations.

release.description:
Unblocked is the context layer for agentic software development. It reasons across your code, conversations, issues, docs, product, and production systems so agents can complete work correctly with less human intervention.

Coding agents know the code. They do not know why it was written that way, which of two conflicting docs is current, what a ticket decided, or what production is doing right now. Unblocked gives them that organizational understanding by connecting the context scattered across your code, messaging platforms, issue trackers, documentation, and product and production data, reconciling conflicts between sources, and enforcing the permissions you already set in each tool.

One MCP server replaces a dozen. Context is ranked, compressed, and assembled server-side before it reaches the agent, so the agent reasons over higher-quality input. The result: reliable code that reflects how your team actually builds software, generated with fewer tokens and less back-and-forth.

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and Codex over MCP, or through the Unblocked CLI and API. Connects to GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Linear, Confluence, Notion, Google Drive, Sentry, Datadog, and more.

release.description:
Birdie helps you capture customer issues and turn them into clear context for troubleshooting.

Instead of relying on written descriptions, customers can record their screen to show the issue. Birdie captures the full context, including what happened, what they clicked, and technical evidence such as console logs, network requests, session data, device metadata, and reproduction steps.

This gives your agent the context it needs to understand the issue, troubleshoot it accurately, and move faster to a resolution.

With Birdie, your agent does not have to guess what the customer meant. It can see what the customer saw and use the right evidence to investigate the issue.

Built for support and technical teams, Birdie reduces back and forth and helps both humans and AI troubleshoot customer issues faster.

release.description:
Inntally is the operations platform behind bars, restaurants and hotels. This plugin lets you ask questions about your own venue and get answers from live records rather than estimates.

Ask what stock is running low, which suppliers changed their prices, how many covers are booked for Saturday, what a recipe costs to make, or how last month's profit and loss looks — and get figures straight from your Inntally account.

Access is read-only. The plugin can investigate, compare and help you draft, but it cannot change stock, place orders, alter bookings or post to your accounts. Those stay in Inntally, where they are approved and audited. It only ever reads the venues your own Inntally permissions cover, and if those change, so does what it can see. Guest phone numbers and booking notes are never shared.

You will need an Inntally account to connect.

You can also manage your catalog, floor plan, and POS configuration through the same conversation.

Access is authorized through your 20Tabs account using OAuth. You control exactly which permissions ChatGPT receives.

release.description:
PuraFi turns a conversation into a finished expense report.

Drop receipts into chat as photos, PDFs, or plain descriptions and PuraFi keeps a running list: merchant, date, category, and amount, organized by month or trip. Describe a drive ("office to the Hartford client and back") and PuraFi figures out the actual driving distance and applies the current IRS mileage rate, including the mid-year rate changes your spreadsheet missed.

When you're ready, PuraFi puts everything into a polished PDF report, plus files your finance team can open straight in Excel or QuickBooks. It double-checks every line for the things that get reports bounced back: missing details, forgotten attendees, duplicate charges. Then it sends the report to your approver with a one-click review link. No account or app needed on their end. After you send it, PuraFi tracks where your report stands (pending, approved, or rejected) and counts how many days you've been waiting, so asking "how much am I owed?" always has a real answer.

Use it for:

• Turning receipt photos and PDFs into organized expenses
• Logging business mileage at the current IRS mileage rate
• Building expense reports as PDF, Excel, or QuickBooks-ready files
• Sending expense reports to your manager for one-click approval
• Tracking approval status and how long you've been owed

Try: "File my expenses from this trip" - "Log my drive to the client site and back" - "Make my expense report and submit it to my manager" - "How much am I owed?"

From a pocketful of receipts to a submitted, tracked expense report, without ever leaving the conversation.

release.description:
Guest-Ready Score helps people set up, prepare, assess, improve and maintain properties used for short-term stays and paying guests. It is designed for Airbnb hosts, short-term rental owners, vacation rental operators, cottage and cabin owners, lake houses, beach houses, chalets, condos, apartments, guest houses, lodges, villas, ski properties, waterfront rentals, country homes, tiny homes, furnished rentals, holiday rentals and other guest accommodation.

The tool is relevant for people asking how to start an Airbnb, how to prepare a property for guests, what to buy or stock, what amenities to provide, how to improve guest reviews, how to create a better guest experience, how to check whether a property is ready to list, or how to benchmark an existing rental against strong hospitality standards.

The 12-question assessment reviews core areas of the guest stay, including arrival and check-in, beds and sleeping comfort, bathrooms, kitchen readiness, lighting, temperature and climate comfort, Wi-Fi, cleanliness, restocking, guest communication, safety and local information. It then provides a practical Guest-Ready Score to help identify what is already working well and where additional attention may improve the stay.

Use Guest-Ready Score for first-time setup, pre-opening checks, pre-arrival preparation, rental audits, hospitality reviews, property readiness checks, host checklists, Airbnb setup questions, STR checklists, vacation rental standards, guest-experience improvement and ongoing quality control.

release.description:
Play fresh Sudoku puzzles directly in ChatGPT. Choose a level and start solving instantly with the on-screen number pad or your keyboard.

Every puzzle is freshly generated with exactly one solution. Five carefully graded difficulty levels welcome every kind of solver: Easy builds confidence, Medium develops technique, Hard raises the challenge, Expert rewards experienced players, and Master offers the deepest test. Each level is measured by the solving logic the puzzle actually requires.

Designed for smooth, satisfying play:
• Instant feedback makes every entry easy to review.
• Pencil marks, erase, and unlimited undo keep every move flexible.
• Logic-based hints guide your next step and help you learn.
• A timer, progress bar, and live remaining-number counts keep you in flow.
• Tap any number to highlight every matching cell on the board.

Choose the classic 9x9 Sudoku, a quick 4x4 or 6x6 puzzle, or the ultimate 16x16 Hexadoku with symbols 1-9 and A-G.

Enjoy a quick mental break, daily brain training, or a serious solving challenge whenever you want. Available in twelve languages.

release.description:
mfloow is a business process improvement platform that uses AI to provide end-to-end support, from visualizing operations to ensuring that improvements are successfully embedded across the organization.

By visualizing task progress, assignees, deadlines, and approval statuses, mfloow enables users to quickly understand the overall state of their operations. It also standardizes business workflows to reduce inconsistencies between individuals and prevent processes from becoming dependent on specific employees. In addition, mfloow automates routine activities such as initiating workflows, assigning tasks, and sending notifications, thereby reducing administrative effort and human error. Its AI-assisted workflow creation capabilities help organizations reduce the time required to design processes, improve operational quality, and establish a sustainable framework for continuous improvement.

The mfloow plugin allows users to access flow and task information stored in mfloow and check progress, deadlines, and assigned work through a conversational interface. Users can review ongoing flows, identify their assigned tasks, and detect overdue tasks, as well as view detailed information such as task comments, checklists, related tasks, and approval statuses.

release.description:
Musafir.com Visa answers visa questions from Musafir.com's live product catalogue: whether you need a visa at all, what it costs, which documents are needed, how long it takes, and whether Musafir.com can process it for you. Where a visa needs an in-person appointment, it also shows the visa centres with published availability and the dates they were last showing as open, so you can see roughly how soon is realistic before you commit to anything.

Visa rules, fees and processing times change constantly and differ by the passport you hold, so remembered or published figures are routinely out of date for the person asking. Every answer here comes from the catalogue that prices Musafir.com's own bookings, and each one names the market it applies to.

Ask about a destination, compare several, or check what paperwork you need and how each document is handed over, whether that is uploaded online, taken to a visa centre or couriered. When you are ready to apply, you are handed the matching page on Musafir.com with your details already carried across, and Musafir.com books the appointment for you once your application is in.

Musafir.com currently serves travellers applying from the UAE. If you live somewhere Musafir.com does not yet cover, the connector says so rather than quoting you a price for a process you cannot use.

This connector is read-only. It cannot access your account, view or change an order, hold or book an appointment, or take a payment. Appointment availability is what the visa centre was last publishing, not a reservation and not a guarantee. It tells you what Musafir.com can process, which is not the same as what a government requires, and it never predicts whether a visa will be approved.

release.description:
Postify is a social media scheduling tool for teams: one calendar for the accounts you publish to, with drafts, scheduling, and delivery analytics in one place. The Postify plugin lets ChatGPT work that calendar with you: list posts and open a specific one, see which channels are connected, draft a new post, move a scheduled post to a different time, search your media library for an image you already uploaded, ask for a suggested posting time, publish a post immediately, or delete one. It can also pull performance figures for posts already delivered, and search Postify's own documentation when you need to know how something works.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, and issued tokens are bound to the Postify MCP endpoint. You choose scopes on the consent screen, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never registered for the session, so the assistant cannot see it. Connected apps are listed in Settings and can be revoked there, and every tool call is written to an audit log you can read in the app.

The two irreversible actions — publishing and deleting — are deliberately gated twice. First, an organization setting controls whether an AI assistant may perform them at all, and that setting can only be turned on by a person inside Postify; no AI credential carries the scope needed to enable it. Second, with the setting on, the first call returns a confirmation request with a short-lived token bound to the exact arguments, which must be echoed back on a second call before anything is published or deleted. Expect that first response — it is the safety step working, not an error.

release.description:
Get accurate, citable answers about Shallon CSP (the trading name of Shallon Legal FZ LLC), a UAE-based legal, corporate, and fiduciary services provider based in Fujairah that serves clients across Europe and international markets. Courtyard AI operates this connector for Shallon CSP with the firm's explicit authorization and keeps its content current automatically, so answers come from the firm's own published information rather than stale third-party sources.

Use it for full details on the firm's practice areas: company formation and corporate administration; corporate services (ongoing governance, compliance, and corporate housekeeping); DIFC and ADGM wills, trusts, and foundations for expatriates in the UAE; cross-border structuring; dispute resolution; legal drafting and documentation; and regulatory compliance and licensing. It also covers who the firm serves, its office hours and logistics in Fujairah, and accessibility information.

The connector exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a canonical source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text, its canonical URL, and metadata. Every result resolves to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded and citable to source.

All content is public business information describing the firm's services. It is general information, not legal advice. No account, login, or personal data is required, and no client data is exposed. The connector is strictly read-only: it retrieves and cites the firm's published information and never performs writes, bookings, or transactions.

release.description:
Der ecoExperten-Connector bringt den deutschen Energieausweis in den KI-Chat. Wer eine Wohnimmobilie vermieten oder verkaufen will, braucht gesetzlich einen Energieausweis — mit dieser App lässt er sich vollständig im Gespräch bestellen:

1. Beraten: Die App erklärt, welcher Ausweistyp passt und welche Angaben nötig sind (Gebäudedaten plus drei aufeinanderfolgende Jahres-Heizabrechnungen).
2. Prüfen: Alle Angaben werden vorab kostenlos gegen die gesetzlichen Regeln des Gebäudeenergiegesetzes (GEG) validiert — z. B. 18-Monats-Frist der Verbrauchsdaten, Bedarfsausweis-Pflicht nach § 80 Abs. 3, Leerstandsgrenzen — ohne dass eine Bestellung ausgelöst wird.
3. Bestellen: Nach ausdrücklicher Zustimmung zu AGB und zahlungspflichtiger Bestellung legt die App eine schwebende Bestellung an und sendet einen Bestätigungslink an die angegebene E-Mail-Adresse. Erst der Klick auf diesen Link macht die Bestellung verbindlich; unbestätigte Bestellungen verfallen nach 48 Stunden automatisch. Kauf auf Rechnung, kein Zahlungsvorgang im Chat. Ein Doppelbestellungs-Schutz verhindert versehentliche Mehrfachkäufe.
4. Verfolgen: Der Bearbeitungsstand ist über Bestellnummer plus die bei der Bestellung angegebene E-Mail-Adresse abrufbar; die Antwort enthält nur den Bearbeitungsstand, keine Personen- oder Gebäudedaten.

Die Ausstellung erfolgt durch eingetragene Energieberater des CO5 Ingenieurbüros für nachhaltiges Bauen (PartG mbB, Berlin); jeder Ausweis erhält eine amtliche DIBt-Registriernummer und wird in der Regel innerhalb von 1–2 Werktagen als PDF per E-Mail zugestellt. Preis: 59 € brutto (Verbrauchsausweis); der Bedarfsausweis (119 €) ist über das Web-Formular erhältlich.

release.description:
Trifolia connects ChatGPT to Chile's primary legal sources, so lawyers and legal professionals can research in natural language and get answers with verifiable citations to the original source.

Through four read-only tools, ChatGPT can search:

- Court rulings: decisions of Chile's Supreme Court, Courts of Appeals, and specialized courts.
- Legislation: statutes, codes, decrees, and current regulations.

release.description:
Everlaw provides a secure, standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows OpenAI to connect to Everlaw and work with live matter data on behalf of an authenticated user.

Through the connector, a connected agent can understand a user’s Everlaw project structure, translate natural-language requests into Everlaw search logic, retrieve responsive documents and document text, and analyze metadata and Bates driven result sets. The connected agent can also support natural-language reporting and analysis workflows, while Everlaw remains the governed evidence layer and system of record for case materials, metadata, and work product.

Access to Deep Dive via this connector complements search and retrieval tools, as well as Everlaw’s native Deep Dive experience. It is intended to support broader, semantic, evidence-backed questions while preserving Everlaw’s permissions and the integrity of the underlying matter record.

The connector is designed to operate within the user’s existing Everlaw permission level. Every request is authenticated and authorized against the user’s Everlaw permissions, so the agent can access only the projects, documents, and data that user is already permitted to view. Deep Dive will also be available through the connector, allowing a user to query Deep Dive over eligible Everlaw project data and retrieve evidence-backed results without changing the underlying matter record.

Using the connector, an agent can:

Use Deep Dive to ask broader investigative questions and return evidence-backed results, once the Deep Dive tools are available.

Convert a natural-language request into a structured Everlaw search. 

Generate structured reports about project contents, document volumes, custodians, dates, Bates ranges, and other returned data. 

Search by document text, metadata, Bates or Control number, binder, coding, redactions, productions, processing criteria, and other supported terms. 

Identify the metadata fields, datasets, and processed uploads available in a project. 

Retrieve matching documents with Bates numbers, metadata, review links, document-text links, and extracted values. 

Summarize and analyze retrieved documents or result sets in natural language.

release.description:
Bizora is an AI native tax research platform. This connector brings Bizora’s research engine into ChatGPT, so you can ask a tax question in the middle of your actual work and get an answer grounded in primary source authority rather than secondary commentary.

Ask the question the way you would ask a colleague. Bizora interprets it, researches it against the governing authority, and returns a reasoned answer with citations you can open and verify yourself. Responses point back to the sources that control the issue, including the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury regulations, revenue rulings and revenue procedures, IRS guidance, and federal case law. State and international authority is included where the question calls for it.

Common uses:

- Researching a client position before you commit to it on a return
- Checking whether recent legislation or guidance changes an answer you already relied on
- Working through cross-border and multistate questions where the authority is scattered
- Building the technical support behind a memo, a client email, or a workpaper
- Getting oriented on an issue outside your usual specialty

Because the connector runs inside ChatGPT, the research sits alongside the rest of your work. You can pull up a client email, research the question it raises, and draft the reply in one thread.

Every tool in this connector is read only. Bizora retrieves and analyzes tax authority without creating, modifying, or deleting your client records or research source material. Research usage is metered against your Bizora account credit balance.

Bizora is a research tool, not a substitute for professional judgment. Review the cited authority before relying on any answer in client work.
