release.description:
bryny MCP Server connects your AI assistant to your own operational data on the bryny fulfilment and logistics platform in Tunisia. Merchants who store their physical goods in bryny warehouses can ask, in plain language, how their orders are progressing, which products are running out of stock, where a parcel is, and how their fulfilment activity is doing — without opening a dashboard.

Access is strictly scoped: you only ever see the data of the account you signed in with. A merchant sees their own orders, products, stock and deliveries; a customer sees their own orders and returns; an administrator sees platform-wide operations.

Key capabilities:
• Order operations: list, search, filter and analyse your own orders and their delivery statuses
• Inventory and stock: real-time stock levels, low-stock and out-of-stock alerts, stock movements
• Shop operations: your shop profile, product records and fulfilment activity summaries
• Logistics: parcel tracking, delivery progress and delivery failure analysis
• Support: your own support tickets and customer returns
• Platform health: service status and audit trail (administrators only)

No purchase, cart, checkout or payment exists in this app. Every transaction happens outside ChatGPT: end customers pay the delivery driver in cash when the parcel arrives, and bryny never collects card or bank details.

release.description:
An information and calculation tool for visa applications by citizens of Türkiye (ordinary/burgundy passport).

It answers questions like "Do I need a visa for Japan?", "How much does a German visa cost?" and "How many Schengen days do I have left?" — always with its source.

What it covers:

· Visa status for 172 countries — 55 visa-free, 23 visa on arrival, 30 e-visa, 64 requiring a consulate application
· Per country: the fee, the published processing time, the application centre and the required documents
· Refusal rates for Schengen applications made from Türkiye, based on European Commission statistics (27 countries)
· Appealing a refusal: the competent authority, deadline, language and fee for seven Schengen countries, and the meaning of all 17 refusal grounds on the standard form
· Calculators: the Schengen 90/180 day allowance, multiple-entry (cascade) eligibility, and the total cost in Turkish lira at the central bank rate

How the data is collected:

Every amount and duration is verified against an official consulate, ministry or legislative source, quoted verbatim. A value that cannot be verified is not published — nothing is estimated; the field is left empty and said to be empty. Answers carry their source and last-updated date.

Only the consulate of the country concerned can grant a visa. We are not an agency: we do not file applications, book appointments, or guarantee approval.

release.description:
Sellergoo is a profit-and-operations analytics service for online sellers. You connect the shops, marketplaces, payment and accounting accounts you already sell through, and Sellergoo brings the orders, fees, refunds, cost of goods, advertising and overhead together to work out what you actually earned — per channel, per product, per order.

This plugin lets you ask about those numbers in plain language instead of exporting spreadsheets. Ask what last month really made after fees, which SKUs are thin on margin, what a marketplace actually deposited in your bank account, or which products run out of stock first.

READ-ONLY
This plugin can only look. It cannot place, cancel, refund, reprice or change anything — not in Sellergoo, and not in any shop or marketplace you have connected. Every tool it exposes is read-only, and the access you grant it carries no permission to write. It reads figures that already belong to you, in answer to questions you ask.

WHAT IT CAN ANSWER
• Profit — sales, units, refunds, fees, cost of goods, ad spend, overhead, gross and net profit, margin and ROI for a period, combined and per channel.
• Profit and loss — a month-by-month P&L for up to the last 12 months, all channels or one.
• Orders — any date range, paginated, with each order's sales and marketplace fees.
• Products — per-SKU sales, units, margin and profit for a period, ranked by sales.
• Payouts — the settlements marketplaces and payment providers actually paid out, with the amounts grouped by line type.
• Inventory — stock on hand, 30-day sell-through and days of cover per SKU, one sales channel at a time.
• Alerts — stock-outs, low stock, thin margins, lost Buy Box, price changes and negative reviews.
• Channels — which shops are connected and when each last synced.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Sellergoo account (sellergoo.com). You sign in once and approve the connection; nothing is copied or pasted by hand. The answers are only as complete as the accounts you have connected — a brand-new account returns empty figures rather than errors, and you can always ask which account is being read.

Sellergoo works with Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy and Stripe, plus QuickBooks for accounting and UPS and FedEx for shipping. Walmart is planned and not available yet. Money is reported in euro.

INDEPENDENT PRODUCT
Sellergoo is made by Wolfsohn Handel (Hüseyin Kurtoglu Wolfsohn, Einzelunternehmen, Germany). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or certified by Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Stripe, Intuit, UPS or FedEx. Those names appear only to say which of your own accounts Sellergoo can read for you.

YOUR DATA
The figures returned are commercial: totals, fees, SKUs, stock and payouts. Order records carry no buyer names, addresses, e-mail addresses or payment details. Nothing returned here is used to train any model. You can cut the connection off at any moment in Sellergoo under Settings → API keys; it stops working immediately, with no grace period.

Documentation: https://sellergoo.com/docs/mcp
Privacy: https://sellergoo.com/privacy · Terms: https://sellergoo.com/terms
Support: info@wolfsohn.de

release.description:
Lead Recorder shows you where your leads actually came from.

It tracks every phone click, form submission and enquiry on a website and matches each one back to the exact ad, Google search or post that produced it. This plugin lets you ask about that data in plain English instead of opening a dashboard.

Three read-only tools:

List Sites returns the client websites your account can report on.

Get Quiet Sites lists sites with no leads in the last few days. Useful if you manage a lot of client sites and want to catch a problem before the client does.

Get Monthly Report returns the numbers for one site in a given month: total leads, new versus returning visitors, the split between phone clicks, forms and email enquiries, the paid, organic and direct channel breakdown, top sources and campaigns, and the percentage of leads that arrived outside business hours.

Things you can ask:

"Which of my client sites had no leads this week?"
"How did Bob's Plumbing do last month and where did the leads come from?"
"Write this month's lead report for a client using the real numbers."

It's built for marketing agencies and the businesses they work with, particularly local service businesses where the enquiry is a phone call rather than an online checkout.

You'll need a Lead Recorder account with the tracking snippet installed on at least one site. There's a free plan and installation takes about thirty seconds. Nothing in your account can be modified through this plugin.

release.description:
PostFast is a social media management tool. This plugin connects your existing PostFast workspace so you can run your posting workflow in conversation instead of opening the dashboard.

Plan and schedule
Draft a post, choose which of your connected accounts it goes to, attach an image or video, and place it on the calendar for a specific time. Save it as a draft, route it for approval, or approve one that is already waiting. Review what is queued and remove a scheduled post. Supported accounts: X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, YouTube, Bluesky, Telegram, and Google Business Profile.

Check how posts did
Look up the performance of a published post, or how an account's follower count has moved day by day. Analytics cover Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest Business accounts, and LinkedIn company pages.

Add an account
Generate a link that opens PostFast's account connection flow when you want to add a new social profile.

How it works
PostFast connects to each social network under its own app registrations and platform credentials, and stores your drafts, scheduled posts, media and comment history in your own PostFast workspace. This plugin is a first-party interface to that product, not a generic pass-through layer. Some tools do call a platform live, for example when publishing a post, and each of those is labelled as such.

You sign in with your existing PostFast account over OAuth. Viewing accounts, writing posts, and reading analytics are separate permissions that you grant individually, and you can disconnect at any time. The connector also exposes comment management tools used by other clients, which are not part of the workflows described here.

Fixture and Finish is a selections and procurement platform built for custom home builders, interior designers, and design-build firms. This plugin brings your project data into ChatGPT so you can ask questions in plain language from anywhere — the office, the job site, or your phone.

Look up any item on a project — fixture specs, finishes, model numbers, dimensions, and installation details

release.description:
Sóley is Iceland's tourism operator registry and live travel intelligence service. It searches Iceland's official licensed operator registers for accommodation providers, day tour operators and travel agencies across the country, with source attribution and freshness for every record. Registry listings are informational and are not automatically bookable. Only two clearly marked demonstration operators are currently bookable through Sóley. No real operator is currently bookable.

Sóley provides live Iceland conditions from authoritative sources, including weather, road conditions, safety alerts, earthquakes, aurora forecasts, avalanche conditions, air quality, flights, fuel prices, exchange rates, news and public transit. Curated multi-day itineraries, developed in collaboration with local tourism bodies in Iceland, connect routes to licensed operators near each stop.

Tourism operators are independent businesses that set their own terms and use their own payment providers. Each operator remains the merchant of record. Sóley is never the merchant of record, never receives traveler funds and never becomes a party to the traveler and operator purchase contract.

release.description:
Ask your AI about the market and it answers from memory: whatever it absorbed during training, with no idea what today looks like or what you actually own.

Jawz gives it both. You get a live market read and a published four-chapter process for thinking about a portfolio: See the World (what markets are doing right now), Understand the Book (what your positions are really exposed to), Decide (how to think through a specific choice), and Observe & Refine (what your past decisions actually did).

Things you can ask:
• "What's the current macro regime?"
• "What does this week's read mean for a portfolio with BTC, AAPL and GLD?"
• "Is my thesis on this position still intact?"
• "What's in this week's World Brief?"

Every answer ends with its sources and how fresh they are, so you can see exactly where each number came from and when it was last updated. The framework itself is public and versioned, with a changelog that says what changed and why, including the times it changed because it was wrong.

Jawz is free and needs no account. The market and portfolio tools work the moment you connect. An optional email sign-in exists only to remember your settings between sessions.

One thing Jawz deliberately will not do is tell you what to buy or sell. It shows what is true about the market and your positions, frames the decision, and leaves the decision to you. Jawz is information and framework, not investment advice.

release.description:
Magnus is an analytics platform for mobile and web app publishers. It aggregates marketing spend from ad networks, subscription and in-app revenue, ad-network monetization, payment-provider outcomes and first-party product-analytics events into one place, so a publisher can ask how a campaign, an app or an experiment is actually performing.

Over MCP the app exposes that data read-only. Three tools answer questions: marketing_timeline_report for acquisition and monetization performance (installs, spend, revenue, ROMI, forecasts), finances_risk_report and finances_risk_approval_rates for payment risk (approval rate, refunds, fraud alerts, disputes, chargebacks). A second group answers product-analytics questions from the publisher's own SDK events: event counts, funnels, retention, user-property segments and A/B experiment configuration. Everything else is a lookup helper that exists to feed those tools with real ids, filter values and metric definitions, because app ids, event names and metric semantics are account-specific and cannot be guessed.

Access is scoped to the companies the signed-in user is an active member of, and that membership is re-checked on every single call, so the model can never reach another tenant's data. The OAuth scope the app requests, mcp:analytics.read, grants read access only: no tool in the server can create, update or delete anything.

release.description:
Letsfind creates group polls from a description in the chat. Say which dates you want to propose, or which options people should choose between, and you get back a link to share.

There are two kinds of polls. A date poll proposes several days or time slots and asks everyone what works for them, which is the usual way to settle on a meeting, a dinner or a trip. An options poll asks a plain question with answers you define, for picking a restaurant, a name or a plan.

Every poll comes back with two links. The voting link is the one you send to the group; people open it in a browser and answer without creating an account or installing anything. The admin link is yours alone and the only way to edit the poll later, so it is worth keeping.

Once answers come in, you can ask here how the poll is doing instead of opening it yourself. You get the count for each option and the names of the people who picked it.

Describe who you are training and the behaviour you want to change, and Agent Kunjani designs the learning outcomes and writes the activities across Kunjani's six activity types (the Suits: Jolt, Advance, Mystery, Oops, Explain, Demonstrate), each with a built-in answer key and grading notes for Kunjani's AI grader. It then publishes the finished deck straight into your Kunjani account, where your learners play it on WhatsApp.

You stay in control: it proposes learning outcomes for your approval before writing activities, and you can list your existing decks, edit individual activities and outcomes, or update a deck in place. Connecting requires your own Kunjani account, and the app only ever reads and writes decks your account is authorized to access.

release.description:
Cosmos brings Consumer Edge's transaction data directly into ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain English and get analyst-grade answers built on near-real-time spend data from millions of US credit and debit cards, covering thousands of brands and merchants — weeks ahead of company reporting. Work directly with transaction-level data to build custom cohorts, run price-point analyses, and answer questions aggregates can't.

Each question runs through Cosmos, Consumer Edge's AI analytics engine, which selects the right metrics, handles panel weighting and merchant hierarchies, and returns a structured summary with the underlying data. Results come back as queryable tables, so ChatGPT can run follow-up analysis, calculate custom metrics, or build charts without re-querying.


Key features:

Natural language querying — no SQL or schema knowledge required; ask about brands, tickers, or merchant groups directly

Full KPI coverage — spend, transactions, average ticket, unique shoppers, visit frequency, and new customer acquisition

Demographic and cohort breakdowns — segment any brand's performance by customer income cohort

Flexible time grains — daily, monthly, or quarterly trends, including quarter-to-date reads on partial periods

Analyst-ready output — answers flag accelerations, decelerations, calendar shifts, and partial-month caveats automatically

Use it to:

Track brand performance ahead of earnings — monthly and quarter-to-date spend growth versus prior periods

Run competitive benchmarking — compare KPIs and market share shifts across any set of brands

Analyze customer behavior — see where new customer growth comes from and whether cohorts are trading down

Spot inflection points — decompose month-over-month changes into customer count, frequency, and ticket drivers

Requires a Consumer Edge subscription with MCP access enabled.

release.description:
Made In Show (MIS) is the management platform for event production companies — audio, video and lighting service providers. This connector links ChatGPT to your company's MIS installation so your team can work with live production data in plain language.

Ask about productions and their schedules, check warehouse availability for specific dates, spot material and crew conflicts before they happen, review how complete a production is, and read production notes and supplier statistics — and, when your administrator allows it, act on the data: reserve equipment, add locations, create productions, and draft estimate texts.

Access is off by default and controlled per user by your MIS administrator: each user's AI access can view data, view and act, or nothing at all. Write operations follow the same per-user permission, enforced server-side on every call; tools designed for impactful changes (such as creating a production) add their own two-step confirmation. The connector authenticates with OAuth against your installation; data flows only between ChatGPT and your MIS backend, is never used for model training by Made In Show, and tool calls are logged for 90 days for audit purposes (responses are never stored).

Requires an account on a Made In Show installation with AI access enabled by the administrator.

release.description:
RoboSystems turns public-company financial filings into a knowledge graph ChatGPT can query directly.

SEC EDGAR: every public company's XBRL filings as one queryable graph. Pull a company's financial statements by ticker or CIK, pivot reported facts across companies, periods and dimensions, resolve a concept like "revenue" to its XBRL element, and run full-text search across filing narratives, then read the exact section.

Read a filing the way it was filed: list the statements and notes in a 10-K or 10-Q, then open one section whole, with its rows, breakdowns and the calculations that tie it together.

The graph also exposes read-only Cypher, so a conversation can move from a question ("show me NVIDIA's latest income statement") to a raw traversal ("which 2025 10-Ks mention goodwill impairment?") without leaving ChatGPT.

Authorization is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. This plugin connects only to the SEC EDGAR repository, which is read-only, and you can revoke access at any time. Open source (Apache-2.0): github.com/RoboFinSystems/robosystems

release.description:
TimePeace is one calm, private place for your whole life — diary, journal, habits, mood, meals, exercise, money, people and travel. Connect the AI assistant you already use, and it can help you plan and keep that life, in plain language.

Ask it to turn a booking confirmation into a trip — flights, hotel and dates filled in — to build a week of training, or to plan your meals and add what you need to your shopping list. It can also log your day as you talk: a workout, a meal, an appointment, a note. Everything it adds is labelled as coming from your assistant, and it can remove only what it added — never your own entries.

You decide what it can touch. Adding to your diary is the baseline; reading your days back, and changing the things you've made (your trips, routines and meal plans), are each a separate permission you grant when you connect — never bundled, and health, people and money each need their own permission on top. Leave a permission off and those tools simply, honestly decline.

Nothing is sold, shared for advertising, or used to build a profile — no third-party trackers, no ads. It's your diary; the assistant is just another way in, working only where you let it.

You can also start from a built-in preset, re-run scans you've saved on OptionClaws, and look up which filters are available before you scan.

release.description:
Brainerce connects your Brainerce-powered online store to ChatGPT so you can run it in conversation instead of clicking through a dashboard. Check what is in stock, look up and update products, review and fulfil orders, issue and manage discount codes, find customers, and edit storefront content.

The connection is bound to a single store and to the permissions you grant when you sign in. An assistant given read-only access cannot change anything, and it can never reach another merchant's store. Actions that modify or delete data are marked as such, so ChatGPT asks before running them.

This app manages catalogues of physical goods. It does not sell digital products or subscriptions, and it does not process payments or transfer funds through ChatGPT.

release.description:
eSIMradar compares prepaid travel eSIM data plans from 60+ providers across 210+ destinations, so a traveller can see what mobile data actually costs where they are going.

Ask for a destination and it returns a ranked shortlist with the data allowance, validity, total price in USD and price per gigabyte, alongside the true size of the catalogue it drew from. Narrow by data need, trip length, budget, or features like 5G, hotspot sharing and top-up. Ask about one plan and it returns the detail that decides a purchase: fair-use throttling, whether the allowance is per day, the activation model, whether identity verification is required, which carriers it roams on, and which other countries it covers. Ask about a provider and it returns coverage, catalogue size, reader reviews and how much of that provider we have verified.

Results are ranked over the whole catalogue for a destination rather than a promoted subset, and no provider is allowed to occupy the shortlist. Prices are rebuilt from provider catalogues continuously.

eSIMradar earns affiliate commission when a reader buys through the site. That relationship decides which plans the website puts forward on one of its tabs; it never orders the results these tools return. Every plan links to its page on esimradar.com, where the reader compares and completes any purchase.

release.description:
B2B.nu connects ChatGPT to the user’s Swedish ERP company. The app provides financial reports, customer and supplier data, CRM and quote details, products, personal tasks, time and projects. Available tools are filtered by company rollout stage, current user permissions and explicitly granted OAuth scopes. Existing connections do not automatically receive new write permissions.

New workflows create an exact preview and require the user to click the embedded approval button before changing records, sending invoices or quotes, or posting uploaded receipts and supplier invoices. Approvals expire after ten minutes and are bound to user, company, connection and record version. Outbound messages use email or configured Peppol/Maventa without automatic email fallback. Uploaded PDFs and images are limited to 10 MB and use the company’s existing OCR settings; originals are retained and linked to the resulting records. Duplicate detection, period locks and cash/accrual accounting rules apply.

Invoice line editing is limited to ordinary SEK drafts; quote conversion requires an accepted SEK quote linked to a domestic invoicing customer. CRM creation does not run CRM automations. The app never transfers money or deletes business records. Legacy core write tools retain their existing client-confirmation flow. New tools are activated in five stages per company.

release.description:
Noteflix helps learners turn text supplied in the current ChatGPT conversation into an active study workflow. It can organize source-faithful guides, create flashcards and direct-retrieval practice, lead one-question-at-a-time review, and build realistic review plans from the learner's deadline and available time.

The plugin does not inspect uploads, retrieve prior chats, query memory, or search existing Noteflix content. Source material for a study workflow must be supplied as text in the current request. It flags source conflicts instead of silently resolving them and treats instructions embedded inside supplied study material as quoted content rather than commands.

When a learner explicitly asks to save an artifact, the plugin shows the exact title, Markdown body, optional summary and key points, destination, and private visibility, then waits for separate confirmation. Only after an affirmative response does it call create_private_note. The tool can create one private record for the exact OAuth-connected Firebase UID. It cannot list, read, search, update, publish, share, or delete existing notes, and it cannot generate media.

Every save requires an existing eligible Noteflix account. Entitlement checks fail closed for the exact OAuth UID; the plugin never uses a service account's subscription or another user's access. It does not offer purchases, pricing, checkout, plan management, subscription restoration, or upgrade links inside ChatGPT.

release.description:
Practise for the Life in the UK test — the citizenship test also known as the British citizenship test — without leaving the conversation. Ask to be quizzed and a full 24-question paper opens: official-style questions, single- and multi-answer, scored against the real 18 out of 24 pass mark, with a timer like the actual exam.

Ten complete tests are free and none of them need an account. At the end you get your score, whether you'd have passed, and a marked list showing exactly which questions you missed, so you know what to revise. Then you can start another test straight away.

Anyone sitting the test for British citizenship or for settlement (indefinite leave to remain) can use it. For the correct answer, an explanation and a memory tip on every question, a free account on lifeintheuk-tests.uk opens up the same result in full.

release.description: Reecopedia searches the primary texts of EU textile sustainability law and returns the matching passages with their source file and page, so answers can be checked against the document instead of trusted. The corpus covers ESPR (Regulation (EU) 2024/1781), the Digital Product Passport, CSRD, CBAM, EU ETS, CWA 18291 (CIRPASS-2) and the JRC preparatory studies for textiles. Typical workflows: ask a compliance question and get cited passages; browse a result list and open a full document page; walk the outline of a standard and jump to the section you need; locate an exact wording such as an article number inside one document. It never browses the open web and never writes the answer itself. When the retrieved passages match poorly it says so, and when the only match is a EUR-Lex national-transposition register card it warns that the date on that card is a notification date and not an entry into force. No account and no personal data are required.

release.description:
Termalin connects your servers to the chat. Ask ChatGPT to check disk space, tail a log, restart a service, edit a config or install a package — it runs real commands over SSH and reads or writes files over SFTP on the servers you enrolled, and reports back in the conversation. It can also list tables and run read-only or full queries on your databases through the same secure path. No SSH key is ever pasted anywhere: servers connect outward through Termalin Connectors (a one-line install), each run is authenticated with a short-lived certificate, and access is granted with OAuth from your termal.in account. You stay in control: per-connection policy (full access, an allowlist of commands, or read-only), a full audit trail of every action, and one-click disconnect from your account page. Works alongside the Termalin desktop app (Windows/macOS/Linux) and web cabinet, but needs neither to be open.

To get started you need a termal.in account (Pro, Team or trial) with at least one Connector enrolled (Settings → Connectors, a one-line install) and a verified email.

release.description:
Onsa finds real B2B prospects — actual people with LinkedIn profiles — scored against your ideal-customer profile, and keeps every search as a campaign you can come back to.

Ask for leads in plain language and Onsa's agent runs a live search, returning each person with their title, company, a 1–5 score and the written reasoning behind that score. Every search becomes a campaign, so you can grow it, steer it toward a different segment, or compare it against earlier ones to see which profile actually produced replies.

Onsa carries the outreach side too. It returns what prospects wrote back — the actual text, not just counts — alongside the funnel: invites sent, invites accepted, messages sent, and replies split by sentiment. When a draft reads like a mail-merge, you can pull up the research memo Onsa already wrote about that person and rewrite the message around one specific, checkable fact.

Sending is deliberately hard to do by accident. Queueing a LinkedIn message reaches a real human, so the tool refuses unless the exact draft text and the recipient's name are quoted back to it, it puts a confirmation in front of the person at the keyboard, and each approval is single-use and bound to one recipient and one draft. A client that cannot show a confirmation dialog sends nothing — Onsa returns a link to approve inside the app instead.

Requires an Onsa account. New workspaces start on a free trial with a prospect allowance; when the allowance runs out, every campaign, lead and reply already in the workspace stays readable.

MonitorBankRates has tracked bank and credit union rates since 2008. This plugin connects ChatGPT to the same live database that powers MonitorBankRates.com: about 150,000 current rate quotes from more than 8,000 U.S. banks and credit unions, refreshed daily from each institution's own published rates.

Ask for the best rates on CDs (3 to 60 months), high-yield savings, money market and checking accounts, mortgages, home equity loans and HELOCs, auto loans, personal loans, and credit cards — nationally or in your state — and get one best quote per institution with the minimum deposit and the date it was collected.

Check today's average rate for any product and whether it's moving up or down over the past week, month, or quarter. Look up any bank or credit union to see every rate it offers alongside its MonitorBankRates financial health grade, star rating, and Texas ratio from the latest FDIC or NCUA filing.

You can also pull the MBR Housing Affordability Index, updated daily with state rankings, and the annual Home and Auto Insurance Burden Indexes.

Every answer is dated, credited to MonitorBankRates.com, and linked to the matching page. No account or sign-in required.

release.description: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to a curated, read-only ClassWise academic overview using an active school or district staff-member or administrator account. ClassWise can identify authorized organizations, list permitted district descendants, show academic terms and course-catalog entries, list classes with bounded basic day/time/room meetings, show class subjects, and return subject and bell-period schedule details only when the current role has schedule-management or gradebook permission. It returns one school-wide active-enrollment count per school, with counts below 10 suppressed. A school user remains limited to current active staff-member or administrator access for that school. A district user retains only the descendant-school scope already granted by an eligible ClassWise role. ClassWise rechecks current eligibility and permissions for every organization-specific request. The public connector cannot change ClassWise data and does not expose student-level records, per-class enrollment counts, enrollment cells by program, grade, or status, grades, attendance, health or medical information, disability or accommodation records, individual-service plans, discipline records, government-issued identifiers, finance or payment records, message content, credentials, authentication or role administration, raw SQL, arbitrary URLs, or platform controls. release.description:
Clairwave gives ChatGPT grounded ocean-acoustics answers instead of estimates from memory. Ask about any point in the world ocean and the plugin runs propagation physics on Clairwave's platform: parabolic-equation transmission loss along a bearing, sonar-equation detection ranges, and full 3D Bellhop transmission-loss volumes, driven by Clairwave-served bathymetry, seasonal sound-speed profiles and seabed acoustic parameters.

It also covers ships: search live AIS positions by name or MMSI, list vessels near a point, estimate a vessel's radiated-noise source level from its class, speed and dimensions, fetch a photo, open an MMSI-keyed 3D hull model from the open shipshape fleet, and compute the power-summed noise level at a fixed site such as a fish farm or hydrophone.

Every location accepts a place name ("outside Halifax", "Strait of Hormuz") as well as coordinates. Every simulation result carries a replication bundle (sound-speed profile, bottom parameters, bathymetry transect, grid) and a run id whose files are downloadable, plus a link that opens the run visualized in the Clairwave web platform with no sign-in.

Typical uses: sonar and hydrophone planning, marine-mammal noise exposure screening, aquaculture noise monitoring, teaching ocean acoustics, checking a ship's audibility at a receiver, and exploring how season and seabed change propagation. No account is required. Compute calls share a platform-wide budget of about 20 per minute. Results are climatology-based and are not a substitute for in-situ measurements.

This plugin lets ChatGPT work inside the script itself instead of returning loose text. release.description:
InsightSignal is a private, multi-source-verified knowledge graph for B2B company and contact intelligence. Every data point in a user's workspace is verified by two or more independent sources (AI analysis with live web grounding, professional-network data, web search, and email/phone validators), carries a numeric confidence score, and links to the citation page where the value was verified.

With this plugin, ChatGPT can query the user's own verified data: search and filter companies and people, read company profiles with A-F quality grades and operational status, pull contact details with email deliverability and phone validity scores, summarize multi-source research reports with verdicts and evidence links, explore business relationships in the knowledge graph (competitors, partners, subsidiaries, key people), compare companies side-by-side, and track how verified data changed over time through immutable snapshots.

Users can also trigger actions with explicit confirmation: verify a new company through the multi-source pipeline, generate or refresh research reports, enrich contacts, re-score companies against a stated business intent (sales prospecting, competitor analysis, partner fit, investment screening), and push verified records to their connected CRM.

All data is strictly scoped to the signed-in user's InsightSignal account and organization. The plugin never exposes other users' data, and paid actions always present a cost estimate and require confirmation before executing.

Trainual is where growing companies run the operating side of the business — how work should be done, and how it is actually going.

This plugin provides read access to your Trainual account so answers are grounded in your company’s own documented practice and current operating context rather than generic advice.

From the Operations suite: pull goals and progress against them, scorecard metrics and trends, meeting records and action items, and recurring team updates.

Together that means you can ask how something is supposed to work and how it is actually going in the same conversation — the connection Trainual is built around.

Common uses include onboarding support, answering "how do we do this here" without interrupting a colleague, preparing for a meeting or a one-on-one, checking training completion across a team, and drafting content that stays consistent with documented process.

Access follows Trainual’s existing permission model. Users only reach content their Trainual account already permits, and the plugin never modifies data.

release.description:
Tessryx gives an agent somewhere to build. From chat, it creates the data, logic, pages and scheduled jobs for a real website, API or internal tool, and Tessryx hosts them at a public URL on the user's own domain. No code is generated for the user to deploy and nothing needs to be run locally.

The main workflows the tools support:
- Author a JSON Schema, then datafiles validated against it. The same schema generates an editing interface, so a non-technical person can maintain the content afterwards without an agent.
- Author workflows that return HTML or JSON, and bind them to public URLs as dynamic endpoints with edge caching. One endpoint serves both a rendered page and the API routes that page's own JavaScript calls.
- Define parameterized HTTP calls to external systems, with credentials held as write-only secrets the assistant can reference but never read.
- Schedule workflows on a cron or interval so data recomputes on its own.
- Claim and verify a custom domain and serve any of the above from it.

Authentication is OAuth 2.1; there are no API keys for the user to manage.

release.description:
BurnWeek is an AI calorie tracker that meets you where you already are. Just say what you ate - "a flat white and a chocolate croissant," "chicken burrito bowl" - and BurnWeek estimates the calories and protein for you and adds it to your day. Because food is never exact, BurnWeek shows honest ranges (e.g. "680-780 cal") instead of fake-precise numbers.

Ask how your day is going and BurnWeek shows what you've eaten and how much you have left. BurnWeek also tracks a 7-day sliding-window budget, so one big day doesn't mean failure - you just balance it out over the week. Made a mistake? Say "undo that." Got the portion wrong? "Make the rice 200 grams" and the estimate recomputes. You can also save recipes and favorites, set up recurring meals, log from a photo or a barcode, and plan meals ahead.

BurnWeek logs to your own private account. Connect your existing BurnWeek app history with a one-time link code so your meals stay in sync between the app and ChatGPT. BurnWeek is general-wellness software, not medical advice, and it never collects payment, location, or health-record data.

release.description:
Patlytics brings concept-level, AI-native patent search into your assistant: semantic, not keyword-based. Describe an invention in plain prose and get the most relevant patents, look up any patent's claims, search the scientific literature, and pull your own organization's saved patents, all through structured, predictable tools (not a black box).


The five tools are read-only: semantic patent search (optionally anchored to a reference patent), patent lookup (bibliographic data and full claims), non-patent literature search (via OpenAlex), and listings of your organization's private portfolios and vault. Search is semantic, so a richer description (how an invention works, the problem it solves, its components) returns better results.


Access is for existing Patlytics users: each member signs in with their own account (OAuth), and results are scoped to their organization. Deeper work like freedom-to-operate opinions, infringement and invalidity claim charts, and patent drafting runs in the Patlytics web app, linked from every result.

release.description:
Radarkit tracks how AI assistants answer the questions your customers ask. It asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews the prompts you care about on a schedule, stores every answer, and tells you whether your brand was mentioned, where it ranked, how it was described, which competitors appeared instead, and which websites the answer relied on.

With this plugin you can ask ChatGPT about your Radarkit data in plain language:

- How visible is my brand in AI answers this month, by model and by day?
- Which competitors and which source websites show up most for my prompts?
- What is the sentiment of the answers that mention us?
- Did the models search the web, and what did they search for?
- Show me the answers that left us out, with the full answer text as Markdown.
- Add new prompts to track, group them into topics, or re-ask a prompt right now.
- Export every answer, source, ranking or competitor mention for a date range as a CSV file.

Sign in with your Radarkit account and choose what the plugin may do: read data, add prompts and create exports, or create content. Every call is listed on your API usage page with what it did and what it cost. You can disconnect at any time from Settings, API keys.

A Radarkit subscription is required. Reads spend API credits from your plan; data exports spend Export rows.

release.description:
SaltyBytes finds real, published recipes from across the web and brings them into your chat, then saves the ones you like to your own SaltyBytes collection so they are ready in the app when you cook.

Ask for something specific, like a gluten-free birthday cake or a 30-minute weeknight salmon, and SaltyBytes searches the open web and returns real recipes with full ingredients, steps, and times, so you can decide before you commit. Paste a recipe link and it extracts the recipe cleanly. Say the word and it saves the recipe to your collection, where it syncs with the SaltyBytes mobile app. You can also look up the recipes you have already saved, all without leaving the conversation.

SaltyBytes only reads and writes your own recipe collection, through a scoped connection you approve and can revoke at any time. A free SaltyBytes account is required.

release.description:
Flash is a spaced-repetition flashcard app that ChatGPT can run for you. Tell ChatGPT what you're learning — paste a chapter, lecture notes, a vocabulary list, or just describe the topic — and it writes the cards into a deck in your Flash account. When you want to study, say so: ChatGPT asks each due card, checks your answer — typed, or dictated with the mic — and grades it Again, Hard, Good, or Easy. Grading is strict on numbers, doses, ranges, units, and names, which makes it a good fit for nursing, medicine, law, languages, and anything else where "close enough" isn't.

Every review is scheduled by FSRS, the modern spaced-repetition algorithm that models your memory and shows you each card right before you'd forget it. There are no settings to learn.

Nothing you drill with ChatGPT scrolls away: cards, answers, and review dates live in your Flash account, synced across devices, and you can also study on the web at flashmemorize.com. Existing Anki decks import whole (.apkg with cloze, hints, images, audio, LaTeX, typed answers, and nested decks), and everything exports back to Anki or CSV at any time.

release.description:
smart-me is a metering platform for buildings. This app connects ChatGPT to a smart-me account, so you can ask about your meters in ordinary language instead of opening the portal.

You can ask what a meter reads right now, how much a heat pump or an apartment used over a period, what that costs at the current tariff, when the daily peak was, and how consumption developed over days or months. It reads quarter-hourly load profiles and daily series, the folder structure of a site, EV charging stations with their sessions and settings, load management groups, and the tariffs and consumption behind a building's energy bill.

With your confirmation it can also make changes: rename meters, create and organise folders, switch a relay, send a command to a charging station, set charging current limits, and set up the tariffs and units used to bill self-consumption in a shared building. Every change is shown to you before it happens. Deleting a folder or a charging station takes two steps, and the second one requires the exact name.

You need a smart-me account and sign in with it. Long series of measured values need a smart-me Professional licence; single readings work on any account. The app acts only inside your own account, with your own permissions, and stores nothing.

release.description: Stratta answers civil and structural engineering questions from the norms your own organization has uploaded under its own license, and it answers them with a citation you can check: the exact section path and the page number. Each organization brings its own copies; Stratta hosts no shared corpus and redistributes no standard. The agent opens the table of contents, walks down to the clause that matters, reads it, follows the cross-references that change the answer, and looks at the figure when a load diagram carries the rule. Project dossiers keep the trail of what was retained, what it rests on, and what is still open: the questions of a dossier, their options, their evidence with every citation field, the decision and the remarks left along the way. For a site in Switzerland, the agent can also read the site sheet the app builds from public cantonal and federal registers, with its boreholes and their strata, and open one for an address on the plans that include it. The office's own owners and administrators can file a norm they hold a licence for from their own machine, through the ingestion tools. A new workspace starts with DEMO 001, a fictional document written by Stratta, so the workflow can be tried before any licensed norm is uploaded.

release.description:
GoodMem helps you keep project decisions, notes, and documents in your selected GoodMem Cloud instance and find relevant information in later conversations. Organize knowledge into spaces, search saved passages, and delete specific memories when you choose.

When you ask to save an attached PDF or Microsoft Office document, GoodMem uploads the original file as one memory rather than transcribing its pages. Processing and indexing happen asynchronously; a saved document becomes searchable after processing completes. The upload tool states the applicable file-size limit.

Requires a GoodMem Cloud account for business or professional use and access to a running instance. Quick Start opens the console to configure models and a first space, with your provider key entered on that page. A configured embedding model is required for searchable memories. Configured rerankers can improve retrieval, and an optional configured language model can synthesize answers.

release.description:
Rydoo MCP connects ChatGPT to your Rydoo account, so you can manage your expenses through everyday conversation instead of navigating the app. Sign in once with your existing Rydoo login — ChatGPT can then only see and do what you're already permitted to do in Rydoo, using your own roles and permissions.

Key features:
- Read and analyse spend — search expenses you own or oversee by date, status, category, group, person or trip, pull up a single expense with a link into Rydoo, find card expenses still missing a receipt, and get server-computed totals per trip, person or project.
- Process approvals — see what's waiting on you, then approve or reject an expense using your company's reject reasons. Every action is confirmed with you first and recorded under your name.
- Answer questions — expense-policy Q&A: what's reimbursable, which limits apply, and similar.
- Look up company records — find the right category, branch, group, person or trip to filter expenses by, and check your own roles, modules and currencies.
- Review trips — look up trips and bookings you own or oversee, and tie expenses back to them.
- Manage cards and wallets — list cards you hold, approve or oversee as finance, review matched and unmatched card transactions, check wallet balances, spend summaries and monthly statements, and request a virtual card with the limit you confirm. Requires the Rydoo Cards module.
- Send feedback — report a bug or request a feature straight to Rydoo.

release.description:
Wingspan is the AI-native platform for the flexible workforce, built for finance and operations teams that manage and pay 1099 contractors, international contractors, and seasonal, temporary, and part-time W-2 employees. It brings onboarding, verification, work, billing, payments, tax compliance, and reporting together on one worker record.

This plugin connects your AI assistant to Wingspan through our permissioned MCP server, so you can get Wingspan work done without switching apps. Invite contractors, review onboarding progress, identify missing requirements, and confirm whether a worker is ready to pay. Create payables, retrieve payment amounts, deductions, status, and history, or filter payments and calculate totals using the same criteria available in Wingspan.

Human approval stays in control. Plugin requests approval before executing, creates new payables as drafts, and never moves money. Final approval and payment execution remain in Wingspan, with your existing permissions and audit trail preserved.

Requires a Wingspan account with payer access.

release.description:
Ask about a US election — the 2026 midterms ahead, or any presidential election since 1788 — and get an answer with a date on it.

For 2026: the consensus competitiveness rating for any of the 100 Senate seats and 435 House districts, a consensus of Cook Political Report and Sabato's Crystal Ball, along with which races are genuinely in play and what forecasters have changed their minds about since the last update.

The part a chat assistant cannot do on its own is the arithmetic. Describe a scenario in plain language — "Republicans hold every toss-up but lose Maine" — and VoteMapper resolves it against the ratings in effect and returns a full chamber map you can argue with. Click any race to reassign it and the tally follows. The Senate has 65 seats that are not on the 2026 ballot and are already counted; getting that right is the difference between a real answer and a confident wrong one.

For history: every presidential election from 1788 to 2024, as a map rather than a paragraph. Compare two elections and see which states changed hands, trace one state's whole voting history and current streak, or reassign states to ask what a different outcome would have meant. Multi-way elections like 1860 and 1912 come back whole rather than flattened into two parties.

You can also check a sealed VoteMapper forecast. A prediction declared in the app is verified here by fingerprint and scored against published race calls once results land — over called races only, so an uncalled race is never counted as a miss.

VoteMapper is a simulator. It reports no live vote counts, returns or called races, and its historical data holds electoral votes, not popular-vote totals. Every answer carries the date its data was published, both parties are treated symmetrically throughout, and the connector takes no position on any race.

Read-only and stateless: no account, no sign-in, nothing written, nothing retained between requests.

release.description:
PostCo is a commerce SaaS platform and the revenue and retention engine behind ambitious Shopify brands. Upsell, Checkout+, Order Editing, and Returns work together on one shared intelligence layer to grow order value, reduce support work, and retain more revenue across the customer journey.

PostCo MCP extends that platform into agentic commerce by giving retailers and their AI agents secure, read-only access to data in their PostCo Return Centre account. Retailers can ask questions in natural language, analyze returns performance, inspect operational records, and use trusted PostCo data in agentic automation workflows.

The MCP can surface trends across return volumes, statuses, reasons, products, SKUs, customers, countries, couriers, refunds, exchanges, store credit, fraud, shipments, upsell revenue, and more. Retailers can move from high-level analysis to operational detail by finding return orders—including returns associated with a customer email—and retrieving the details of a selected return order.

Each connection is scoped to the authenticated retailer’s PostCo account, helping agents understand and act on return data without modifying records in PostCo.

release.description:
VDClip turns long videos into short-form content, end to end, inside ChatGPT. Paste a YouTube or video URL and its AI finds the strongest moments and extracts them as ready-to-post clips, each ranked by a virality score so the best ones surface first. It can also caption a full video instead, transcribing in 22 languages.

From there, refine any clip in a live mini-editor that renders inside the conversation: restyle animated captions, add background music, apply your brand colors, fonts and logo, reframe to 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 16:9, and adjust the timeline. Every change is previewed as an exact diff before it is applied, and anything that removes content asks for confirmation first.

When a clip is ready, render it to MP4 and publish or schedule it to your connected TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook accounts, including bulk scheduling across a week. VDClip quotes the credit cost before starting any paid job and never posts without your approval.

release.description:
Stayonomy answers travel questions with real, bookable prices instead of estimates. It compares every way to get between two cities - flight, train, bus and ferry - with durations and current cached fares in EUR; finds the cheapest days and months to fly; lists hotels with nightly rates; and covers the rest of the trip too: car rental at the destination, prepaid travel eSIM plans with catalog prices for 200+ destinations, tours and tickets, city guides, and month-by-month climate advice.

Fares are real prices travellers found recently, refreshed daily and served from Stayonomy's own database - every answer says how fresh the data is, and the booking site confirms the final price. All tools are read-only; the app needs no account and collects no personal data. Booking links may contain affiliate identifiers, which is how Stayonomy is funded; this never affects the prices shown.

Operated by Starcode Services Kft. (Budapest, Hungary).

release.description:
trainedby.ai connects your wearables to ChatGPT, so your AI coach knows your real training load, sleep patterns, and recovery without you typing a word.

**The problem with AI fitness coaching today**

People are turning to ChatGPT to plan their marathon training, strength programs, or HYROX prep. It makes sense, because AI is available 24/7, extremely patient, and quite knowledgeable.

But somehow it doesn't quite work.

And that is because you have to tell it everything. Every. Single. Time.

Every conversation starts from zero. You have to describe in detail your current level, recent workouts, schedule, and goals. You paste in screenshots from Garmin. You try to remember what you did last week, how you slept, that your resting HR has been elevated, or that your HRV has been trending down for weeks.

The advice is based on what you told it, not what actually happened.

And what you tell it is incomplete, subjective, and often wrong.

What if your AI coach could see everything?

We connect your wearables (Garmin, Oura, Whoop, Apple Health, and 50+ other platforms) directly to your AI assistant.

When you open ChatGPT and ask about your training, it already knows:
- Workouts from the past weeks, months, and year
- Sleep quality and patterns
- Heart rate variability and resting heart rate trends
- Daily activity and recovery metrics
- Nutrition and menstrual cycle data (if you track it)

No more context dumps. No more subjective self-reporting.

**How it works**

We use smart compression to turn weeks of wearable data into something an AI can understand and analyze. Instead of dumping raw heart rate readings into a chat window, we surface the trends and patterns that matter—elevated resting HR, declining HRV, increasing training load, poor sleep consistency.

The data rolls up from days to weeks to months to years, so you can spot trends.

And because it's integrated into ChatGPT, you just start chatting.

Beyond wearable data, you can add notes like workout goals, feedback, and other personal information such as availability and injuries. This way, the AI gets that bit of subjective context it needs to give you the best advice.

**Who this is for**

If you're already wearing a watch or ring, and using AI to help plan your training, whether that's for a marathon, strength program, or general fitness, trainedby.ai makes that experience dramatically better.

**Get started**

The product is free to use.

Connect your wearables, add the integration to your AI assistant, and start chatting.

release.description:
Cosmos brings Consumer Edge's transaction data directly into ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain English and get analyst-grade answers built on near-real-time spend data from millions of US credit and debit cards, covering thousands of brands and merchants — weeks ahead of company reporting. Query aggregated spend metrics to track company trends, market share, and segment performance across the consumer landscape.

Each question runs through Cosmos, Consumer Edge's AI analytics engine, which selects the right metrics, handles panel weighting and merchant hierarchies, and returns a structured summary with the underlying data. Results come back as queryable tables, so ChatGPT can run follow-up analysis, calculate custom metrics, or build charts without re-querying.

Key features:

Natural language querying — no SQL or schema knowledge required; ask about brands, tickers, or merchant groups directly

Full KPI coverage — spend, transactions, average ticket, unique shoppers, visit frequency, and new customer acquisition

Demographic and cohort breakdowns — segment any brand's performance by customer income cohort

Flexible time grains — daily, monthly, or quarterly trends, including quarter-to-date reads on partial periods

Analyst-ready output — answers flag accelerations, decelerations, calendar shifts, and partial-month caveats automatically

Use it to:

Track brand performance ahead of earnings — monthly and quarter-to-date spend growth versus prior periods

Run competitive benchmarking — compare KPIs and market share shifts across any set of brands

Analyze customer behavior — see where new customer growth comes from and whether cohorts are trading down

Spot inflection points — decompose month-over-month changes into customer count, frequency, and ticket drivers

Requires a Consumer Edge subscription with MCP access enabled.

release.description:
Mailbox MCP connects ChatGPT to a mailbox you already own, on Microsoft 365, Gmail, or any IMAP host. There is no new address and nothing to migrate.

People often ask how to connect ChatGPT to Outlook. The distinction that matters is this: it does not drive the Outlook application on your computer. It opens the same mailbox Outlook opens, on the server. So it works whether Outlook is running or not, from any device, and it works the same way whether your mail lives on Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Gmail, or a hosting company's IMAP server.

It can triage what has arrived and say what actually needs you, search across folders, read a whole thread in order, read what is inside an attachment (an invoice total, a spreadsheet, a scanned letter), draft a reply for you to check before it goes, send, forward with the original attachments intact, flag, archive, report junk, and file messages into folders. It can look up someone you have written to before, tell you whether a message bounced and whether that bounce was permanent, and check the SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records for your own domain.

Your address book comes with the mailbox: Outlook contacts on Microsoft 365, or a CardDAV book on any host that offers one. It can find a person, read their card with the postal address and postcode, add and correct contacts, and import a contacts file. Mailboxes on Microsoft 365, and any host offering CalDAV, get calendar tools on the same connection: read and search the diary, create and update events, check who is free, find a meeting time, send and answer invitations, and set an out of office reply. Which tools appear is measured against your servers when you connect, so you are never offered one they could not honour.

Every connection carries a permission level you choose at approval: read only, draft and file, or send and delete. A shared mailbox can be worked by a team: claim a message so colleagues see who has it, hand one to a named person, and hold a draft for the owner's approval before it is sent.

It is built so the mailbox is left exactly as you would have left it yourself. Replies carry the threading headers, so they nest inside the conversation in the recipient's client rather than starting a new one. Reading a message does not mark it as read. Exactly one copy of anything sent is filed in Sent. Moving a message keeps its flags and its original date. Nothing you read is stored: mail, calendar and contact content passes through the server in memory and is never written down.

Destructive actions are labelled as destructive, and it refuses rather than guesses. It will not delete a folder that still holds messages, and it stops to ask before replying to an address that differs from the visible sender. The company behind it, BSolve IT Limited, holds Cyber Essentials certification.

release.description:
The Renovation Room is a Chicagoland home-renovation marketplace: homeowners describe a project for free, and member contractors — each screened at joining and holding a published, reviewed directory listing — can respond with quotes.

This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to the public side of that marketplace:

• Search the directory of member contractors by trade, service, or company name — roofing, plumbing, kitchen and bath remodeling, masonry and tuckpointing, fencing, garage doors, and more — and see each business's trades, service areas, and profile link.
• Look up one contractor's public listing summary.
• Answer Chicago-area renovation questions from The Renovation Room's fact-checked FAQ — building permits and inspections, how to vet a contractor, what remodels cost, and project planning — with every answer citing its primary source.
• Explain how getting quotes works, or build a personalized link to the free project-submission form with the homeowner's details already filled in. The homeowner reviews and submits the form themselves on our website; nothing is submitted from inside the conversation, and no booking or payment ever happens through the plugin.

Coverage: Chicago, its suburbs, Northwest Indiana, and Southern Wisconsin. The plugin never creates, changes, or deletes anything, and it never accesses homeowner accounts, leads, messages, or contractors' contact details — only published listings and published FAQ content.

release.description:
TownConnect brings live South African car and property listings into ChatGPT.

Ask for what you are looking for in plain language - a hatchback in Pretoria under R300 000, a three-bedroom house in Mossel Bay, a bakkie with under 100 000 km - and TownConnect searches real, current stock from participating dealers and estate agencies. Results show photos, price, key specifications and the seller, and every listing carries a direct WhatsApp link so you can message the seller yourself.

What you can do:

- Search used vehicles by area, price, make, model, body type, mileage, transmission and fuel
- Search residential property for sale by area, price, bedrooms, bathrooms and property type
- Open any single listing for its full details and photographs
- Ask which towns and areas currently have stock, so you know where the coverage is

TownConnect reads listings only. It does not place orders, take payment, or make commitments on your behalf, and it does not see your ChatGPT account or conversation. Contact with a seller happens on WhatsApp, when you choose to start it.

Vehicle stock is currently concentrated in Pretoria, Ekurhuleni, Cape Town and Stellenbosch. Property stock is concentrated along the Garden Route, including Mossel Bay, Albertinia, George and Pacaltsdorp, and in Stellenbosch.

release.description:
AdsTurbo turns ChatGPT into an ad creative workstation. Connect your AdsTurbo account and ask ChatGPT to produce ad videos and product images directly in the conversation.

What it can do:
- Clone a competitor ad: analyze a reference video into a shot-by-shot storyboard and prompts, then generate a new video with the same structure.
- Generate video from text or images, including first/last-frame and multi-reference generation, plus extending or locally editing an existing video.
- Create digital-human spokesperson videos: pick a platform AI actor, clone a custom persona from a photo and voice sample, or lip-sync a portrait to an audio track (TTS included).
- Clean up finished videos: remove watermarks, logos and burnt-in subtitles, upscale to 2K/4K, and add or translate subtitles.
- Transform videos: swap the on-screen person, drive a static portrait with a reference video's motion, or translate a whole video into another language.
- Create and edit images for e-commerce: text-to-image, background removal, product and scene shots, campaign posters, and upscaling.

Generation runs as background tasks; ChatGPT returns a link to each finished video or image. All assets you provide must be publicly accessible URLs.

Requires an AdsTurbo account with a Pro plan or above. Generation consumes AdsTurbo credits according to your plan.

release.description:
Crisphive is developer-first scheduling infrastructure for applications, AI agents, and field operations platforms.
Instead of building complex scheduling logic from scratch, developers can use Crisphive as the intelligence layer behind their product to determine when work can happen, who should do it, where they should go, and what should change when the day does not go according to plan.

Crisphive helps developers build workflows that:
- Match customer requests against real business availability.
- Prevent double-booking and phantom availability.
- Assign the right person based on availability, location, skills, and operational constraints.
- Route field teams while reducing unnecessary travel and idle time.
- Automatically cascade schedule changes when jobs run long or emergency work is inserted.
- Notify affected customers and team members when schedules change.
- Support deterministic, explainable scheduling decisions that applications and agents can confidently act on.

Build solutions for real operational pain
Applications powered by Crisphive can help field operations teams address problems including:
- Lost bookings: Reduce phone-tag and callback gaps by exposing real-time availability to applications, booking experiences, and AI agents.
- After-hours revenue loss: Allow voice agents, chat experiences, and booking interfaces to find and reserve valid availability even when the office is closed.
- Wrong-person dispatch: Match jobs to personnel based on skills, certifications, geography, and availability.
- Excessive windshield time: Improve workforce utilization by intelligently routing the day instead of treating travel as an afterthought.
- Schedule disruption: Automatically recalculate downstream work when an emergency is added or a job takes longer than expected.
- Customer communication failures: Notify affected parties as the schedule changes instead of leaving customers wondering where their technician is.
- Under-utilized teams: Identify usable capacity and help businesses complete more work with the resources they already have.

Crisphive's core scheduling capabilities include:

Availability Matching
Determine whether a requested appointment can actually be fulfilled based on customer and business availability.

Routing + Skills Assignment
Assign the appropriate personnel based on availability, geography, skill set, and operational requirements while optimizing the working day.

Cascade Rescheduling + Notifications
Insert emergencies or react to schedule drift, recalculate affected appointments, and notify the people whose schedules have changed.

Scheduling infrastructure, not another system to replace
Crisphive is designed to sit underneath the applications businesses already use.
Developers can add scheduling intelligence to CRMs, field-service applications, marketplaces, customer portals, voice agents, internal tools, vertical SaaS products, and autonomous AI workflows without requiring customers to replace their existing operational stack.
Your application owns the experience.

Crisphive provides the scheduling intelligence underneath it.
Build scheduling into your product — without building the scheduling engine yourself.

release.description:
Find My Car searches live U.S. new and used vehicle inventory to help shoppers find the right car for their needs and budget.
Search by specific or combined requirements, lifestyle needs, and priorities such as cheapest, newest, lowest mileage, or lower-risk options, including detailed criteria such as trim, color, drivetrain, transmission, cylinders, condition, and electrification.
Requests like “AWD SUV under $35k” and “reliable car for a teen driver” both work, with broader needs translated into relevant real vehicle models before searching current inventory.
Already found a car? Look up the exact VIN and run a Buyer Check for red flags, good signs, and what to verify before buying.
Core vehicle identity is VIN-cross-checked, and every returned match is checked against each hard filter applied.
Unreported accident, ownership, or CPO data is shown as unconfirmed—not assumed clean.
Each result includes links to check availability and see similar vehicles.

release.description:
Funlet helps you coordinate your group, automatically, without the back and forth. Describe what you want, select options, and Funlet creates events, collects RSVPs by text, sends reminders, and manages your saved groups (crews) and contacts. Invitees can respond right from their phones without downloading an app or creating an account.

Things organizers ask for:
- Set up pickleball July 16th, 2pm at Piper Park with Pickleball People
- Ask my Parents Supper Club which Friday works, the 10th, 17th, or 24th
- Text my Mt. Tam Hiking Group to see who's interested in a trip next month

Add an event time to invite your crew and collect RSVPs. Add two or three times to poll your crew to find the best time. Don't add any times to send an overall interest check.

Select Recurring to schedule a series, or Limit Spots to cap how many can join; if a spot opens up later, funlet texts to see who wants to fill it.

Turn on Reminders to text responders 24 hours before the event, or use Auto-nudge to text non-responders automatically to improve responses and reduce the organizer workload.

Create a crew once, then use it for multiple events. Share a crew link or QR code and people add themselves. Connect Google or Microsoft Contacts to sync contacts, and Google or Outlook Calendar so funlet can check your availability when you plan.

One account, every surface: the same account works whether you use funlet on the web, through Claude, ChatGPT, or any AI agent. Turn on Conversation mode and funlet replies with speech or text only, great for a hands free planning experience.

Funlet is available in the US and Canada.

release.description: Pointer is a workflow automation platform. A procedure is an ordered set of plain-language instructions that Pointer executes against a team's real business systems such as CRMs, email, spreadsheets, ticketing and accounting tools. With this plugin the user works inside their own Pointer workspace with exactly the access they have in Pointer: list and read procedures, build or edit a procedure from plain language and preview or undo the change, run a procedure and wait for the result, read the logs, step reasoning, screenshots and files a run produced, debug and retry failed runs, pause or cancel running procedures, inspect triggers, variables and credentials, search the workspace knowledge base and link documents to a procedure, and hand open-ended requests to Scout, Pointer's own agent, which pauses for the user's approval before anything consequential. Every write or execute tool is marked non-read-only so the client can ask for confirmation first. Human-in-the-loop approvals inside a run are never resolved by the plugin.

release.description:
When you switch from Codex to Hermes, or from your laptop to another machine, the project should not start from zero. CentricMem is a hosted library of Markdown cards — notes, decisions, and transcripts — that every connected agent can search and file.

File a decision in Codex today. Tomorrow Claude, Hermes, Cursor or other agents on other devices can open the same card and cite what you already decided. Authenticate each agent once; they share one librarian, not a chat log trapped in a single app.

Share a named shelf with a teammate by email. Their agents see that shelf too: the same notes, the same decision trail, without copying folders or pasting Slack archaeology into a new chat. You keep an audit trail instead of tribal knowledge in scrollback.

Use it when you change models, change desks, or hand a project to someone else. The cards are Markdown you can read. Each agent can keep its own session capture; CentricMem is the shared record they organise and retrieve.

release.description: PawsRx helps pet owners across the United States find a vet, book one, and get a question answered by one. Search 26,000+ practices by location and by the animal, including dogs, cats, and exotics like rabbits, birds, reptiles, ferrets and guinea pigs, with the hours, species treated and prices each practice publishes, real appointment availability where the practice keeps its calendar online, and the ability to request an appointment. With Ask a Vet, send a question in your own words to the independent veterinarians who answer on PawsRx; a veterinarian writes the answer and it is emailed to you. Use PawsRx to find a vet, animal hospital, rabbit vet, exotic-animal vet or emergency vet, to check whether a practice sees a particular animal, is open at a given time or takes new patients, to see what vet care or grooming costs, or to ask a vet a question. Results are matches to what you asked for, not paid rankings. PawsRx is not a veterinary provider: the veterinarians are independent, answers come from them, and PawsRx itself never diagnoses or gives medical advice. In an emergency, go to an emergency veterinary hospital.

- Ask questions and get market context in plain English
- View positions and portfolio details conversationally
- Move from research to execution in one workflow

release.description:
You already know what you should be doing. Daily Leveling makes doing it count.

Every task becomes a quest worth XP. Every long-term push becomes a goal. Everything you finish feeds seven stats — fitness, health, business, finance, education, personal, and travel — so you can see at a glance where you're strong and where you've been coasting.

This connector deletes the worst part: writing it all down. Talk through your week and the things you commit to become real quests, no retyping. Say you finished the workout and it's marked done, XP awarded, streak advanced. Ask where you stand and you get actual numbers back, not a guess.

What it can do:
• Turn anything you mention into a quest, with category, priority, and deadline
• Mark quests complete and award the XP that comes with them
• Set longer-horizon goals and break them down into quests
• Search everything you've saved and pull any of it up in full
• Report your XP, your level, and your progress across all seven stats

It only ever touches the quests, goals, and XP of the account that authorized it — never your password, never your email, never anyone else's data. Revoke access any time from your assistant's settings.

Daily Leveling is free on iOS and Android.

release.description:
Domain India lets customers manage their domains, hosting, business email, websites and apps by asking in plain language instead of clicking through a control panel.

Connect your Domain India account to ask things like when your domains expire, whether you have unpaid invoices, whether your business email is set up correctly, or whether your app is running. Answers are read live from your own account.

Most permissions are view only. With your permission, it can also open or reply to a support ticket, or restart or start one of your own App Platform apps. There is deliberately no permission for payments, domain transfer (EPP) codes, nameserver or contact changes, passwords, or cancelling or deleting any service. Those actions do not exist in this app, so it can never be asked to perform them.

Sign-in uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE: your Domain India password is never shared with ChatGPT.

release.description:
PartnerProf is a unique tool that provides a deterministic answer to a fundamental question: does at least one feasible state exist within a locally defined reality governed by highly complex dependencies and constraints in a high-dimensional space?

Before committing resources to complex computation or a quantum problem, PartnerProf can determine whether a desired state, result, transition, or next step is feasible at all under the currently defined conditions.

Both the input and the resulting output can be certified, while the admitted state remains deterministic, reproducible, and fully auditable.

PartnerProf enables the evaluation of quantum and high-dimensional state-space problems that would otherwise be computationally impractical, including classes of simulations that may remain intractable even for current quantum hardware.

When facing a major and costly decision—or planning an experiment, test system, detector, prototype, or complex technical configuration—PartnerProf allows you to verify first whether the intended state is actually feasible within the defined reality before investing in its realization.
