release.description:
Nanga is the B2B marketing analytics platform built by Spark (Paris), used by e-commerce and lead generation companies to follow their advertising, creative and SEO performance.

This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to your existing Nanga account, for one company chosen when you connect, under your own Nanga permissions. Ask ChatGPT about your advertising: spend, ROAS, CPA and the other metrics your company defines, computed with your own definitions; what moved between two periods and which campaign or platform carries a deterioration; whether data really landed for every platform before you compare; how the account is doing over a period against the previous one; where you stand among comparable companies, anonymously; and what your online store collected next to advertising spend. ChatGPT can also read your saved dashboard analyses and your company context.

Figures are computed by Nanga, not by ChatGPT, and every answer carries its dates, units and definitions. A metric Nanga cannot compute for your company is named as such, never shown as a zero.

You choose what ChatGPT may read when you connect: company context, recent advertising figures and online store sales are three separate permissions. The connector never writes: it changes no campaign, generates no analysis and creates no account. You can revoke access at any time from your Nanga account or from ChatGPT.

An existing Nanga account is required, and your company must have the connector enabled by the Nanga team.

release.description:
Polypo connects your Polypo account to ChatGPT so shopping questions are answered with your own body instead of generic assumptions.

See it on you — send a product link or a photo of a garment and Polypo renders you actually wearing it, shown as an image in the conversation. It works from a link, from a photo on your device, or on one of Polypo's house models if you would rather not use a photo of yourself. It can wear a top and a bottom together, a whole outfit as it comes, or just the piece you asked for, and stack accessories on top — a bag, a belt, a scarf, sunglasses, several at once, each placed the way you say — and you choose which of your photos it is rendered on.

Get the size right — paste a brand's size chart, or drop in a screenshot of one, and Polypo works out which size fits: your measurements against the garment's on every dimension the brand lists, and how the other sizes scored. It remembers what it told you, so "what size am I in Zara" has an answer next time, and you can say how something actually fitted.

Your measurements — your stored girths and lengths in centimetres, from your Polypo avatar, whenever you want to check them.

Your wardrobe — garments you have sent or tried on are kept, so wearing one again is a tap rather than another upload, and your past try-ons stay where you can find them.

Sign in with your Polypo account. If you do not have an avatar yet, signing in walks you through creating one — that is where your measurements and your photos come from.

Privacy and control: Polypo only ever reaches the account you sign in with, over an OAuth-protected connection, and cannot see anyone else's data. It renders you on your own photos — there is no way to look up or render another person. The photos you send, the garments you keep, the sizes you were given and the renders themselves are stored on your Polypo account, and you can remove a photo, a garment or a try-on from the conversation at any time; your profile, avatar and measurements are managed at customer.polypo.io. Rendering a try-on, and reading a size chart out of a screenshot, are carried out by Google Cloud (Vertex AI) as our processor. Images are served over links that expire.

release.description:
WEM answers one question an assistant cannot answer on its own: is this actually the price you should pay?

Ask for a product — by name, by barcode, or by pasting a WEM product link — and WEM returns every retailer offer it can verify for that exact item, cheapest first, with the 90-day price low so you can tell a real discount from a repackaged one. Identity is resolved by GS1 barcode rather than by matching titles, so the offers you see are the same product, not a lookalike, an accessory, or a different size.

WEM compares live prices from authorised partner feeds and marketplace APIs it is licensed to use. It ranks on price and on the priorities you state — never on what any retailer pays WEM. It carries no advertisements, and affiliate commission is not an input to comparison ranking.

Checkout for compared products happens on the retailer's own site, at the retailer's price — WEM never handles payment, your card or your personal details for those purchases. WEM is free to use and funded by disclosed affiliate commission, disclosed on the card itself and at wem3.ai/disclosure.

What it will not do is guess. When WEM cannot verify a second price, it says so instead of inventing one.

release.description:
Moonwalk is where you write boards: pages that hold text alongside live tables, charts and interactive widgets, which you can keep private or publish as a public page. This plugin lets ChatGPT write and maintain those boards with you, and build the data and machinery behind them.

What ChatGPT can do with it:
- Boards: read, search and write pages, reorganize them, and publish a board as a public page.
- Data for your boards: create tables, read and write rows, and run read-only SQL queries whose results show live on a board.
- Widgets: build interactive screens (charts, forms, dashboards) that sit on a board, and see a picture of what it built.
- Automations: create workflows in Python that keep a board's data current, running on a schedule, from a webhook or by hand, and read each run's results.
- Files: browse, search, read and edit the files in your base, and upload new ones.
- Connections: see which third-party accounts and keys your base holds, and ask you to add one. ChatGPT never sees or types a secret; you enter it in Moonwalk.

Safe to hand to an agent:
- Everything ChatGPT changes is recorded as yours, with ChatGPT noted as the agent.
- Deleted boards, tables, widgets, automations and files go to a 30-day trash and can be restored.
- Edits are versioned, and a batch of row changes can be undone in one step.

Requires a Moonwalk account (sign up at moonwalk.now). You sign in and approve access on Moonwalk's own screen, and can revoke it at any time from Moonwalk's Agents page.

release.description:
Bond Memory lets ChatGPT make choices grounded in your real preferences, past experiences, and the facts you have shared with Bond.

ChatGPT never receives a copy of your memory. It asks Bond a question and gets back a judgment with reasoning written for you. Three tools are available:

- Pick for you: give ChatGPT a few options (restaurants, products, movies, gifts, plans) and it picks the one you are most likely to prefer, and explains why.
- Worth telling you: before ChatGPT surfaces a deal, event, or find you did not ask about, it can check whether it clears your personal bar.
- Personalize a search: rewrites a search query around your tastes while keeping your intent and location intact, so the results ChatGPT searches for fit you.

Access is read-only. Nothing ChatGPT does through Bond Memory can change or delete anything in Bond.

To connect, you need the Bond iOS app installed and signed in. Approval happens on your phone: Bond shows a QR code in your browser, you scan it, and tap Approve in the app. No password is entered on the web.

You can disconnect every connected assistant at once from Settings in the Bond app.

Bond is a personal memory app for iOS. Learn more at bond.now/docs/mcp.

release.description:
Connect your Northeast Telemetry customer account to ask questions about the equipment, systems, spaces, and properties you monitor.

Review current sensor readings, historical trends, and available recent device alarms across your authorized dashboards. Ask for a short explanation or detailed calculations, units, dates, and data limitations. Available information depends on your installed sensors, published dashboard configuration, permissions, and retained history.

Explore changes over time with interactive charts and bounded historical analysis. Broad periods use sampled charts and server-side summaries rather than returning every data point. Exact statistics and energy estimates use source observations and identify missing history; an incomplete period is not presented as a complete total.

Where your account owner has configured approved controls, request an exact shared-attribute or client-attribute setting change. Each action requires the appropriate permission and your separate approval in the conversation before execution. ChatGPT or Codex may also request permission according to your connection settings. The plugin cannot choose arbitrary settings or values, send RPC commands, or change dashboard layouts. A stored setting is not independent confirmation of physical equipment state.

Northeast Telemetry does not guarantee detection or prevention of equipment failures or property problems, provide emergency response, or replace code-required safety devices, professional inspection, maintenance, repair, or life-safety systems.

release.description:
Pressure Atlas is a daily macro pressure gauge that helps you and your AI understand the broader environment behind markets and headlines.

Like barometric pressure in weather, it provides one important measurement within a larger picture: whether macro pressure is building or releasing, how much pressure is present, and whether its pace is increasing or slowing.

Use it to bring consistent macro context into your research, AI conversations, and analytical models. Explore recent readings, compare changing conditions, and consider how the broader environment fits alongside your own data and analysis.

Each daily reading includes a 0–5 value, a plain-language label, and direction and pace indicators. Pressure Atlas measures conditions—it does not provide predictions or recommendations.

PeriodFinder is an independent comparison site. It is not medical advice, it does not diagnose anything, and it takes no payment from any brand for placement or ranking.

release.description:
Skilcrew is a global marketplace for both jobs and services. Find work or hire people; offer your services or bring in a professional for a one-off task — the client picks the pro. It covers one-off home services, permanent hiring and IT work. This app connects your Skilcrew account to ChatGPT. The Skilcrew platform itself is localized into 44 languages and listings can carry per-country texts; in ChatGPT the assistant simply replies in your language.

For job seekers and service providers: see who is hiring in your country, browse open vacancies and the client request feed, track your published listings, submitted applications and conversations, and check your plan and quotas. The same account also works as a client: search one-off service providers — plumbers, tutors, movers and more — to bring a professional in. With assistant write access enabled in your Skilcrew cabinet you can also apply to vacancies, reply to client service requests, message providers to order a job, and message clients right from the chat.

For employers and recruiters: search candidate profiles (including anonymous ones), review applications received on your vacancies, follow your recruiting pipelines, draft new vacancy listings and start conversations with candidates.

The connector is role-aware: after sign-in it serves exactly the tool set that matches your account type (job seeker or employer/recruiter). Write tools create or reactivate applications and service-request replies, send messages, and create new listings. The listing-editing tools can replace a listing's country reach and add, overwrite or remove its per-country texts. No tool can edit account credentials, delete an account or listing, or recall a sent message. Every write tool is disabled by default and only works after you explicitly enable assistant posting/messaging in your Skilcrew cabinet; switching a toggle off stops the assistant instantly. Search and listing tools return only what users chose to publish on their listings (including a contact phone when the owner published one); anonymous candidate listings stay masked with no contacts, resume files are never returned, and account emails or internal identifiers are not exposed in catalog results.

release.description:
BauLedger is construction-site documentation for trade and construction businesses: a site diary with dictation and photos, defects, tasks, VOB deadlines and working hours – captured on site, reviewed in the office.

This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to exactly these records. Instead of digging through files, ask ChatGPT: "What happened in the site diary last week?" – "Which defects are still open for this client?" – "Which VOB deadlines expire in the next 14 days?" – "How many hours were logged on the project in August?"

Access is strictly read-only: no tool creates, changes or sends anything. ChatGPT sees only your own company's data, and only what the connected user is allowed to see themselves. Evaluating named working hours is a separate permission, confirmed individually when connecting – never pre-selected. Every connection is visible and revocable in BauLedger at any time, by the user and by any company administrator.

Requires a BauLedger account (bauledger.de). Defects, tasks and deadlines that originated as AI suggestions are only returned once confirmed by the office – unconfirmed suggestions only on explicit request, clearly labeled.

release.description:
QualiTaTi is an AI-powered qualitative research platform used by academic and UX researchers. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your QualiTaTi account through a hosted MCP server, so you can run a study end to end without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Interview studies: create an AI-interview project from a topic, draft or refine the interview guide, set the language, voice or text mode and duration, and get the participant link to share. QualiTaTi's AI interviewer then runs the interviews with your participants and transcribes them. You can also import transcripts you already have.
- Progress and results: list your projects and interviews, see which interviews are complete and analysed, read each interview's conversation and quality score, and read the stored analyses (themes, codes, digests).
- Analysis: run the complete analysis or inductive coding on a finished interview (this spends QualiTaTi credits and is always confirmed with you first), then pull the results into the chat as evidence-backed summaries with verbatim quotes.
- Conversational surveys: build a survey from a brief, add questions and publish it; responses are then reviewed on qualitati.com.

Three bundled skills teach the model QualiTaTi's workflows: setting up an interview study, building a survey, and reading results. The plugin works with a free QualiTaTi account. Sign-in uses OAuth 2.1; the grant inherits your plan and quotas, and access tokens expire automatically.

release.description:
doDomain is domain-connect-as-a-service: it gives a product a guided flow for pointing a customer's own domain at that product, and handles the DNS records, verification, and certificates behind it. The doDomain plugin lets ChatGPT drive that work from your account: check a domain's current DNS state, list the apps configured on your team, list existing domain connections, create a new connect session for a customer, look up a session you already started, verify a session once the records are in place, and re-run verification on a connection that has drifted.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration. Scopes are granted per capability on the consent screen — separate read and write scopes for domains, apps, connections, and sessions — and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered to the assistant. Connected apps can be revoked at any time from the Connected Apps page in the dashboard. Tool responses are written against a narrow contract: secret API keys are never returned, and doDomain's billing surface is not reachable over the plugin at all.

Creating a connect session counts against your plan's monthly connection quota; verification checks are rate limited, so a repeated re-verify on the same connection will be told to wait rather than silently retried.

Futrumi is a Czech food-tip platform: named food critics, chefs, sommeliers and gastronomy journalists share where they actually like to eat and drink, and the exact dish or drink they recommend. release.description: FALCON Verify checks whether an AI's answer is supported by the evidence it was given — the document, the figures, the record it was written from — and says so claim by claim. Paste an answer and its evidence, or ask ChatGPT to verify what it just wrote against the facts you supplied; FALCON extracts the material claims, settles what it can deterministically (numbers, names, dates against the evidence), sends the rest to a judge model, and returns a verdict for every claim: supported, qualified, unsupported, contradicted, or more evidence needed. Every result carries a hash-chained record of the decisions that produced it, which a stranger can check. It verifies against the evidence given, never against the model's own beliefs. Free for 25 verifications a month; Starter, Personal and Team plans after that. Nothing to install: sign in with Google, connect, and ask.

release.description:
CookNest is where people keep the recipes they cook: imported from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and any website, scanned from paper, or typed in. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your own CookNest account so you can work with that library in conversation.

Ask what you can cook with chicken and ChatGPT searches your saved recipes, not the web. Paste a link to a recipe you liked and it is saved to your library with ingredients and steps. Plan the week's dinners from your own recipes, then turn the plan into a shopping list sorted by aisle, skipping the staples you always have at home. Tick items off as you shop, keep private notes on a recipe ("less sugar next time"), and organise recipes into collections.

Everything ChatGPT changes shows up right away in the CookNest app on iPhone, Android and the web. You sign in with your CookNest account (Google, Apple or email). ChatGPT only reaches your own recipes, plans and lists; it never receives your password or payment details, and you can disconnect it at any time.

It never returns market data.

release.description:
Frondy is an Israeli electronic-signature service. With the Frondy app, ChatGPT works in the user's own Frondy account: add a contract attached in the chat or from a link, place signature and date fields, send it for signature by email, SMS, WhatsApp or link, see who has signed and who is still pending, remind signers, save and reuse templates, keep contacts and organise documents into folders, in English or Hebrew.

Every signature request is shown to the user as a summary first and goes out only after they confirm. The app uses the account's own permissions and plan limits. It cannot delete documents, folders, templates or contacts, make purchases or change billing or admin settings, and it never reads national ID numbers or passwords. Users sign in on Frondy's own page and can disconnect at any time in Frondy under Settings > External connections. Connecting requires a paid Frondy plan.

release.description:
Search across thousands of new job opportunities everyday from the UK and US. Filter by work style, location and salary. Direct links straight to the employer’s job page so you can move quickly.

Shoutt is a live feed of freshly posted UK and US jobs. Every role was published within the last seven days and drops out of the feed after that, so results are what is new this week rather than an archive of stale openings. Around 10,000 to 15,000 new jobs are added every week.

Tell ChatGPT what you are looking for and it searches by meaning, not just keywords: asking for "AI engineer" also surfaces related titles like forward deployed engineer or machine learning engineer. Results are filtered to jobs open to people in your country, and you can narrow by work style (remote, hybrid or onsite in any combination), the city you can work from, and a minimum salary in GBP or USD. Jobs that do not list a salary are kept so you do not miss them.

Each result shows the title, company, how recently it was posted, and a link straight to the job page on the employer's own site. No job boards, no middlemen. Ask for a job's full details to see the description and requirements before you apply.

Shoutt covers roles across engineering, product, design, data, marketing, sales, operations and more. No account or sign-in is required.

release.description:
QuoteScore scores a contractor, home service or auto repair quote for pricing fairness. Paste the line items and it returns a 0 to 100 score, the fair market range for each line, and the specific problems named: a lump sum with no breakdown, labor billed past standard book time, parts marked well above retail, or an inflated shop supplies fee.

Scoring runs against roughly 14,700 regional pricing benchmarks and an archive of thousands of real quotes that people submitted to be checked, so the answer is grounded in observed prices rather than estimated. The aggregate dataset is published openly under CC BY 4.0.

Free, and no account or sign in is required. It checks price, not workmanship: it cannot tell you whether a contractor does good work, only whether the number is normal.

release.description:
Enrow looks up and verifies professional contact details for specific, named business contacts, using the Enrow account of the user.

What it does:
• Find a professional email address from a full name and a company name or domain, one at a time or in bulk?
• Verify whether an email address is deliverable, including on catch-all domains, single or in bulk.
• Find a mobile phone number from a LinkedIn profile URL, or from a name and company, single or in bulk.
• Check your Enrow credit balance and registered webhooks.

How it works: 
Searches are asynchronous. 
A find or verify tool starts a search and returns an id. ChatGPT then retrieves the result with the matching get tool. Bulk jobs of substantial volume can take several minutes.

What it is not for: it does not search or read the mailbox of the user, write emails, look up general customer-service numbers, or provide personal (non-professional) contact details.

Requires an Enrow account. Get started at https://enrow.io.

release.description:
Shopping online feels like a trust exercise you're destined to fail. You find a product with 5,000 five-star reviews, but half of them look like bots and the other half are people just happy the box arrived on time. It's impossible to know what's actually good.

This app cuts through the junk. You tell us what you need, and we ignore the sponsored placements to build you a shortlist based on merit, not marketing budget.

This is where we do the heavy lifting. We don't just show you the star rating; we dig into the text to find the truth. We scan forum discussions, Reddit threads, and verified purchase comments to summarize the actual consensus.

- The Good: We highlight the specific features real people love.
- The Bad: We spot the patterns in the complaints - like if a "waterproof" boot actually leaks after a month.
- The Verdict: We tell you if the hype is real or if you should keep looking.

Once you have a few options, we stack them side-by-side. You get a clean look at the specs and prices without opening twenty tabs or building your own spreadsheet. It's the deep research you want to do, done for you in seconds.

release.description:
BookYolo is an AI-powered travel tool designed to help you inspect the quality of hotels and vacation rentals before you book them. The platform analyzes public listing information and guest feedback to surface fatal flaws,  hidden red flags, review patterns, overselling and marketing techniques, fee surprises and expectation gaps that travelers often miss. BookYolo goes beyond ratings and surface level reviews by running a deep analysis of each property through a 100-point inspection.

Many properties appear highly rated online, yet travelers still run into unexpected issues on arrival. Reviews are often influenced by politeness bias, where guests soften criticism or focus on positives. At the same time, unhappy guests do not always leave reviews at all, which further skews the overall picture. Add to that the sheer volume of reviews, often hundreds per listing, and it becomes unrealistic for travelers to read and interpret everything themselves.

release.description:
Tarotap lets you draw real tarot cards without leaving ChatGPT. Ask a question, and Tarotap shuffles a full 78-card Rider-Waite-Smith deck on its server and fans it out face down in an interactive widget. You pick your own cards by hand, each one flips face up as it lands, and once the last card is revealed ChatGPT interprets the reading in the context of your question.

Nothing is decided in advance: cards can land upright or reversed, and they stay hidden from everyone, ChatGPT included, until you flip them. Choose from 14 classic spreads such as Time Flow (past, present, future) and the Celtic Cross, or ask for a free-form draw of one to ten cards, including a quick card of the day.

No account or sign-in is needed, and Tarotap stores nothing about you or your reading. Just ask for a reading and draw.

release.description:
PharmacyOS is the retail-management system a Bangladeshi pharmacy runs its counter on — point of sale, inventory by batch and expiry, prescriptions, suppliers, and NBR-compliant receipts. This connector gives the owner and staff of one pharmacy a plain-language way into their own live records.

Ask what sold last month and get the real figure, with the count, discounts, VAT and total. Ask what is running out and get the items at or below their reorder level, with a suggested quantity to cover the next fortnight. Ask who owes money and get the khata book, biggest debt first, with each customer's remaining credit. Ask what money is stuck on the shelf and get the stock that has not sold in ninety days, valued at cost. Ask about one receipt by the number printed on it and get every line, the cashier, the discount, the VAT and the customer. Ask what you actually made and get gross profit and the month's operating expenses side by side.

With the owner's opt-in it also writes: create a medicine, change a price or a reorder level, receive a batch with its expiry, log rent or a salary, add a supplier, raise a draft purchase order, record a customer's payment against what they already owe, and save a photographed supplier invoice as a review session the owner finishes in the app.

Everything is scoped to the single pharmacy the signed-in user belongs to. There is no parameter on any tool that could reach another business's data, and no way to ask for one.

It is a business tool, not a clinical one. There is no drug monograph, indication, dose, interaction or therapeutic-equivalence information in any response, and no tool that provides any. Clinical questions belong with the pharmacist.

Amounts are in Bangladeshi Taka, held as integer paisa. Dates are Asia/Dhaka. Bangla and English both work.

With this plugin, ChatGPT and Codex read your SignalRaven workspace and help you act on it.

What you can do: see your strongest signals this week and open any of them with the person, the ICP analysis, why it matters, the suggested opener and the talking points. See workspace usage and where signals are delivered. With the write permissions you grant on the consent screen, start an Account or Person Intelligence run from a LinkedIn URL (spends credits) and create or update a delivery destination.

Safe by design: the plugin reads your own workspace over an OAuth connection you approve and can revoke. Monitoring runs on SignalRaven's infrastructure. It never touches your LinkedIn login, cookies or session. Anything that spends credits or changes where signals go sits behind its own named permission.

A trial or paid SignalRaven workspace gets live data. Any other account can connect and explore with clearly labeled sample data.

release.description:
BTC DCA Engine answers one question with arithmetic instead of opinion: what would a regular buying plan have been worth?

Give it an asset, an amount and a schedule — daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly — and a start date, and it returns what you put in, what it would be worth at the last close, the profit, the simple and money-weighted returns, the units held, and end-of-year checkpoints along the way. It can compare plans side by side and rank them, and it can return the individual purchases behind any figure.

Every answer carries a link that reopens the same run in the web app, pinned to the exact data it was computed from, so a number in a conversation can be checked rather than taken on faith. Prices come from published daily closes; inflation and rate series come from the St. Louis Fed. There is no forecasting, no advice, and no trading — it reads history and does the sums.

Free with no account: seven assets including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, the S&P 500, the Nasdaq 100 and gold, and two plans per comparison. A BTC DCA Engine account covers the rest of the catalogue, larger comparisons, and the risk, inflation, lump-sum and rules-based overlays.

release.description:
Sendly is an email platform for product teams: a transactional sending API, campaigns, visual workflow automations, contacts with custom fields, lists, dynamic segments, topic preferences, suppressions, sending-domain setup and analytics. The Sendly plugin lets ChatGPT run that workspace from your own account: look up contacts and segments, explain how last week's emails performed, draft a campaign or a template, build a multi-step onboarding workflow from a plain-language brief, check why mail from a domain is not landing, validate addresses, manage suppressions and topics, and — only when you explicitly confirm — send.

Sending is treated as the dangerous action it is. Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration; on the consent screen, read scopes are pre-selected while sending and destructive scopes are unchecked behind a warning, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered. Sending a campaign is two-step: the first call reports the audience size and asks, and only a second call carrying an explicit confirmation sends. Test sends can reach only your own verified address. Mail can only go out from domains you have verified, every project has daily and monthly sending caps tied to its trust tier, and destructive tools are annotated so clients can ask before running them.

The plugin sells nothing in-tool, generates no images, video or audio, and serves no ads. Address validation and list cleaning are metered features of your Sendly plan.

release.description:
NotForm replaces the form with a conversation. You describe what you want to find out, the AI writes the questions and interviews each respondent in text or voice, and what comes back is not a loose transcript: it is structured data, field by field, ready to analyse.

With this connection that fits inside ChatGPT. Ask for a survey in plain language and get a shareable link back; come back later and read the collected answers without leaving the conversation, with the assistant summarising what came in.

Five tools are available: listar_pesquisas lists your surveys with how many answers each one has, and is where you start; ver_pesquisa shows the fields a survey collects and its response link; ler_respostas returns the structured answers, including who replied when the person identified themselves; listar_modelos offers ready-made templates for common cases such as NPS, team climate and post-support follow-up; and criar_pesquisa creates a survey from a plain-language objective or from one of those templates.

A NotForm account is required. The connection only ever sees the surveys of the person who authorised it, and reading and creating are granted as separate permissions on the approval screen.

release.description:
Paste a LinkedIn post and see which rhetorical formulas readers have seen too often.

The plugin counts a small set of formulas and compares each count with a reference corpus of published LinkedIn posts in the same language. For every formula, it reports the value found, how the post compares with the reference posts and, when a formula is used more than usual, a concrete suggestion to say the same thing more directly.

French and English, and it says which one it measured. French carries three formulas: the "ce n'est pas X, c'est Y" contrast, three lines in a row opening on the same word, and the announced lesson ("Résultat :"). English carries one, the "it's not X, it's Y" contrast: the other two were measured on English posts and were not reliable, so they are left out.

It is a style check only. It does not rewrite the post, and it does not assess who wrote it or how it was produced. No account needed.

release.description:
Every AI you talk to has amnesia, and a wall around it. You re-explain the same context to each one, every session, and none of them share what they learn.

Kemory is a permissioned memory that lives across every AI you use. Tell one thing to one assistant and they all understand, with you holding the keys. Connect it to ChatGPT and your preferences, project facts and decisions are there from the first message — including the ones you explained last week, in a different client, on a different machine.

This is not another memory inside one assistant. ChatGPT remembers what you tell ChatGPT. Kemory is the layer underneath that travels with you: the same memory answers in ChatGPT, in Codex, in Claude, in Cursor, and in any other MCP client — with organisation-level scoping and an audit trail that a single assistant's memory does not provide.

What you can do with it:

- Recall decisions, preferences and context from earlier conversations, without repeating them
- Keep project knowledge in one place and draw on it across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Cursor and any other MCP client
- Carry a thread from one AI into another without losing where you were
- Inspect everything Kemory holds about you, and delete any of it

How it is governed: every memory is scoped to a user and an organisation, and that scoping is enforced in the database rather than in a prompt. Colleagues cannot read each other's memories by default.
Memories are shared only when you deliberately promote them to a shared namespace, and every event lands in a hash-chained, tamper-evident audit log. We do not train on your data.

Kemory reads only what you deliberately capture into your own account. It never reads ChatGPT's own memory, chat history, conversation summaries or your files.

Kemory reads and writes. Every memory tool is titled and annotated, so ChatGPT knows reading from writing from deleting before it runs anything.

Requires a SeKondBrain account. Sign in over OAuth; there is nothing to install and no keys to paste.

Kemory by SeKondBrain — the memory layer of the SeKondBrain Cognitive OS. Beta version.

release.description:
Rosey is an independent verification layer for documents, decks, or other content that has been drafted, edited, or summarized by AI — financial reports, scientific writing, technical documentation, and any other content where factual precision matters.

Rosey checks Accuracy: every claim, number, and citation in a document is verified against its source materials, with findings delivered as traceable evidence rather than a bare confidence score. It also applies optional expert personas — a CFO reviewing for financial coherence, an adversarial analyst stress-testing claims, an operating partner checking operational plausibility — to surface weaknesses before an output reaches its intended audience.

Why it matters for agentic workflows: an agent that generates important outputs for users or agents downstream cannot reliably verify its own output. Verification benefits from a separate system checking claims against ground truth, the same way external audit is separate from the finance team it reviews. Rosey is built for end-users, agents, and agentic pipelines so that errors can be caught before they propagate – either to another agent or to someone who will make decisions based on the output. 

Findings are returned with in-line judgement on each factual claim, so work can move from draft → verified → finalized quickly.

Typical triggers: a document contains numerical claims, financial figures, or factual assertions; a document was generated or substantially edited by an AI model; a document is headed to a client, regulator, or decision-maker and needs a pre-send accuracy check; an agent is creating important output that will be consumed as inputs by another agent in a workflow and requires reliability.

Not for: scenarios where there is not an underlying source-of-truth that can be provided directly to Rosey.

Tapusor, Türkiye gayrimenkul piyasası için değerleme, analiz ve portföy yönetimi asistanıdır. Kendi Tapusor hesabınızla (OAuth) giriş yaptıktan sonra şunları yapabilirsiniz:

• Değerleme & piyasa: Bir konum için tahmini satılık/kiralık m² değeri, yakındaki gerçek ilanlar, bölgesel piyasa trendi, parsel/kadastro bilgisi, yatırım analizi ve nokta bazlı risk.
• Bilgi Al: Teknik durum/kısıtlılık, imar planları, bölge havadis, resmi satışlar (TKGM), sosyo-ekonomik veriler, yakındaki danışmanlar, Milli Emlak fırsatları; favorileriniz ve gezdikleriniz.
• Konum çözümleme: Ada-parsel, koordinat, adres veya ilan no ile kesin parsel bulma.
• Raporlar: Konut/İşyeri/Arsa/Elit/Emsal + İnnBroker/Varlık/Fırsat raporları oluşturma; mevcut raporun içeriğini okuma; raporu veya hazırlanan bir tabloyu mail/WhatsApp ile kendinize gönderme.
• Varlık Yönetimi: Portföy panosu (değer/trend/teknik-plan/pazar potansiyeli), varlık listesi ve tek varlık detayı (emsal karşılaştırma, pazar göstergeleri, yatırım skoru, teknik riskler).

Veriler yalnızca sizin kendi hesabınıza aittir; başka kullanıcıların verisine erişilmez. Yazma işlemleri (rapor oluşturma, gönderim) onay ister.

release.description:
Connect Movena to ChatGPT to understand gym booking performance or review your own approved training information.

Gym owners can review weekly booking health and daily booking trends across the business locations they select, including capacity, occupancy, fill rates and waitlists. Coaches receive operational summaries only for locations and sessions they are currently authorised to access. Reports contain business totals and approved business location names; they never disclose member names, contact details, notes, attendance records or other member personal information.

Eligible members can separately choose whether to share My training and My session health. Each category is off by default, independently consented and independently withdrawable in Movena. Operator authority never substitutes for member consent. My training includes workout results from the last 30 days and non-heart-rate personal records with no date cutoff. When a result is linked to an exercise in Movena’s catalogue, Movena includes the catalogue exercise name and available movement classifications. Names assigned to gym-created exercises are never shared.

My session health may include session duration, time in five heart-rate zones, intensity, training load, heart-rate coverage and data-quality indicators from the last 30 days. Movena excludes raw heart-rate readings, average and peak heart rate, calories, sleep, daily-health data, date of birth, coach notes, arbitrary member- or gym-authored text, internal identifiers and other members’ information.

Movena provides read-only informational summaries. It cannot change bookings, memberships, payments, messages or training records, and it does not provide diagnosis, treatment or medical clearance. Access uses Movena sign-in and explicit approval, expires after one hour and cannot be refreshed. Users can withdraw either member category or disconnect the assistant from Movena.

release.description:
Plota brings UK planning applications and planning permission records into ChatGPT. Ask about any address, postcode, street or council in England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland and get the applications themselves: the proposal, status and decision, key dates, and a link to the official council record.

What you can ask:

- What has been applied for at or near an address, and what is pending next door
- Everything about one site in a single answer: its applications, related amendments and appeals, larger -housing schemes nearby, and planning constraints such as flood zones, conservation areas, listed buildings and green belt
- How long a council takes to decide planning applications, and how often it approves them
- Planning appeals and their outcomes, and planning permissions that are about to lapse
- New applications by type, size or number of homes, across a town, a council or the whole country

Used by homeowners checking what is planned nearby, and by architects, planning consultants, developers, property professionals and suppliers tracking new work. Records are collected daily from council planning registers, and every answer links back to its source.

Sign in with your Plota account, or enter your email to start on the free demo allowance. Some features, such as site constraints, depend on your Plota plan.

release.description:
Distill Markets gives ChatGPT direct access to US SEC filing data, served exactly as filed and traceable to the EDGAR accession that stated each number.

What it covers:
- Fundamentals from 10-K and 10-Q XBRL: latest values, up to 20 years of history, financial ratios, and a bring-your-own-price valuation panel.
- Point-in-time views: what was knowable on a past date, every version of a fact across filings, and material revisions, for restatement-aware research and backtests without lookahead.
- Ownership: 13F institutional holders and manager portfolios, Schedule 13D/13G blockholders, and Form 4 insider transactions.
- Filings and events: recent SEC filings, 8-K item events, and a delta feed for agent loops.
- Context: 16 government macro series and sector capital-cycle aggregates.
- Pre-2009 annual fundamentals parsed from text filings (FY1995 to FY2009), kept separate from the XBRL record and served with per-fact provenance.

Every tool is read-only. Responses carry the accession number, filing date and XBRL concept behind each value, so any figure can be checked against the SEC document. The server states no opinions and gives no investment advice: it reports what the filer said and how it reconciles.

Coverage is US domestic 10-K and 10-Q filers. Figures are in the filer's reporting currency, never converted.

A free account covers most tools. Analyst and Pro plans add depth: full ownership lists, point-in-time detail, cross-ticker comparison and the pre-2009 corpus.

release.description:
GetItDone is a team task and workspace manager. The GetItDone plugin lets ChatGPT work inside your workspaces directly: list the workspaces you belong to, browse and filter tasks, open a task's full details and attachments, pull the video context attached to a task, create new tasks, update existing ones, archive them, and search your workspace documentation.

You connect by signing in to your existing GetItDone account over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. The consent screen shows exactly which scopes you grant — reading workspaces, reading tasks, and writing tasks are separate — and the assistant only ever reaches data the signed-in account can already reach. Attachment links handed to the assistant are short-lived presigned URLs rather than permanent ones. You can review and revoke any connected assistant at any time from the Connected apps tab in your GetItDone settings.

The server is tool-only over Streamable HTTP and exposes eight tools. It processes no payments, generates no images, video, or audio, and serves no ads.

release.description:
FIRMEN.directory is a company directory for Switzerland, Austria and Germany. This plugin lets ChatGPT look up companies in it.

What you can ask
- Register facts about a company: legal form, UID (Switzerland) or Firmenbuch number (Austria), seat, status, registered purpose, share capital and former names.
- Companies of a trade in a town, postcode, canton or Bundesland, for example accountants in 8400 Winterthur or tax advisers in Tirol.
- Whether a company still exists, and under which name a company with a former name is registered today.
- Listings that business owners maintain themselves, with their short description, website and public phone number.

Where the data comes from
Swiss entries come from Zefix, the central business name index of the Federal Commercial Registry Office (EHRA). Austrian entries come from the Firmenbuch, published as open data by the Republic of Austria, represented by the Federal Ministry of Justice (CC BY 4.0). Every answer names its source. The plugin returns active companies only.

What it does not do
It does not search for persons, gives no contact details for register entries, keeps no lists of insolvencies or deletions, and gives no credit information. It is a private directory, not the official register, and its data has no legal effect. For a certified extract use zefix.admin.ch or JustizOnline.

How results are ordered
Name match first, then listings maintained by the owner, then rating (from three reviews), then name. Paid plans on FIRMEN.directory have no influence on inclusion, order or presentation, and the plugin shows no advertising.

No account is needed and the plugin is free. Each result links to the company's profile on FIRMEN.directory. Answers are in your language; company data and source lines are German.

The assistant works only in the trips you choose and does only what you allow: looking at the plan, adding to it, creating trips, or also deleting things, reading the chat, posting to it, and creating share links for trips you own. release.description:
Triad Astro reads your birth chart in three astrological traditions at once - Western (Tropical), Vedic (Sidereal), and Chinese (BaZi / Four Pillars) - and shows you where they agree.

Give it a birth date, plus a time and place if you know them, and it calculates all three charts in a single step: Sun, Moon and rising signs, planetary aspects and elemental balance from the Western system; Nakshatra, Navamsa, planetary dignity and the Vimshottari Dasha timeline from the Vedic system; and the Four Pillars, Day Master and ten-year Luck Pillars from the Chinese system.

Most astrology tools give you one system's answer. Triad Astro gives you three, then helps you read the overlap - the themes that show up independently in all three are the ones worth a closer look.

Planetary positions are computed from ephemeris data aligned to NASA JPL standards, and birth places are resolved to coordinates with automatic timezone handling, so charts are accurate to the minute when the birth time is known. Ambiguous place names can be looked up first so you can confirm the right city.

No account or sign-in is required. Just ask for a reading - for example: "Calculate my tri-system birth chart. I was born March 14, 1990 at 7:45am in Bangalore, India."

release.description:
Tennis Life brings a player's own tennis season into ChatGPT.

Ask what you have planned today or tomorrow and get your real Tennis Life schedule — training blocks, tasks, and whether a tournament falls on that day. Ask about your season and get your own tournaments: dates, city, surface, status and your match results. Ask how your Champion day is going and get the app's own view of it, in plain words.

You can also search the Tennis Life drill library — real drills written by coaches, with objective, setup, duration, instructions and coaching cues — and ask ChatGPT to build a practice session from them. And you can add a task to your own Tennis Life list without leaving the conversation.

What this connection never returns: anyone else's data, including a coach's athlete or a parent's child; health, recovery, sleep and injuries; nutrition and calories; your journal, chats and mentor conversations. Meal entries appear only as an unnamed busy block, so the day reads as busy at that hour without revealing what it was.

Connecting requires a Tennis Life account and is available to adults only.

Consulta el texto vigente de códigos y leyes artículo por artículo (con su estado de vigencia), busca jurisprudencia de la Corte Nacional y la Corte Constitucional, y explora los más de 6 millones de juicios provinciales (eSATJE) con filtros por materia, provincia, judicatura, fechas o empresa. Genera un resumen estructurado de cualquier proceso a partir de su número —estado, hitos y próximos pasos—, obtiene el texto íntegro de resoluciones y actos del Registro Oficial, y revisa las novedades normativas publicadas. Todas las respuestas citan su fuente. Deley no solicita ni almacena datos sensibles: sus herramientas solo reciben términos de búsqueda, números de proceso y filtros públicos, y omiten identificadores personales (números de cédula, correos, teléfonos) presentes en los registros judiciales; en listados sin filtro por parte, las personas naturales se muestran solo con iniciales. Pensado para abogados y equipos legales que investigan y litigan en Ecuador. Requiere una cuenta gratuita de Deley (deley.io); las búsquedas de normativa y jurisprudencia son ilimitadas. El producto y las respuestas están en español.

release.description:
Gemral Edge provides public-record financial intelligence inside ChatGPT. It covers congressional stock trades, U.S. federal and defense contracts, lobbying activity, management commitment history, upcoming market catalysts, prediction-market odds, and cross-signal convergence. Results depend on subscription tier and are informational only, not investment advice.

Who's trading and who's winning money: congressional stock trades (who in Congress is buying or selling, STOCK Act disclosures, a trading leaderboard, any lawmaker's history), U.S. federal & Pentagon defense contract awards, corporate lobbying-spend velocity, AI tech-infrastructure shifts, and FED system liquidity — cross-referenced onto the same ticker and ranked by an Alpha Score where signals converge.

Does management keep its word: the Management Track Record engine scores whether a company's executives actually deliver on the commitments they make on earnings calls and in filings — an Executive Reliability / Credibility score, realization rate, time accuracy, promise-execution timeline, and language-drift/contradiction alerts (and it follows executives across companies).

What's about to move the market: a Breakout Watch / catalyst radar of upcoming market-moving events — drug-approval decisions, regulatory and enforcement actions, appropriations and contract deadlines, executive orders and policy shifts — each with a breakout score and expected-impact scenarios, plus prediction-market odds and historical resolution precedents.

Example asks: "top convergence signals in defense right now", "the congressional trading leaderboard this quarter", "which companies just won federal contracts", "does NVDA management keep its promises", "what catalysts are coming up for biotech this month", "the 2026 Senate battleground", or "screen for tickers where congressional buying, contract wins, and lobbying all line up".

Results are served at your subscription tier (a free tier is available; upgrade for full unmasked signals, the Alpha Score, catalyst radar, and alerts). All data is derived from public records and is informational only — not investment advice.

release.description:
JobMojito runs AI-led conversational sessions in three shapes: scored interviews for hiring, simulated personas that assess how someone handles a real situation, and self-serve coaching for practice. Connect this server and your assistant can set all three up, invite people, and read back transcripts, scores and reports — as you, with your own permissions.

Interviews. Generate one from a job description, or supply your own questions. Pick the modality: a voice-only interviewer, a live video avatar, or a pre-recorded one. Register candidates and each gets a personal link; when they finish you get the transcript, structured analysis and a shareable HTML or PDF report.

Simulated personas. Instead of a question list, the avatar plays a defined character in free-form conversation — a sceptical buyer, an angry customer, a difficult stakeholder — and the person is scored on how they handle it. These use the same invitation and result flow as an interview, so they land in the recruiter's result list alongside everything else.

Coaching. The same persona engine pointed at practice rather than assessment: learners start sessions themselves from a browsable catalogue, spend their own coaching credits, and their results stay private from recruiters. Organise the catalogue with directories, tag filters and your own Markdown pages.

Across all three: upload documents to a knowledge base the AI draws on, check credits and analytics, and search JobMojito's documentation without leaving the conversation. If you manage several accounts — an agency, a reseller, sub-brands — an interactive picker chooses which merchant you are acting as.

Everything JobMojito produces is decision support: input for a qualified human reviewer, never a hiring decision on its own, and candidates are told AI is part of the process. Read-only lookups run freely; anything that creates a session, mints a link or generates a report asks you first.

Sign in with your JobMojito account — no API key to manage.

Built for recruiters, talent teams, sales and service trainers, coaching providers, and the platforms that serve them. The same capabilities are available over the JobMojito HTTP API if you would rather integrate directly — this connector is for when an assistant should drive the work interactively.

release.description:
Autosheet lets ChatGPT run a specialized spreadsheet agent directly in Google Sheets. Describe what you need in plain language — the agent inspects the spreadsheet, plans the steps, performs work, and reports back.

Delegate most tasks involving a Google Sheet including simply reading data or inspecting structure — it's reliable, fast, token-efficient, and helps keep context clean.

Everyday tasks:
- Create, fix, and explain formulas
- Build charts, pivot tables, and dashboards
- Format and style cells, ranges, and entire sheets
- Restructure data into clean, organized rows, columns, and sheets
- Web research

Row-by-row bulk processing with AI at up to 1,000 rows per minute:
- Enrich and categorize product catalogs for e-commerce and merchandising
- Generate, rewrite, and translate content at scale for SEO and localization
- Enrich and score leads for sales outbound through bulk web search
- Clean, standardize, and deduplicate messy data across any dataset

Beyond these, teams use Autosheet wherever work lives in a spreadsheet: accounting, finance, HR, inventory, education, and more.

How it works:

Give ChatGPT a prompt and a Google Sheets URL or ID. Autosheet launches an agent on that spreadsheet and returns the result. Long jobs keep running server-side — check status or stop an agent at any time. Follow-up requests continue on the same spreadsheet with full context. The agent works directly in the spreadsheet and can add, change, or remove content.

Authentication through OAuth: you grant access to your own Google Sheets. Works with any spreadsheet you can edit.

Built by Talarian, the team behind the GPT for Sheets and Docs add-on (7M+ installs on the Google Workspace Marketplace). New accounts start with free trial credits.

Ask about your Amazon business and get the answer from your own data, without exporting a spreadsheet.

Epinium reads your catalog, your advertising and your automations:

• Catalog — one product entity that merges the Seller Central, Vendor Central and Advertising views of the same ASIN, with brands, barcodes and keyword clusters.

release.description:
Boomerang finds the warmest introduction path to any buyer at any company, using the relationships your team already has.

Most sales outreach is cold because the network that could open the door is invisible: employees and executives, investors and board members, customer champions, and partners. Boomerang maps those relationships into a scored graph, then shows who on your side actually knows someone at the account you care about, ranks the paths by relationship strength, drafts the introduction request, and tracks it through to a meeting.

In ChatGPT you can ask things like "Who do we know at Snowflake?", "Find the strongest path to the CFO at Acme and tell me who should make the intro", "Which of our champions changed jobs this quarter?", "Show me the buying committee at Acme", or "What is my intro-to-meeting conversion this quarter?"

Boomerang connects to your CRM (Salesforce and HubSpot) and to calendar and email signals, so coverage is calculated against the accounts your team already works. A Boomerang account is required. You sign in with your existing Boomerang credentials, and every request is scoped to the workspace and permissions of the signed-in user.

release.description:
Check data against the standards, canonical models and policies it claims to conform to, and get back a graded, machine-readable result that says what was checked, what was not, and why.

dVeracity is a verification engine for regulated data. An agent can read a canonical data model at design time (entities, sectors, semantic codes and policy guardrails), validate a payload against a named standard before submitting it, look up approved regulatory compliance policies with their rules and provenance, and query verified datasets in natural language. Every result states its model version and the checks it ran, so it can be handed to a reviewer rather than pasted into a chat.

The first standard onboarded is Open Footprint (The Open Group), with O-DEF semantic codes, PACT product-footprint validation and verified emissions and methane datasets. The engine is domain-neutral; further standards are onboarded through the same path.

Eighteen tools, all read-only. Model, sector, semantic-code and standards-catalogue tools are free of charge. Natural-language queries and validation are metered per call in credits, with machine-readable HTTP 402 payment semantics: when an account runs out, the tool tells the agent to ask its human operator to top up, and never retries. Compliance-policy tools are available on paid plans.

Authentication is OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration; a human approves access on dVeracity's consent screen. Optional GLEIF-rooted vLEI verified-agent identity is supported for organisations that need attributable agents.

Built for compliance, ESG and reporting teams, standards implementers, and anyone whose data has to be checked before it is trusted.

release.description:
Check any UK-registered car, van or motorcycle's MOT using official DVSA test records. Give it a registration and you get whether the vehicle has a valid MOT and when it expires, when a newer vehicle's first MOT is due, and the result, mileage, advisories and defects from its latest test — plus the full MOT history going back through every recorded test.

The history check flags whether recorded mileage ever went down between tests, a common sign of clocking or a recording error, which is worth knowing before buying a used car. Advisories and failures come back in plain language rather than DVSA shorthand.

Data comes from the DVSA MOT History API, the official UK government record of MOT tests, with tax and MOT status from the DVLA. Every answer links to the vehicle's full record on motcheck.io.

No account or sign-in is needed. MOT records contain no personal information about a vehicle's keeper. UK-registered vehicles only (Great Britain and Northern Ireland).

release.description: AstraVerify checks whether a domain is trustworthy in the two places that matter today: the inbox and the AI answer. Ask about any domain and it returns two scores out of 100. Email Security covers MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, including whether DMARC is actually enforced, and every finding comes with the exact TXT record to paste. Discoverability covers what search engines and AI crawlers can actually get from the site: robots.txt rules for Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot, whether the CDN blocks them at the edge, the sitemap, www/apex redirects, canonical tags, titles and descriptions, Organization and WebSite structured data, llms.txt, and whether the opening paragraphs define the brand. A fetch-as-crawler tool shows the exact response a named crawler receives, and verify_fix re-checks one area after you change something. Scores are computed by the same rules as astraverify.com, so what the assistant says matches the report page it links to. The server reads public DNS and public pages only, never logs in, never writes to your domain, and needs no account: results are cached and shared, and fresh scans are rate-limited per domain. Built for founders, marketing owners, IT generalists and the agencies that manage many domains.

release.description: Mail and calendar for your AI agent: an MCP server on your real mailbox (Microsoft 365 or IMAP) with out-of-band human approval on every send, delete and calendar write.

interface.short_description: Answer email from your files
interface.long_description:
GigaMail connects Codex to your real mailboxes, Microsoft 365 or any IMAP provider, and to your calendar, and answers mail the way you would: from your own identity and your own documents. Tell it once who you are, what you do and how you sign; attach your price list, catalogue, terms or product sheets to the account. When a request comes in, Codex reads the thread and what was already said to that sender, takes the numbers from your files instead of inventing them, checks your free slots before proposing a time, and drafts the reply in the language the customer wrote in. Several mailboxes work side by side, one agent across all of them.

Nothing goes out on the agent's say-so: every send, reply, delete or calendar write waits for your approval, from the desktop console, the CLI or Telegram, and mail content is treated as data, never as instructions. The server runs on your machine (pip install "gigamail[all]"); this skill teaches Codex how to use it.

Draft replies from the account's identity and knowledge files
Compute free calendar slots and manage events
Out-of-band human approval for send, reply, delete and calendar writes

interface.short_description: Agent-native trading infra
interface.long_description:
Hey-Traders! Quant Trading gives AI agents access to quantitative market research and strategy testing through the Codex browser, with workflows designed for token-efficient tool use.

Manipulate and analyze charts, add technical indicators, research markets, analyze portfolios descriptively, build and backtest trading strategies, and run strategies in simulated paper mode using the tools available in HeyTraders.

The skills use structured commands and targeted capability discovery to connect research, strategy development, and validation in your HeyTraders workspace. Agents discover the tools relevant to each task and retrieve focused results, keeping interactions concise while working with the application’s current capabilities.

Requires Codex desktop with the Browser plugin and a HeyTraders account. Paper workflows use simulated balances and do not send orders to a trading venue. The public plugin does not place, modify, cancel, or monitor real orders; run live strategies; or connect exchanges. Sign-in is completed by the user in the application.

release.description: Understand proteins with ESM: explore mutation landscapes, interpret learned features, predict and view structures, and discover relatives.

interface.short_description: Understand proteins with ESM
interface.long_description: Biohub ESM helps you understand proteins from a name, sequence, or file: explore mutation landscapes, interpret what ESMC sees, predict and view all-atom structures, and discover related proteins. It chooses the right ESM workflow, preserves confidence and provenance, and presents results automatically. It also supports MSA-guided and modified-complex workflows, and private or large-scale compute routing. Supported protein sequences use the Biohub MCP viewer. Complexes and exact prediction files use a separate molecular viewer when available, with an agent-generated static rendering as a last resort where local rendering tools are available. Managed inference requires a Biohub API key and may incur usage charges. Predictions support research hypotheses, not experimental conclusions.
interface.default_prompt: Map the mutational landscape of PETase and show me where it is most constrained or tolerant.
default_prompts: Map the mutational landscape of PETase and show me where it is most constrained or tolerant.

release.description: One fresh, read-only consultation for material technical decisions in Codex CLI and Codex desktop.

interface.short_description: Read-only technical advice
interface.long_description:
Codex Advisor automatically adds a fresh, read-only second opinion when Codex identifies a material technical decision.

Standard remains Terra/high for ordinary bounded architecture, interface, data-model, and generic-advisor decisions. Specialist remains GPT-6 Sol/high only when targeted evidence still leaves a cross-system design, compatibility or concurrency boundary, competing diagnosis, security or trust boundary, recovery, irreversible migration, or data-loss decision unresolved. Project importance, security adjacency, or an ordinary architecture question alone stays Standard. A separate advisor-astra role offers explicit-only Astra/high consultation for the most complex uses; it is never selected automatically, uses more Codex allowance, and remains subject to account and runtime availability.

Every consultation runs in a separate read-only, tool-free process. It cannot change your files, run commands, browse the web, or make decisions for you. You remain in control: Advisor does not implement, deploy, or perform final review.

skills.name: hyperloom-workload-optimizer
skills.description: Autonomously optimizes end-to-end LLM inference throughput on AMD Instinct GPUs and reports a validated gain, using the Hyperloom multi-agent optimizer. release.description: Tighten prose or write unambiguous technical documentation with two complementary writing skills.

interface.short_description: Clear writing, made simple.
interface.long_description:
Plain English tightens ai writing. Paste prose and it flags each weak sentence with a fix and hands back a cleaned version. 

The problem is old. In 1946 George Orwell wrote Politics and the English Language against prose that hides meaning: passive voice, abstract nouns, Latin where a plain word would do, metaphors dead from overuse. In 1948 Sir Ernest Gowers wrote Plain Words for the British civil service and turned the same instinct into working rules. Between them they solved most of it. Language models then added a dialect of their own: em-dashes everywhere, words like delve and leverage, preamble, summary closers, lists padded to three, stacked hedges, "studies show" with no study. So the skill runs two passes, Orwell and Gowers first, then the model habits. Your meaning and voice stay.

The plugin also includes Simple English, a separate skill for technical documentation. It follows ASD-STE100, the controlled language aerospace has written maintenance manuals in since 1986. Documentation goes there; prose with a voice goes to Plain English. The two never run on the same text..
interface.default_prompt: Rewrite this in plain English without changing its meaning.

Also run as a self-audit pass before delivering long-form prose (essays, blog posts, articles, reports) so the output isn't recognisably AI-generated. Three modes: audit (flag + suggest), rewrite (deliver cleaned prose), edit (fix a named file in place). Technical documentation routes to the simple-english skill instead.

interface.short_description: Build and publish websites

Describe the website you want (a portfolio, an event page with RSVPs, a small shop, a sign-up form, a survey) and Simple Host puts it online at its own address that you can share straight away.

Every site can save what people send it. RSVPs, orders, votes and survey answers are kept, and you can download them as a spreadsheet. Orders, RSVPs and sign-ups can go in a private list that only you can read, and you choose who may save: anyone who signs in, or only the people you list.

Change a site any time by asking for it. Earlier versions are kept, so you can preview one or put it back. Saved data keeps 30 days of history, so a deleted entry or an unwanted change can be restored, and a deleted site can be brought back for 7 days.

Ask how many people visited, which pages they read and where they came from. Give a site a free name.simple-host.app address or connect your own domain, and download a copy of any site whenever you like.

You sign in to Simple Host once (with Google or an emailed code); after that every conversation can publish and update your sites. Pages are public to anyone with the link, so keep private information in private lists. Free to start.

release.description: An Anima Felix skill for responding to anxiety with a calm, structured reset.

interface.short_description: Steady yourself when anxious
interface.long_description: Anxiety Reset gives an assistant a short, bounded way to respond to someone who is spiraling, panicking, overthinking, or awake at 3am. It offers one practice at a time rather than stacking techniques, suggests a tentative way to name the loop the person is caught in, and refuses to keep supplying reassurance that briefly soothes and then wears off. It hands off rather than assessing: on any sign of crisis or a possible medical emergency it stops, says plainly that it is not the right tool, and directs the person to local emergency services and someone nearby. It names no specific emergency number, so the assistant can supply resources correct for the user. It administers or scores no psychological instrument, offers no diagnosis, and gives no medication guidance. Wellness support, not therapy, diagnosis, treatment or crisis care. Published by Anima Felix under CC BY 4.0.

release.description: Turn complex work into inspectable, verified execution graphs.

interface.short_description: Run verified workflow graphs
interface.long_description:
Graph Mode turns complex tasks into transparent, dependency-aware execution graphs instead of relying on an open-ended agent loop.

It breaks work into explicit nodes with dependencies, access levels, expected outputs, evidence requirements, attempt limits, and clear statuses. Graph Mode can run independent research or inspection branches in parallel, safely join their results, verify completion with deterministic evidence, and perform one bounded repair cycle when verification fails.

Use it for repository audits, feature implementation, parallel research, maker-reviewer workflows, monitoring, and other multi-step tasks where control flow and proof of completion matter.

Graph Mode does not expand the user’s permissions or scope. External writes, destructive actions, and materially ambiguous decisions remain approval-gated. Every run ends with a clear terminal state and reports the executed path, evidence, changes, blockers, skipped branches, and remaining uncertainty.

release.description: Inspect and debug mobile apps with Ansight CLI: runtime evidence, live UI, app tools, and repeatable tests.

interface.short_description: Inspect and debug mobile apps.
interface.long_description:
Ansight gives your coding agent runtime evidence from real mobile apps, so it can debug and verify what actually happened instead of guessing from source code.

Install the Ansight SDK into an iOS, Android, .NET MAUI, React Native, Flutter, or Capacitor app, and every development session records logs, network requests, telemetry, screenshots, visual trees, and touches. This plugin's 27 skills let the agent use that evidence through the Ansight CLI:

• Set up the CLI and start the local host
• Investigate a recorded session: bracket a time window and correlate logs, failed requests, screenshots, and UI trees around an error
• Operate a running app: boot a simulator or emulator, launch the app, tap and type through the semantic UI, and capture before-and-after evidence
• Call remote tools the app exposes for authoritative in-process state
• Annotate sessions for review
• Score automation readiness and automation-ID coverage
• Author and run repeatable, source-controlled UI tests
• Add platform-specific SDK setup and custom remote tools for each supported framework

Requirements: the Ansight CLI is installed separately, and live workflows need a development or QA build with the SDK integrated plus execution access to the machine running the Ansight host. Installing the plugin in a cloud-only environment does not by itself provide access to a local device or simulator.
interface.default_prompt: Check whether Ansight CLI is ready on this machine.

interface.short_description: Make sites readable by AI
interface.long_description: agentmarkup generates the machine-readable layer of a website at build time: llms.txt, JSON-LD structured data, markdown mirrors, AI-crawler robots.txt rules and Content-Signal headers, then validates what the build actually produced. It works out which layer owns your final HTML and installs the matching adapter rather than guessing from what is already in package.json: Vite, Astro, Next or Nuxt, plus a framework-agnostic CLI for any other directory of built HTML, and core helpers for custom pipelines and dynamic SSR routes. Inspecting your repo is read-only. Before installing a package, writing config, running a build, or making an outbound request to a deployed site, it stops and presents a single plan naming the package, every file that would change, and the exact commands. Validation is deterministic: a missing required field is an error, a missing recommended field is a warning. There is no score, grade or percentage. Existing curated llms.txt, robots.txt, _headers and JSON-LD are preserved unless you explicitly opt into replacement. Open source and MIT licensed.

release.description: OKRs as markdown files in your own repo, with an AI coach that checks new work against your key results, pre-drafts weekly check-ins, and parks distractions.

interface.short_description: OKRs as files, with a coach
interface.long_description:
okrdev turns OKRs into markdown files in your own repository and puts an AI coach beside them. The coach checks new work against your key results before it starts, pre-drafts the weekly check-in from git history and merged pull requests, and parks distractions instead of letting them become this week's work.

It installs on an adoption ladder and never installs a level you did not ask for. Level 0 is a parking lot and takes ten minutes. Level 1 adds a mission, cycle objectives, check-ins and a scored retro. Level 2 adds collaboration rails for teams shipping through pull requests.

The coach never blocks. It classifies, it argues, and when you overrule it, it logs the judgment call with your reason so the next planning session has a record instead of a memory.

No MCP servers, no telemetry, no account, no network calls of its own. Everything it produces is a file in your repository, under your git history and your access control. Delete the okrdev directory and the marked block in your agent instructions file, and it never existed.

release.description: Run several coding agents side by side on one repository. Each participant works in its own Git worktree, claims numbered issues before editing, announces advisory file reservations to the others, and hands work over explicitly with a summary and evidence instead of overwriting a peer.

interface.short_description: Coordinate agents on one repo
interface.long_description: Agent Parley lets several coding agents work on one repository at the same time without overwriting each other. Each participant runs in its own Git worktree. Before editing, a participant claims a numbered issue, and the claim is visible to every other participant. File reservations are announced over MCP and are advisory: peers see a conflict and stop, but nothing on disk is locked. Work moves between participants through an explicit offer and accept, carrying a summary of the commit, the checks that ran, and what remains. Outcomes are reported as agent claims with evidence, never as independent verification. The skill reads coordination state through the agent-parley command line tool, which must be installed separately.

release.description: Learn durable Codex preferences from session feedback and retain them as scoped, reviewable AGENTS.md improvements.

interface.short_description: Learn and retain preferences
interface.long_description: When using Codex, we often see it miss things that feel obvious to us: it may run far more tests than necessary or make assumptions about a project that simply do not make sense. Correcting it helps in the current conversation, but that lesson is often forgotten as soon as a new conversation begins. A good harness should keep learning a user's taste, preferences, and working style from these interactions. This Skill does exactly that: it analyzes Codex conversation history, extracts durable preferences, and writes them to project-level or global AGENTS.md files, giving Codex a form of continuous learning. You can think of it as a stripped-down version of Hermes. The project intentionally limits itself to preferences suitable for AGENTS.md rather than trying to generate Skills. We do not want to lock an agent into particular ways of working, since such constraints can become liabilities as models improve. User preferences, by contrast, are not learned simply by upgrading the model and are therefore worth preserving.
interface.default_prompt: Review my conversation history and suggest AGENTS.md improvements.
