release.description: A gated, lecturer-in-the-loop workflow with guided, course-adaptive evidence-grounded redesign.

interface.short_description: Gated evidence-led redesign
interface.long_description:
◆ LECTURER / TEACHER CONTROL • You retain every consequential decision. The Course Redesign Orchestrator is the sole lecturer-facing interface.
◆ SPECIALIST TEAM (10) • Course Mapper and Learning-Outcomes Auditor; Active-Learning Researcher; AI Integration and AI-Competence Researcher; Student Experience, Accessibility and Workload Proxy Critic; Assessment and Constructive-Alignment Designer. • Source Verification and Citation Auditor; Evidence and Feasibility Red Team; Learning Designer; Learning Material Designer; Artefact Accessibility and Visual QA Auditor. The student-experience role is a design-review proxy and never authorises identifiable student data.
◆ GATED WORKFLOW • Gate 0A: verify ownership/processing authority, sensitivity, student data, protected assessment and environment before any source path or content. • Gate 0: confirm sources, rights, tools and egress. Gate 1: confirm the course brief and a fresh run. • HITL 1: approve focus after preliminary mapping. Research, source verification, cross-specialist synthesis, assessment integration and red-team review lead to HITL 2. • Gate 3: approve the integrated blueprint and file plan. Material production creates only approved working copies, followed by evidence, accessibility, visual, alignment and assessment-security QA. • Verify production handoff before HITL 3; accept, revise or reject each artefact. • Request or decline final system review; the accepted run becomes complete and dormant until a later manual or separately approved scheduled trigger creates a fresh run.
◆ DECISION DIALOGUE • One unresolved question at a time. • Use a card only if the live host can show the complete option set plus custom answer. Verified current Codex in Plan mode: 2–3 explicit choices plus automatic Other. • If capacity is unknown, unavailable or exceeded, use ordinary chat with every valid numbered option plus Other, then wait. Never prune, hide or combine valid options to fit a card. • Long sets may use dependency-based chunks with every option visible; the lecturer may split, merge, reorder or rename them. • Preserve custom answers verbatim, show editable recaps, never preselect recommendations and fail closed on uncertainty.
◆ BOUNDARY • The plugin does not register schedules, start runs, publish content, add connectors or change permissions.

release.description:
Better Plans helps turn complicated decisions into clear, practical plans so you can move forward with confidence.

Start with a decision you’re facing or something you want to make happen. Whether you’re planning a wedding or trip, renovating a home, buying a car, making a career move, or tackling another complicated project, Better Plans helps you clarify what matters, understand the tradeoffs, work within real-world constraints, anticipate problems, and turn your thinking into practical next steps.

It combines structured thinking from engineering, risk management, and project planning with AI-guided conversation to help you make stronger decisions without replacing your judgment.

The goal isn’t a perfect plan. It’s to help you choose on purpose, make the call with confidence, adapt when things change, and move forward with intention.

release.description: Open-source full-SDLC framework with graph-native project knowledge for agentic development.

interface.short_description: Develop without IT-specialists
interface.long_description:
NaCl (reading as Natrium Chloride) is an open-source full-SDLC framework, and its core innovation is how it solves the hardest problem in agentic development: storing and retrieving project knowledge. Instead of markdown specs that agents must re-read every session, all project knowledge — requirements, architecture decisions, entities, rules, and their relationships — lives in a Neo4j knowledge graph as first-class queryable objects. The measured effect: planning a single use case takes ~550 tokens (one targeted Cypher query) instead of ~150,000 tokens (reading a ~70-file markdown spec, because the agent doesn't know in advance where the relevant facts live) — a 99.6% reduction in context per use case, repeated in every planning session.

Around the graph we've built the full tooling for agentic development and testing: 57 skills covering BA → SA → TDD development → review → QA → release, quality gates before production, and an autonomous goal orchestrator (/nacl-goal). The framework answers "how is this built and why" for any part of the system, regardless of project scale or iteration count. Benchmarked on a real production project (EV charging station management): a classical team was estimated at 5,831 person-hours; running fully on NaCl the same scope takes 1,480 person-hours — 4x fewer person-hours and 60% lower cost.

release.description: JuicyLucy's paid-media ad production: /video-ad-production and /static-ad-production, with the composition, motion and media skills a video run reads, the platform and workspace conventions both engines share, the brand facts they resolve, and /juicylucy-setup for the local toolchain.

interface.short_description: Make video and static ads
interface.long_description:
Create video and static ads from a brief or your existing creative, adapt them for Meta, Instagram and TikTok, and localize them for different markets.

Two entry points:
• /video-ad-production — a new ad from a brief or, more often, a variation of a reference creative ("copy this ad, change the hook"). It generates the first frame and then the footage, cuts to the placement spec, checks the copy against Meta's advertising policies, and exports under a filename an ads-manager report can be traced back to.

Your data
Composition and rendering happen on your Mac, where project files and downloaded media are saved. Generation prompts, settings and required reference media go to JuicyLucy's generation service under your account. Its providers process and host generated media, and the service stores job and credit records. Codex processes the conversation and task context under your OpenAI account. Optional winner analysis reads your authorized Meta account; requested asset retrieval can contact other media sources. The privacy policy explains data handling and retention.

release.description: Create and validate safety-gated operational runbooks.

interface.short_description: Create and resume runbooks
interface.long_description:
Create, review, dry-run, execute, resume, and audit operational procedures for releases, incidents, migrations, QA, beta launches, and recurring work.

Make the decision points explicit: an observable entry signal and verification check, a rollback or containment trigger, and the person or role responsible for the final go/no-go. Each procedure includes preservation requirements, atomic steps, expected results, verification, failure handling, and approval boundaries.

Version 0.4.0 adds separate draft and ready structural checks and a durable execution record. Preserve completed steps, consumed authorizations, uncertain outcomes, and the next authorized action across sessions. Reconcile uncertain external actions before retrying them, and bind evidence to the exact artifact, environment, observation time, and claim.

Structural validation does not grant authorization, enforce budgets, or prove live readiness. The plugin works with the host's available tools and permissions; it has no publisher-hosted service, MCP server, or publisher-side analytics.

release.description: Audit whether a website can be found and cited by AI answer engines, and return a ranked list of fixes.

interface.short_description: Check if AI search cites you
interface.long_description: Classic SEO asks whether you rank. AI answer engines do not rank - they retrieve a few sources and synthesize one answer, so a site can sit at the top of page one and still never be quoted. This plugin audits the second thing. It runs a citation baseline across buyer-intent prompts, checks whether the AI crawlers that control citations can actually reach your pages, reviews whether your content is written in a form that survives retrieval, and returns a fix list ranked by impact over effort. It also ships a fast robots.txt check for the crawlers that matter, because the single most common cause of total absence from AI answers is an accidental block - and the agent most teams block is not the one that controls citations. A single run is a snapshot; the skill also explains what it takes to turn one audit into a repeatable measurement you can re-run month over month.
interface.default_prompt: Audit whether example.com gets cited by ChatGPT Search and Perplexity.

release.description: Offline, inert context migration across supported coding agents

interface.short_description: Resume past agent sessions
interface.long_description: Portable Resume migrates bounded context from your previous local coding-agent sessions into a fresh session. One resume skill per supported source (17 sources: Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Cline, Codex CLI, Crush, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, goose, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, Kimi CLI / Kimi Code CLI, OpenClaw, OpenCode, OpenHands, Pi agent, Qwen Code) reads that agent's own on-disk session store, selects the newest session recorded for the current working directory where the source records one (a session without a recorded directory may remain eligible, depending on the adapter, and OpenHands has no directory filter), and prints an inert, best-effort redacted markdown handoff that the destination agent reads as data and summarizes; during a skill invocation the host and its model provider receive that output directly. Everything runs locally with Python's standard library: the bundled reader never contacts the network, never invokes the source agent's CLI, never modifies the source store, and ships no MCP server, credentials, scheduler or background service. Recovered text is marked untrusted and stale, and redaction is best-effort rather than complete data-loss prevention. This is offline context migration, not live session restore.
interface.default_prompt: Resume my last session from this repository as a fresh handoff.
default_prompts: Resume my last session from this repository as a fresh handoff.

interface.long_description: Bagel lets you ask questions about robotics, drone, and IoT data (ROS 1/2 bags, MCAP, PX4/ArduPilot/Betaflight logs, CAN/MF4, live MQTT) in plain English. release.description: Automatically guards supported Codex tool calls with Atbash safety judgments and provides secure local setup guidance.

interface.short_description: Guard tool calls with Atbash
interface.long_description:
Atbash Safety checks supported Codex tool calls against your Atbash agent's safety policy before execution. The package includes a local PreToolUse hook, the bundled production Atbash SDK, and a setup and troubleshooting skill; it does not use an MCP server.

Requires a supported local Codex environment, Node.js 22.13 or newer, an Atbash account with a registered agent, and network access to Atbash services. Configure your agent private key and exact organization name in the local Atbash configuration file, then explicitly review and trust the hook in Codex. Never paste private keys into chat.

Once configured, enabled, and trusted, the hook sends tool-call details through the SDK to Atbash for a judgment. ALLOW permits the pending call; HOLD, BLOCK, and handled configuration or service errors deny that attempt. Coverage is limited to tool calls exposed to Codex's PreToolUse lifecycle; ordinary Chat, plain-text replies, and tools outside that lifecycle are not protected.

Source and setup instructions: https://github.com/Atbash-Ai/atbash-chatgpt-plugin
interface.default_prompt: Use $atbash-setup to configure Atbash without sharing my private key.
default_prompts: Use $atbash-setup to configure Atbash without sharing my private key.

release.description: Twelve focused workflows for cryptography research, proof review, manuscript writing, protocol implementation, benchmarking, and reproducible artifacts.

interface.short_description: Research workflows for crypto
interface.long_description:
Twelve focused skills for researchers working on cryptographic constructions and papers, especially secure multiparty computation and zero-knowledge proofs.

Formulate research questions, trace literature claims to primary sources, draft and minimally edit technical prose, and examine security arguments under their stated definitions and assumptions. For implementation work, use separate workflows for protocol correspondence, benchmark accounting, evaluation writing, and reproducible artifacts.

The skills emphasize precise models, evidence provenance, conservative claims, and keeping the requested scope small. Proof audits distinguish confirmed errors, proof gaps, unstated assumptions, and unverified dependencies. They are read-only unless edits or proof completion are requested.

This package provides workflow instructions and references. It does not certify security, replace expert review, or supply a proof assistant. The host agent's available tools determine which searches, file edits, builds, and experiments can actually run.

release.description: An interactive, non-legal assessment that helps emerging companies sanity-check document readiness before fundraising.

interface.short_description: Assess financing readiness
interface.long_description:
Prepare for financing with a clearer picture of your company's records and a practical plan for what to organize next.

ECVC Financing Readiness helps founders and emerging-company teams turn scattered information into a structured preparation checklist. See which records appear accounted for, which need attention, and which questions remain unanswered before initial investor diligence.

Start with guided questions, review of documents you choose to provide, or both. An optional pitch deck can help prefill company context; its claims are flagged for confirmation, not treated as proof.

The seven-step assessment covers company and governance records; capitalization; people, intellectual property and digital assets; financial and tax organization; commercial agreements, privacy and regulatory records; disputes and investigations; and data-room organization.

Get a provisional process-readiness score alongside assessment completeness and reviewed-evidence coverage, so the result shows both your preparation and the limits of the information available. A category summary and prioritized action plan help your team decide what to organize first.

When requested, create an editable readiness report, workbook, or data-room index and action plan in a format supported by your environment. A data-room index is an organizational aid, not a hosted data room.

Provided by Pillsbury Winthrop Shaw Pittman LLP. Workflow author: Steve Ryan.

This plugin provides general information and organizational guidance, not legal or investment advice. It does not determine legal validity, ownership, enforceability, compliance or investment suitability, or predict whether financing will succeed. Use does not create an attorney-client relationship. Share only materials you are authorized to provide and remove unnecessary sensitive information.

release.description: Evidence-backed engineering backlog discovery: turn any repository into a prioritized list of real work without manufacturing issues.

interface.short_description: Find real work in any repo
interface.long_description: Repo Scout reviews a whole repository, not just a diff: architecture, frontend, backend and data, mobile, systems, security and privacy, tests and CI, docs and releases, and AI-agent code. It maps modules and data flow first, then hunts for candidate problems, actively looks for counter-evidence, and returns a ranked backlog where every finding carries a source location, impact, an evidence level (E0 lead to E3 reproduced), the alternative explanations that were checked, a minimal fix direction and acceptance criteria. The report ends with a coverage matrix that says what was inspected, partially inspected, blocked or skipped. The default scan mode never modifies code, runs project scripts, opens issues or triggers CI; verification, planning, publishing and fixing each need explicit authorization. A read-only, filename-only inventory helper is bundled; no MCP server, credentials, scheduler or background service is included.

release.description: Find, explain, and keep an eye on household bills without a HomeOps account or storage

interface.short_description: Find and explain bills
interface.long_description: You know the bill arrived. You just can't find it. Ask instead. “How much is my electricity bill?” HomeOps finds the email, opens the actual PDF where there is one, and tells you the amount, the period, and when it's due. When something isn't stated — no due date, an unclear figure — it says so, rather than filling the gap with a guess. It can remind you before a bill falls due, and check each week for the next one from a provider you name. Those checks belong to you: they live in ChatGPT, and you can pause or delete them whenever you like. And here's the part most apps can't say. HomeOps has no account, no database, no server. It isn't that we promise not to keep your bills — there is nowhere for them to go.

interface.short_description: 対話から、論考・指示・レビュー・掲載を育てる
interface.long_description:
Dialogue Skillsは、人間とAIの対話を文章や実行用の指示へ育てる、4つの独立したスキルです。

・Essay：人間の着想をまとまって伝え、AIによる検討と総括を別の部分に置いた論考を作ります。
・Prompt：人間の制作動機を残し、エージェントに託す目的と実行条件を備えたプロンプトにします。
・Checker：制作意図と完成条件に照らしてレビューします。必要な修正、確認不足、任意の拡張を区別し、目的を満たす成果物には完成を伝えます。
・Publisher：完成原稿を利用者が選んだ媒体・言語・公開形態へ整え、利用環境で操作できる場合に掲載や更新を進めます。

各スキルは必要なものだけ単独で使えます。本文と付属の事例は日本語です。掲載先への接続や認証情報は同梱していません。掲載やファイル保存などの実行範囲は、利用するChatGPT・Codex環境のツールと権限に依存します。

論考とレビューでは、本文に加えて紹介するリンクや添付も対象とし、読者への有用性と会話の参加者にとっての適切さを確かめます。AIによるレビューは、誤りが一切ないことの保証ではありません。

release.description: Rules for clear, unambiguous and information-dense technical Czech.

interface.short_description: Clear Czech technical writing
interface.long_description:
Controlled Czech is an open specification for clear, unambiguous and information-dense technical Czech, packaged as a skill. Use it when writing, editing or reviewing Czech documentation, specifications, ADRs, issues, pull request descriptions, runbooks and AI agent instructions.

Every rule has a stable identifier (CCxxx), so the agent can load a single rule instead of the whole specification and every suggestion can be traced back to it. Only the skill description enters the context up front; the full rules load when Czech text is actually being written.

The repository also ships a deterministic linter written in Go (controlled-czech check). It runs offline, uses no LLM and never rewrites text, so the same rules can gate documentation in CI with --fail-on-warning.

Not intended for marketing copy, fiction, personal communication or brand voice.
interface.default_prompt: Přepiš tento koncept podle Controlled Czech a vysvětli, která pravidla CCxxx jsi použil.

release.description: Persistent AI memory, saved context, tasks, and local relay tools.

interface.short_description: Persistent memory for your AI
interface.long_description:
BetterContext provides persistent memory for AI tasks that have local computer access. Save and recall project decisions, preferences, notes, and tasks; register chats with MEM message counters; and relay messages between registered chats sharing one database.

This Directory release contains skills and local Python commands. It does not register BetterContext callable MCP tools. Memory and relay work through the assistant's local command execution and require Python 3.10+ plus access to your chosen persistent folder. Ordinary hosted ChatGPT chats cannot access your computer's memory database by installing this plugin. Hosted ChatGPT Work may run these commands in its own execution environment; persistence and sharing between hosted chats are not guaranteed. This is separate from storage on your computer. The full local package provides direct MCP tool integration separately.

To choose or move storage, ask: "Show my memory location" or "Move my existing BetterContext memory to [absolute folder]." To share a store between computers, enroll each installation in the same permanent shared registry using that computer's mount path. Migrations preview the change, create a verified backup, preserve records and counters, and update enrolled installations. Keep the registry outside the moved folder and reachable by every host. Public and private editions stay separate.

MEM counters reconcile available visible assistant-message history; prefix display depends on the assistant following the skill. A counter is not a complete transcript archive. Cross-chat recall covers saved/imported content and accessible history, not every conversation in your account.

Relay queues messages; it does not itself wake another chat. An optional helper can wake selected local Codex tasks when the destination computer is running and has a compatible Codex CLI. Windows helper installation is tested; new Linux/macOS installers and reboot behavior remain unverified. Hosted ChatGPT wake is unavailable.

Records stay in your chosen local or shared-filesystem database. Unknown Digital LLC operates no storage backend or telemetry for these records. Retrieved information enters your assistant conversation under that platform's data settings. No measured chat-wide token-savings claim is made.

release.description: Skills for the Mergify CLI: merge queue, stacked pull requests, CI Insights, merge protections, and configuration.

interface.short_description: Run and debug your merge queue
interface.long_description:
Mergify serializes merges through a queue that runs CI on temporary merge commits, so a pull request that only breaks in combination with another one gets caught before it reaches your default branch. These skills drive the Mergify CLI so an agent can work that queue with you.

Ask why a pull request left the queue and get the engine's own dequeue reason, the checks that failed, and a link straight to the job log. Read the activity log for one pull request or for the whole repository. Validate a .mergify.yml against the schema before you commit it, or simulate what your rules would do on a real pull request. Set up merge protections such as dependencies between pull requests or scheduled freezes for a release window. Turn a branch of commits into a stack of one pull request per commit and keep them rebased.

Six skills ship in the bundle: mergify-merge-queue, mergify-events, mergify-config, mergify-merge-protections, mergify-ci, and mergify-stack.

It runs on the Mergify CLI, a single static binary with no runtime to install, so it needs a local execution environment: Codex, or ChatGPT desktop with local execution. You need a GitHub repository with Mergify enabled. Install the CLI with 'brew install mergifyio/tap/mergify-cli', sign in once with 'mergify auth login' or set MERGIFY_TOKEN, then ask for what you want in plain language.
interface.default_prompt: Why did pull request #1234 leave the merge queue?
default_prompts: Why did pull request #1234 leave the merge queue?

Une image pour ouvrir un regard, un sourire pour rapprocher, une phrase pour laisser une trace. Poetize vous aide à trouver des mots qui vous ressemblent, qui touchent et qui résonnent.

Message à un proche, post, prompt, discours, communication d’entreprise ou parole de leader : vous apportez votre voix, nous lui donnons du souffle.

Avant la plume, la rencontre. Quelques questions précisent votre public, votre histoire, votre singularité, vos trois messages clés et l’émotion à transmettre. Puis vient un texte abouti : métaphores, rimes intérieures, punchlines et traits d’esprit, du personnel à l’universel, entre profondeur et légèreté.

L’intelligence poétique relie le vécu, l’imagination et le sens pour éveiller l’émotion et ouvrir des possibles. Pour le leadership, Poetize s’appuie sur les 4H — Héritage, Humanité, Horizon, Harmonie — créés par Vincent Avanzi, Chief Poetic Officer, pour le Bureau of Poetic Leadership (BPL).

Des textes qui prennent vie à voix haute : rythme, souffle, pauses et mots qui résonnent. Prose poétique, vers ou slam, selon votre envie ; indications d’interprétation sur demande. Pour une vie plus poétique et un avenir plus harmonieux, en lien avec les autres et le vivant.

release.description: Data engineering plugin - warehouse exploration, pipeline authoring, Airflow integration

interface.short_description: Build and debug Airflow DAGs
interface.long_description:
Astronomer's toolkit for Apache Airflow and the data it moves. Ask for a pipeline, a fix or an answer from your warehouse, and the plugin follows the steps an Airflow engineer would.

Build and test DAGs. Write new DAGs, extend existing ones, and test them locally before you deploy. Covers dbt with Cosmos, DAG Factory, Blueprint, human-in-the-loop tasks, Airflow plugins, and tasks written in Go or Java.

Debug failures. Find out why a DAG fails to parse or a task keeps failing. The plugin reads the logs, finds the root cause, and fixes the code.

Run Astro. Set up an Astro project, run Airflow locally, deploy, and troubleshoot Astro deployments.

Migrate. Move DAGs from Airflow 2 to Airflow 3, or move a Dagster project to Airflow.

Query your warehouse. Answer business questions with SQL against Snowflake, BigQuery, Postgres and other SQLAlchemy databases. Profile tables, check how fresh the data is, and generate a schema reference so later questions go faster.

Trace lineage. See what feeds a table and what breaks downstream if it changes.

Most skills run local tools such as the Astro CLI and uv, so they work best in Codex. Warehouse skills read connection details from ~/.astro/agents/warehouse.yml.

release.description: Follow-ups, matter updates, meeting briefs, and prospect signals for law firm partners, sourced from the inbox you already have and the public web.

interface.short_description: Partner inbox intelligence
interface.long_description:
Most business development support tools want your data and tell you what to do. Maeve Lite reads the inbox you already have, keeps everything inside your ChatGPT workspace, quotes rather than guesses, and never touches a deadline.

Five skills for the partner who runs relationships out of email: Follow-up Radar finds what you owe, what you're waiting on, and which prospect threads have gone quiet. Matter Pulse turns recent mail into update-ready litigation and deal updates for your business development or operations team. Meeting Brief gives you the one page you read before a call, built from your own history with the people in the room. Week Ahead lays out what's scheduled, what's due, and what needs preparing. Client News Monitor finds recent public developments about a named prospect or client and their company, with an opened source behind every fact.

Built for how relationship-owning lawyers actually work. The mailbox is treated as the record because the CRM rarely is. Every line, date, client scope and output cites the email it came from, so you can verify it in one step. The output is a reading of your mail, not a floating recommendation.

Nothing leaves your workspace. The mailbox skills use the Gmail or Outlook account already authorized in ChatGPT and are read-only by default; Follow-up Radar and Matter Pulse can create one unsent draft on explicit request, and no skill ever sends email. Client News Monitor uses public web search only and never touches email or other connected data. Maeve operates no server behind these skills: no analytics, no callbacks, and no transfer of prompts, outputs, mailbox content, or credentials to Maeve. Confidential matter details never go into a web query.

Intended for ChatGPT Business or Enterprise workspaces, where terms exclude training on your content. Maeve Lite does not provide legal advice. Maeve Lite runs on one partner's mailbox; Maeve brings the same signals firm-wide across matters, people, and clients — for enterprise product contact www.maeven.ai.

interface.long_description:
Keybook 是供本机已授权任务使用的凭据目录。首次使用时，告诉它你现有凭据 YAML 文件的绝对路径；它会在本地检查格式，只保存路径。以后无需反复粘贴密码或 API Key，直接让 AI 继续原任务即可。

需要登录网站时，可查找 web 分类中的用户名、邮箱、指定密码变体和 PIN；需要本机授权时，可分别查找 system 中的 macOS 登录密码或登录钥匙串密码。发布 npm 包、上传 Hugging Face 模型或数据集、推送 Docker 镜像、操作 GitHub/GitLab、部署 Cloudflare 时，可按名称查找 services 中对应的令牌。调用 OpenRouter、ModelScope 等模型 API 时，查找 llm 中的密钥；连接已授权的 SSH 主机时，查找 ssh 中的私钥文件路径。实际可用条目取决于你自己的 YAML，Keybook 不会假定某个服务已配置。

Keybook 先搜索条目名称，再用随包脚本把选定值注入可信目标程序的环境变量，并继续任务。list/search 只返回名称，get 始终遮盖值，run 隐藏子进程输出并只报告状态；不会在对话中展示明文。SSH 条目是文件路径，由目标程序传给 SSH 客户端。你自行维护本地 YAML；插件不会创建、加密或同步它，也不提供浏览器自动填充。需要本机终端与 Node.js 22+。

release.description: Compare, use, and tune original Soul Kit personalities in ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.short_description: Compare and tune AI voices
interface.long_description:
Give your AI a voice of its own.

Compare Flint, Lantern, and Moss on your own question, then choose the personality you want to work with. Flint gets to the decision, Lantern explains with a concrete example, and Moss offers a measured view with occasional dry humor. You can also import a Soul Kit from Honorary Human.

Adjust the selected voice as you work: less humor, warmer wording, shorter answers, or writing only. Ask which voice is active, pause and resume it, reset your adjustments, or switch personalities. These choices apply to the current conversation. Your instructions, facts, and requested format take priority.

When you ask to save lasting changes, Soulware can prepare a revised portable Soul Kit. With file execution available, its bundled helper validates and versions the file while preserving the original. Otherwise it can provide manually inspected JSON to save yourself. Reimport the revised kit to use it in another conversation.

In local Codex, you can also export a reusable voice skill, install it for yourself or a project, and choose whether to make it a default. Inspect, update, or remove installed kits when needed.

The plugin requires no Soulware account or API key. Its bundled helper makes no network requests and does not send your kit or conversations to Honorary Human. ChatGPT and Codex still process the content you give them under their own settings and policies.

Find more Soul Kits or create an original personality at honoraryhuman.com. A personality is a designed communication style. It does not impersonate a real person or change account-wide ChatGPT preferences.

release.description:
You know the problem. A deadline slips, another fire drill ensues, and it turns out the team knew weeks ago. The information was there. An easy channel for surfacing it wasn't.

Conventional status reporting is painful and often inaccurate as reports get sanitized on the way up. By the time a project is obviously red, the good options have gone.

Genchi opens a different channel, straight to the people actually doing the work. Team members are prompted for a regular two-second check-in: one click, answering how confident they are their initiative will hit its goal by the deadline. Individual answers are anonymous, which is what makes them honest. Aggregated, they become a confidence score you can track over time.

This plugin puts that score into the conversation, rendered rather than described. Ask how your projects are tracking and your whole portfolio appears as color-coded cards. More complex project structures unfurl with a click, and clicking any card opens the confidence chart — the current score, the trend over the last fortnight, the anonymized individual check-ins, and any blockers or comments that add context.

Things rarely go wrong all at once. Seeing a team's confidence begin to slip is an opportunity to intervene while there is still time to change the outcome.

Replace the status meeting, and the incessant "so, how's it going?" calls, with a crisp and honest view.

Inspired by the Toyota Production System's genchi genbutsu — "go and see for yourself" — Genchi does the same for software teams: a picture built by the people actually doing the work, at minimal reporting cost.

Each connection is authorized by one person and shows only what they can already see in Genchi. Individual check-ins are never attributed. Check-ins are cast in Slack, or by email.

Genchi also imports initiatives from Jira and Asana, and is free for teams under 10.

AI notetaker for in-person and online meetings. Search meeting notes, transcripts, decisions and action items in 100+ languages.

Your company's know-how lives in people's heads and in meetings nobody can search. VoiceCap turns every meeting - online and in the room - into organisational knowledge your team and your AI can actually use.

Ask what was decided, who committed to what, or when a topic last came up, and get an answer that links to the exact second it was said.

Eight read-only tools: search across transcripts, summaries and decisions at once; list meetings by date, group or participant; open one meeting's full record; read any transcript window word for word; and pull decisions or action items across many meetings in a single call. VoiceCap also implements the standard search and fetch pair, so deep research can cite your meeting archive directly. Decision Memory tracks what a team has agreed across many meetings, so you can ask whether something was already settled instead of re-litigating it.

It exists because nothing handled non-english languages properly and nothing handled in-person meetings properly. VoiceCap records in-person meetings from a phone as well as online calls, and transcribes 30+ European languages and 100+ languages overall.

- Go multilingual: add a language and translate pages in place.

release.description: Registered Dubai property data for research: sale prices, rents, gross rental yields, growth and off-plan returns by building, area and villa community, from Dubai Land Department and Ejari records, with sources and sample sizes on every figure.

interface.short_description: Registered Dubai property data
interface.long_description:
Dubai Wealth Index answers what Dubai homes sell for, rent for and yield, from registered records rather than listings. Figures are medians of Dubai Land Department sale transactions and Ejari rental contracts, published per apartment building, per area and per villa community, and date-stamped by data edition.

Ask about one building by its registered or marketing name, or get a full report on it covering every unit size, growth with both comparison periods, and each figure that was withheld for lack of evidence. Filter the whole index on your own thresholds (price band, minimum gross yield, minimum evidence), compare two to four buildings on matching bedroom types, read a published ranking, inspect the individual transactions behind a median, test an agent's claimed yield against registered records, and see what changed in your saved buildings since an earlier edition. Every figure comes with its bedroom type, unit, period, data date and evidence count.

Built for investors, buyers, tenants, analysts and journalists who need a sourced Dubai property figure.

Limitations: Dubai only. Yields are gross, before service charges and other costs. Short-term rental returns are modelled from a stated occupancy assumption, not measured. Villas are published by community, not individually. The index holds no listings, cannot arrange viewings, and does not give investment, mortgage, tax or legal advice. Every tool is read-only. Connecting requires a Dubai Wealth Index account, which also lets the plugin read the buildings you have saved on dubaiwealthindex.com.

interface.short_description: AI Bookkeeping for Startups
interface.long_description:
Accountable is AI bookkeeping for startups and the founders who run more than one company: books kept by AI and closed every day. With this plugin, ChatGPT reads and keeps those books for you.

What you can do:
- Ask how a company is doing: cash, net burn, runway and revenue, from the live books.
- Pull a profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow or trial balance for any months or exact days, on a cash or accrual basis, and ask why a number changed.
- See which transactions still need a category, categorize them the way the company already does, and save a rule so a vendor never asks again.
- Read bills, invoices and who owes what, and check how this month's close is going.
- Post a journal entry, comment on a record, label an alert or save a planning scenario.

How changes work: every change is previewed first and changes nothing until you confirm it. Each change is logged with your name and ChatGPT's, follows your role in that company (a viewer can read but not change), and can be undone. Closed months stay closed.

Who it is for: founders and the finance people who work with them, on an Accountable account. Sign in with your Accountable account and choose which companies ChatGPT may open, and whether it may only read.

Limitations: it never moves money. It records payments that already happened but cannot pay a bill, send a transfer or file taxes. Sending invoices, closing a month, imports and settings stay in Accountable's app.

release.description: Sports video analysis: measures speed, distance and joint angles from your own phone videos and replays the motion in 3D.

interface.short_description: Measure your moves in 3D
interface.long_description:
Autelica is a sports video analysis app. It measures human movement from ordinary phone videos: how fast you ran, how far you went, your knee and hip angles and your left-right balance, with a 3D replay of the motion.

Attach a video of your sprint, jump, cut or swing and ask how fast you were. Autelica measures the whole motion, not a few frames: top speed, distance, knee and hip angles and left-right balance, with a 3D view you can orbit. One video gives an estimate, clearly labelled. Two to four videos of the same moment, filmed at the same time from different sides, give a measurement: Autelica lines up the clips, works out where each camera was from the athlete's own body and rebuilds every joint in 3D. While it processes, the card shows your place in the queue; when it's done, ChatGPT explains what the numbers mean and what to work on.

No video yet? Open an example: a real athlete filmed by three drones or three tripod cameras, rebuilt as a photoreal replay you can freeze and fly around, with its measured numbers. Or ask how to film: Autelica gives a setup for the number of phones you have.

Beat the sprint is a game built on the same motion: tap on each footstrike to race a real athlete's captured run, then send a friend a link to race your ghost.

Each result carries a grade that says how well the cameras agreed, and nothing about the athlete is generated. No account needed. Numbers are measurements from video with stated accuracy, not medical advice.

release.description:
Converly is the easiest way to send conversions to Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, and more when someone submits a form, schedules an appointment or starts a chat on your site.

This plugin makes it super easy to set up. You simply say things like 'Send conversions to ChatGPT Ads when someone submits the contact form on my website' and the plugin will set up a conversion flow, give you a snippet of code to add to your site, and test that it's all set up and working.

It can detect conversions in 100+ tools, including Gravity Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Typeform, Jotform, Webflow Forms, Wix Forms, Squarespace Forms, Calendly, Acuity Scheduling, Cal.com & more.

It can send conversions to 20+ destinations, including Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads and more.

Converly supports conditional logic so you can decide exactly when a conversion fires, such as when someone submits your Quote Request form but not your Contact Support form.

Instead of relying on the visitor's browser to send conversions, Converly sends conversions directly to the ad platforms' servers, where ad blockers and privacy restrictions in iOS and Safari can't get in the way.

It also captures the lead's name, email, phone, click IDs, IP address, device, etc and sends it with the conversion. This gives ad platforms the data they need to match the conversion back to a real person and the original ad they clicked. Ultimately, this means you get more accurate conversion data, and your ad platform can understand what a good lead looks like for your business so it can go find more of them.

Converly gives you a full debug log that shows exactly what was captured, what was sent where, and whether it arrived successfully. You can even query it through the plugin by saying something like 'Is my conversion tracking working properly' and it will query the log and respond.

Customer Success teams don't lack data — they lack a single place to make sense of it. Signals live in one tool, conversations in another, notes somewhere else entirely, and by the time it's all pulled together, the moment to act has often passed. Vitally brings all this data together under one roof, so CS teams can proactively fight churn, spot expansion opportunities, and grow their customer relationships. 

The Vitally MCP connector brings that same account intelligence into ChatGPT, wherever you're already working. Ask about any customer and get answers grounded in the full context your team has captured — not just the surface-level number, but the substance behind it: what customers have actually said, done, and asked for. Every answer is scoped to exactly what your own Vitally login can already see, so nothing surfaces that you couldn't already find yourself.

Take action on customer data directly from a ChatGPT session, capturing what you've learned, moving work forward, and keeping your workspace current without switching tools or losing the thread.

Built for CSMs, CS leaders, and Account Management teams who want to spend less time hunting for context and more time staying a step ahead of churn and unlocking growth — all without leaving ChatGPT.

release.description:
Glow is WordPress maintenance and management software for agencies: updates, uptime and SSL monitoring, backups, vulnerability scanning, client reporting and support tickets, for every site an agency looks after, in one dashboard.

A vulnerability is published most weeks and the first question is the same: which of my sites are exposed? Answering that across forty sites means opening forty dashboards, so it does not get answered until something breaks. Connected to Glow it is one question with one answer, and the follow-up (update those, safely) happens in the same conversation.

What you can ask: which sites run a plugin below a given version; what needs updating on a particular site; which sites a newly published vulnerability affects; which went down this month and which certificates expire soon; which have no recent backup or no scheduled report; and which clients are over their monthly time allowance.

What it can change, each behind its own permission, granted deliberately and none of them required: run updates, where plugins go through Safe Updates with a backup and screenshot first, a check afterwards and a rollback if needed, while themes and WordPress core are not reversible, which the tool says plainly before running one; turn uptime monitoring on or off for a website; and log work against a website and set its monthly time allowance.

What it can never do: delete a website, a backup or a client, or deactivate a plugin, a theme or anything on a client's website. Those are not exposed to assistants at all.

A connection sees exactly what the person who authorised it sees, including any per-website restrictions, and never receives passwords, connection keys or website content. Every request is logged, and a connection can be ended at any time.

For WordPress agencies, freelancers and reseller accounts looking after many client sites.

release.description: Tracklists for DJ sets on YouTube: every track with its timestamp, the track playing at any moment, and the sets a track was played in.

interface.short_description: DJ set tracklists from YouTube
interface.long_description:
WhatsTheID connects your assistant to its database of DJ set tracklists from YouTube. Ask what was played in a set, which track is playing at a given moment of a video, which sets a track has been played in, or what a channel has uploaded recently. Answers come from WhatsTheID's public tracklists, with links to the full tracklist and to the exact moment on YouTube.

Every track is labelled so you know how far to trust it: identified or still an unknown ID, and whether it comes from the uploader's own tracklist or YouTube's music detection, from listener comments, or from WhatsTheID's audio recognition. Estimated times are marked as estimates. If a set is not on WhatsTheID yet, the assistant says so and gives a link to add it; it never guesses a tracklist.

Tools:
- Search DJ sets: find sets by DJ, event, festival, club, channel or genre.
- Get set tracklist: the full tracklist of one set from its YouTube link.
- Find track at timestamp: the track playing at a moment like 42:10, with the previous and next tracks.
- Search tracks: find a track and the sets it was played in.
- Latest sets from a channel: a channel's newest sets with tracklists.

Read-only, with no account needed. Each answer is small (one tracklist or up to ten results) and links back to whatstheid.com.

release.description:
1F916 keeps a tamper-evident record of what an AI agent was told and what it did. Before acting, the assistant records the instruction and the action it is about to take. Afterwards it adds the result to the same record. It can also seal a memory, so a later session can check whether it changed.

Each record is chained into a public log. Every few minutes the registry signs a stamp over the whole log, independent witnesses countersign the stamps, and copies are sent to Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) and Base. A record altered afterwards would no longer match the published stamps, and anyone can check that with the inclusion and consistency proofs this app returns.

By default only fingerprints (SHA-256) are public. The text stays with you, or is stored encrypted to your key.

This app moves no money and calls nothing outside the 1F916 registry. Reading needs no sign-in. Writing asks you to sign in once: register the assistant as an agent with its own 1F916 handle, or connect one that already exists.

interface.long_description:
Shortlist Pass hosts the live pages of real local businesses around Myrtle Beach, South Carolina — food trucks, restaurants, bakeries, shops and HOA communities. Shortlist Pass is the first-party platform these businesses run their pages, menus, stops and ordering on; this plugin reads that data directly from Shortlist Pass and helps a customer place an order.

What it reads: each business's profile, hours and whether ordering is open; the full menu with prices; and every upcoming stop or event with its date, time, address and — for food trucks — the menu being sold at that particular stop, plus the pickup times still available. A stop whose menu the owner has not set yet says so rather than showing everything.

What it does: with start_order, the assistant sends the items and quantities the customer wants (never prices). The customer opens that link on the business's own page, reviews the order, chooses an optional tip, and pays there through the business's own Stripe or Square checkout. Payment never happens inside ChatGPT. The assistant never takes payment and never sees card details. The cart expires in 30 minutes if it is not paid.

No account, no sign-in and no key are needed. Demo pages and cancelled or test events are never returned.

release.description: Fastio workspaces for agents and the people they work with: files, shares, comments, metadata and AI search through the Fastio MCP server, plus the agent guide as a skill.

interface.short_description: Files, workspaces, AI search
interface.long_description:
Fastio is a workspace and file-storage platform for teams. This app connects a signed-in Fastio account to ChatGPT: browse and search workspaces and files, read file text and metadata, organize folders, upload files, manage branded shares, read and add comments, and manage workspace and share members.

Sign-in uses OAuth in the browser; the app acts with the permissions of the signed-in account. No tool accepts a password, API key or verification code, and no tool returns one.

Each operation is its own tool (for example `storage_search`, `storage_create_folder`, `share_create`). Read tools only retrieve data. Tools that change data are marked as writes, and tools that delete or overwrite data are marked destructive, so ChatGPT can ask the user before running them.

Search finds files by keyword or semantic match within one workspace or share and returns ranked results with short excerpts; a separate tool returns a quoted passage from a specific file.

Documentation: https://tokenos.ai/mcp/gas-tracker

Outputs are informational — on-chain reads, deterministic calculators and heuristic scans — not financial, legal or security advice. TokenOS is non-custodial and never holds keys or funds; anything you launch, deploy or sign happens from your own wallet.

release.description:
Tailor lets ChatGPT read Tailor Platform's public documentation and answer questions about building on it, grounded in the published docs rather than training data.

Tailor Platform is a headless ERP platform: define your data model, workflows, and permissions in code with the Tailor SDK, and get a GraphQL API, TailorDB, StateFlow workflows, Pipelines, Auth, and an App Shell for building business applications.

What this plugin does:
- search_knowledge: find documentation pages whose body text mentions a term, with an excerpt and a link for each hit
- list_knowledge: browse the table of contents by source or section
- fetch_knowledge: read a page as Markdown, or one section of a long page

Every answer can cite the exact page on docs.tailor.tech.

No account, sign-in, or token is required. The plugin only reads Tailor's published documentation; it cannot access any customer's application, data, or workspace. All tools are read-only.

Good for: developers evaluating or building on Tailor Platform, teams writing tailor.config.ts, and anyone asking how to do something in TailorDB, StateFlow, or the Tailor SDK.

release.description: Example gross-revenue planner for wellness service lines at a clinic in the United States.

interface.short_description: Plan clinic wellness revenue
interface.long_description:
MODRN Wellness Menu Planner helps an owner or manager of a clinic in the United States sketch example monthly and yearly gross revenue from wellness service lines the clinic would offer. You choose the lines, the price your clinic would charge, and the share of patients you expect to use each line. Optional room and hour inputs can cap the visit count. The card shows a low, expected, and high range by varying the uptake you enter. Defaults are example starting assumptions for you to edit. They are not market statistics. Figures are estimates from your inputs, before clinic costs, and they are not a promise of revenue.

The planner does not name, price, or sell any product. It does not link to a shop or a checkout. It does not give medical advice. Service lines are generic categories your clinic prices itself. No login is required.

If you want a next step, you can book a 30-minute call or ask MODRN to call you. Contact is by email or phone. The app does not offer text messages, and it does not collect patient information.

release.description: Interactive AP Calculus lessons with animations and multiple-choice questions.

interface.short_description: AP Calculus visual lessons
interface.long_description:
Sophie Tutor opens an interactive AP Calculus lesson next to the chat. Each lesson moves one step at a time: an animation shows the idea, a short text explains it, and multiple-choice questions check understanding. A wrong answer explains the mistake and lets the student try again; a right answer shows why it is right. At the end, the student sees a short summary and a score.

Lessons cover AP Calculus AB and BC topics: limits and continuity, average and instantaneous rates of change, derivatives from the definition, the product rule, the chain rule, higher derivatives, L’Hôpital’s rule, optimization, u-substitution, definite integrals on a calculator, differential equations from word problems, and area in polar coordinates.

It is for high-school students who take AP Calculus, and for anyone who wants to review a calculus topic visually. Sophie Tutor only opens a lesson when one matches the topic; for other topics, ChatGPT helps as usual. It needs no account and collects no personal information.
interface.default_prompt: Teach me the chain rule.
default_prompts: Teach me the chain rule.
I don't get L’Hôpital’s rule. Can you show me?

release.description:
AiEngage CRM connects ChatGPT to your own AiEngage CRM workspace so you can ask questions about your sales and marketing data in plain language instead of building a report.

Ask how many contacts you have, what is in the pipeline and at which stage, which campaign performed best last quarter, who on the team logged the most meetings, how a workflow or web form is converting, or what your advertising spend returned. ChatGPT reads the answer directly from your live CRM and explains it.

The connection is strictly read-only. There is no tool that can create, edit, delete or send anything, so nothing in your CRM can be changed from ChatGPT.

You sign in with your own AiEngage login and choose exactly which areas ChatGPT may read - records, reports, analytics, campaigns, segments, lists, workflows, advertising, web forms and more - and which modules within them. Every read runs as you, so ChatGPT sees only the records your CRM permissions already allow you to see, and nothing from any other organization. You can change what is shared, or disconnect entirely, at any time from Settings > API & Connections.

release.description: Design custom map posters of the places that matter, as wall art or a personalized gift: where you met, got engaged or married, a first home, a hometown, a city someone is leaving or a trip. Pick any city, address or landmark and one of 50+ styles, add names, a date and a heart on the spot, then open the poster in the MapPoster editor at mapposter.xyz to fine-tune it or, in the drawn map styles, order it as a print.

interface.short_description: Map poster gifts and wall art
interface.long_description:
MapPoster turns the places in your life into a map poster: a personal gift for someone you love, or wall art for your own home.

Tell ChatGPT the occasion and the place, and MapPoster designs the poster right in the chat. Make a map of the street where you met as an anniversary or Valentine's gift, or of the venue where a couple got married as a wedding gift. Give friends a housewarming gift of their first home with a heart on their new street, or give someone who is moving away a map of their hometown. You can also map the city of a honeymoon or a road trip, or a baby's birthplace in soft pastels for the nursery.

Every poster is a map of a real place: a city, neighborhood, street address or landmark, in one of 50+ styles. Add your own title, names, a date, coordinates or a short message in 14 fonts, a heart or marker on the exact spot and a driving route on the map. Make it a heart-shaped, round or hexagon map, or add a gallery mat. One poster can also hold up to three places, each with its own map and label: where you met, got engaged and got married, or two cities for a long-distance couple.

You see a preview of the poster in the conversation and can try other styles and move the map right there. Screen-size designs in 15 of the styles can be downloaded as a PNG (up to 1080 px, with a small watermark). Every design opens in the MapPoster editor at mapposter.xyz to fine-tune it, and posters in the drawn map styles can be ordered there as a printed poster (from A4), a framed print or a canvas, up to 18x24 in, plus square sizes, shipped to you or straight to the person it's for.

What you can ask for:
- Map wall art for a living room, home office, dorm or nursery
- Styles from minimalist black and white and vintage-style to blueprint, dark, neon, pastel and rose gold
- Sizes for prints, square frames, Instagram and phone or desktop wallpapers

Limits: up to three places per poster; a poster with several places is rectangular, with the markers and route on its first map. Routes are driving routes. The chat preview leaves out street names; the classic city map styles show them in the editor. Prints ship to 20 countries, including the US, Canada, the UK, much of Europe, Australia and Japan.

Street maps are drawn from OpenStreetMap data. MapPoster needs no account and doesn't store your posters or your conversation.

온라인으로 간편하게 참여하는 '아모레리사이클'을 통해 다 사용한 화장품 용기를 수거하고 플라스틱 재활용에 동참할 수 있습니다. 환경을 생각하는 작은 실천으로 나만의 디지털 숲을 가꾸며 건강한 뷰티 라이프를 완성해 보세요.

Share a URL, a document, text, or an idea. Canvora reads it and creates a full set of designs – social posts, carousels, stories, ads, presentations, and slide decks – in your saved brand kit (logo, colors, fonts, style). You can create for multiple brands and keep each one consistent.

  - Localize a whole set into any of 150+ supported languages, with text regenerated natively – right-to-left and non-Latin scripts supported

  - Create variations and export to PDF, PPTX, or ZIP at 2K or 4K

Built for creators, freelancers, marketing teams, and agencies – whether you run one brand or many.

release.description:
das-programm – Dein KI-Assistent für den Handwerksbetrieb
das-programm verbindet deinen Handwerksbetrieb direkt mit ChatGPT. Stelle Fragen, erhalte Antworten und löse Aktionen aus — in natürlicher Sprache, ohne durch Menüs zu klicken.
Was du damit machen kannst:
Sprich einfach mit deinen Betriebsdaten. Frag „Welche Rechnungen sind noch offen?" und erhalte sofort eine Übersicht deiner offenen Forderungen. Sieh auf einen Blick, welche Arbeitsberichte und Aufträge noch keine Rechnung haben — damit nichts vergessen wird. Rufe eine monatliche Umsatzübersicht für jedes beliebige Jahr ab: Angebote, Aufträge, Zahlungen und Rechnungen auf einen Blick.
Behalte deine Projekte im Griff. Suche und filtere deine Projekte nach Kunde, Status, Ort oder Projektleiter. Sieh genau, wo jeder Auftrag steht — von der ersten Anfrage über das Angebot und die Auftragsabwicklung bis zum Abschluss.
Verwalte deine Finanzen ohne großen Aufwand. Ruf deine vollständige Debitoren- und Kreditorenliste ab, verfolge ein- und ausgehende Zahlungen und sieh, welche offenen Angebote noch auf eine Unterschrift warten. Wenn ein Kunde im Verzug ist, erstelle und versende eine Mahnung (Stufen 1–4) direkt aus dem Chat.
Nicht nur fragen — auch handeln. Erstelle Rechnungen aus Aufträgen oder Arbeitsberichten und verschicke sie per E-Mail an den Kunden — alles mit einer einzigen Nachricht. Kein Wechseln zwischen Apps, kein Copy-Paste.
Plane deinen Terminkalender. Frage Termine, Arbeitsberichte, Aufgaben und Aufträge für beliebige Zeiträume ab und behalte den Überblick über dein Team.
das-programm wurde speziell für Handwerksbetriebe im DACH-Raum entwickelt — Elektriker, Installateure, Bauunternehmen und alle anderen Gewerke — die ihren Betrieb smarter führen wollen, nicht stressiger.

특정 날짜의 스포츠 경기 데이터를 인터랙티브 위젯으로 즉시 불러와 제공하는 서비스입니다. 정확한 스포츠 데이터에 기반한 할루시네이션 없는 답변을 보장합니다. 오직 정확한 데이터에 기반한 답변만을 제공받게 되며, 이를 통해 ChatGPT와 본 서비스에 대해 더 높은 신뢰를 가질 수 있습니다.
현재 야구, 농구, 축구, 배구 데이터를 제공하며 확대 예정입니다.

1. 할루시네이션 방지 및 신뢰도 향상: 실시간 데이터를 직접 참조하여 정확한 답변을 생성합니다. 근거 없는 정보가 아닌, 팩트에 기반한 고품질의 응답을 경험할 수 있습니다.
2. 데이터 기반의 심층 추론 제공: 단순한 스코어 전달을 넘어 실시간 경기 상황, 팀 간 전력 비교, 선수별 세부 스탯 등 풍부한 데이터를 바탕으로 사용자에게 한 차원 높은 분석을 제공합니다.
3. 인터랙티브 위젯 연동: 각 스포츠 경기 데이터를 시각적 위젯으로 가져와, 텍스트만으로는 전달하기 힘든 복잡한 스포츠 정보를 직관적으로 확인하게 합니다.

특히 Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, Qoo10, TikTok Shop, Shopee 등 글로벌 마켓플레이스 입점 및 운영과 관련해 상품 등록, 판매 전략, 콘텐츠 기획, 광고 운영 방향, 크로스보더 물류 및 글로벌 판매 구조를 보다 쉽게 이해하고 실행 가능한 형태로 정리할 수 있도록 돕습니다.

release.description:
Tripsy helps travelers plan, organize, and manage their trips directly from ChatGPT. Connect your Tripsy account to access itineraries, destinations, reservations, activities, notes, and other trip details, so ChatGPT can answer trip questions, summarize plans, suggest next steps, and help keep your travel information organized before and during your journey.

Example prompts

- “Show me my itinerary for Paris next week.”
- “What reservations do I have on the first day of my trip?”
- “Summarize my upcoming Japan trip.”
- “Help me find gaps in my itinerary.”
- “What activities are planned near my hotel?”
- “Create a day-by-day overview of my trip.”

Use cases

- Review upcoming trips and daily plans
- Find reservations, activities, notes, and key details faster
- Summarize complex itineraries into simple overviews
- Prepare for travel days with checklists and reminders
- Ask natural-language questions about your saved trip plans
- Get help organizing ideas while building your itinerary

Travel with Tripsy anywhere
Tripsy is also available as a native app for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, so you can access and manage your trips during your journey. The native app supports offline access, making your itinerary available even when connectivity is limited.

Realistimo (Реалистимо) helps you find real property listings in Bulgaria — apartments, houses, offices, and more — directly in ChatGPT.

Describe what you're looking for in English or Bulgarian (city, neighborhood, budget, sale or rent). The app shows interactive maps with neighborhoods, photos, prices in euros, and links to the full listings on Realistimo.

• Searching for houses and apartments for sale or rent in Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna, Burgas, Ruse, Stara Zagora and other cities;

release.description:
Before you run something that can't be undone (a force-push, a production deploy, a destructive command, a config change), ask invinoveritas for a verdict: approve, approve with concerns, or reject, with issues ranked by severity and suggested fixes. The verdict can come back as a signed proof that anyone can check later without trusting us.

You can also verify a proof someone handed you (free), read the public verdict track record including the verdicts that turned out wrong (free), timestamp a third party's exact claim, reality-check a backtest, and audit an agent's verifiability.

A verdict is a reasoned second opinion, not a guarantee of outcome.

Each search shows up to 10 products, and the "전체보기" (View all) link on the cards takes you to the full results on Gmarket. When you find the right one, tap the card to complete your purchase on Gmarket.

Gmarket offers a wide selection across fashion, beauty, home appliances, electronics, groceries, home & living, and more.

release.description:
サブスクラインは、LINEを活用したマーケティングCRMです。本コネクターを使うと、ChatGPTから自社のサブスクラインのデータを安全に参照し、各種設定や配信を「下書き・無効状態」で作成できます。

■ 参照（read）
・ユーザーグループ（配信セグメント）の一覧
・顧客基盤の概況（LINE友だち数・ブロック数、サブスク契約の継続/解約、直近の予約・来店）
・課金まわりの情報（販売中プラン、トライアル設定、支払い方法の区分）
・配信の下書き一覧／下書き詳細、送信済み配信の実績レポート（送信対象数・開封・タップ・各率）

■ 作成（write）※すべて安全な状態（下書き／無効／非公開）で新規作成します。既存データの更新・削除や、即時配信・即時公開は行いません。
・セグメント配信／ステップ配信の下書き
・ユーザーグループ（全員対象・条件付き）
・キーワード自動応答
・クーポン
・プラン
・リッチメニューの下書き

作成した内容は管理画面で確認し、人が有効化・公開・配信します。AIがLINEへ直接配信したり、設定を即時公開することはありません。

■ 安全性
・各接続は1つのテナント（契約ワークスペース）に固定。接続先はアクセストークンから決まり、AIクライアント側から変更できないため、テナント越境は起きません。
・認証はOAuth 2.1（PKCE／動的クライアント登録）。スコープ（read／write）はツール単位で制御。
・すべてのツール呼び出しは監査ログに記録。本コネクター経由で取得したデータを当社AIモデルの学習に使用しません。

対象：サブスクラインをご利用中の店舗・事業者さま。

release.description:
Revenue Analytics by DataLabs.store connects your HubSpot data to ChatGPT. It continuously replicates your portal (custom objects, deals, contacts, companies, line items, engagements, email events) into a real relational Microsoft SQL Server database whose schema matches your portal, then lets ChatGPT query it in plain English and return answers backed by the exact SQL that produced them.

Why it exists
HubSpot is built to run your CRM at scale, and its reporting tools are genuinely good at what they were designed for. The limit is structural: standard reports are built one object at a time, so questions that need several tables joined together before the math even starts do not fit. Per-deal margin (deals joined to their line items), multi-hop paths (deal to contact to company to source), correctly weighted stats (SUM(clicks)/SUM(delivered), not an average of averages), cohorts, and window functions all need a real database underneath. That is the job this fills.

What you can ask
- "Rank owners by weighted pipeline (each deal's amount times its real stage odds) and their historical win rate."
- "Unique click-through rate by acquisition source, weighted by delivered volume, for contacts who became customers."
- "Which deals are aging past 90 days, and where does our ARR actually concentrate?"
Then keep drilling: "now split by pipeline... now only Q2... now show the trend."

What makes it different
- Real joins across any objects, expressed as one query.
- Every answer is auditable: the exact SQL ships with the number, so you can verify and reproduce it.
- You bring the model: full frontier ChatGPT reasoning runs over your own data.
- Complementary to HubSpot's own AI. Breeze works inside the CRM; this understands the data behind it.

A note on sensitive data
This app's HubSpot integration requests only standard, non-sensitive OAuth read scopes for CRM analytics. It does not request HubSpot's sensitive scope grants (for example, crm.objects.contacts.sensitive.read). Because HubSpot enforces this at the API level, any property a customer has explicitly marked as a "sensitive data" property inside their own HubSpot account is withheld by HubSpot and never delivered to our sync process. It cannot enter the customer's synced database, and therefore cannot be returned by any of this MCP's tools, regardless of the query executed.

release.description:
Shorty turns long videos, audio files, documents, and web pages into readable summaries and accurate transcripts. The Shorty plugin lets ChatGPT run that library end-to-end: start a summary from a YouTube link, a web page, pasted text, or a file already uploaded to your account; transcribe a publicly accessible audio or video URL; generate subtitle tracks for a video you provide; then poll the job until it reaches a terminal state and pull the finished article or transcript back into the conversation. It can also search your existing summaries, open a specific article or transcription, list what you made recently, check how much of your monthly quota is left, and search Shorty's own documentation.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. You choose which scopes to grant on the consent screen — separate read scopes for articles, transcriptions, jobs, usage and docs, and separate write scopes for creating summaries and transcriptions — and any tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered to the assistant at all. Consent is re-checked on every individual tool call, so revoking Shorty from Connected AI Apps in Settings stops the assistant immediately rather than at token expiry. Write tools are backed by an idempotency ledger, so a retried request will not create duplicate jobs, and no tool deletes or overwrites work you already have.

Summaries and transcriptions consume your Shorty plan's monthly quota; the assistant can check the remaining balance before starting a long job.

release.description:
Uptimely is an uptime monitoring and incident management platform. The Uptimely plugin lets ChatGPT work across your projects: read a project overview, list and open monitors along with their status history and targets, list and open incidents, list alerts, list maintenance windows, see who is currently on call, list status pages, and list telemetry services. With write access enabled it can also create a monitor, run an on-demand monitor probe, declare an incident, change incident or alert state, save a postmortem, and create an alert.

You connect by signing in to your existing Uptimely account over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, granting a subset of thirteen granular scopes at the consent screen; project API keys work for non-interactive clients. Every call names the project it acts on — there is no ambient current project — and access is checked against your real Uptimely membership, so one connection cannot reach a project you are not a member of. All seven write tools stay inert until a project owner turns on Allow AI write operations, which is off by default, because some of them page real people or change what a public status page shows. Connected assistants can be reviewed and revoked at any time from Connected AI apps in your user settings.

Twenty tools over Streamable HTTP: thirteen read-only and seven write. The six tools that dispatch outside Uptimely are marked as such in their metadata. The plugin processes no payments, generates no images, video, or audio, and serves no ads.

release.description:
uNotes is a study library of university course materials — past exams, assignments, lab reports and lecture notes, organized by school and course. The uNotes plugin gives ChatGPT read access to that library and to the user's own study data: it can search the library, open a document and read its full text, list the user's flashcard decks and quizzes, look up their study streak, check how much of their monthly quota is left, and list the schools and courses they follow.

Every tool is read-only. The plugin exposes eight tools, all declared readOnlyHint:true / destructiveHint:false / idempotentHint:true, and none of them create, edit or delete anything in a uNotes account. Typical use is asking a question about material the user already has — "what do my Biology notes say about cell structure", "which courses am I following", "how long is my study streak" — and letting ChatGPT pull the answer out of the underlying documents.

Access is authorized with OAuth 2.1: PKCE (S256) with dynamic client registration, an explicit consent screen, and seven granular read scopes (search, documents, flashcards, quizzes, study, profile, library) plus offline_access. Tools are registered per request against the scopes the token actually carries, so a grant that omits a scope makes the matching tools invisible rather than merely blocked. Requests are rate-limited per user, and tools never accept a user identifier as input — every call is scoped to the authenticated account's own data.

release.description:
Ruwana Studio brings a connected creative production workflow into ChatGPT. Start from an idea, brief, product, manuscript, image, or other source material and use Ruwana tools to create professional photography, commercial visuals, fashion campaigns, lookbooks, ads, cinematic scenes, animation, avatars, motion, and video.

For fashion and commercial production, Ruwana goes beyond generating a single image. It supports consistent models and characters across shots and uses production direction such as camera, lens, lighting, proportions, styling, and product fidelity to create controlled editorial and commercial results.

For film and documentary workflows, production can begin from manuscripts, photographs, documents, or archival material and continue into visual interpretation, character and environment development, scene creation, previsualization, and moving sequences.

Photography, image creation, animation, motion, avatars, and video can belong to the same connected workflow, with one result becoming the source for the next production step. You describe what you want to create in ChatGPT, and Ruwana executes the requested production through its connected tools.

できること:
・Google・Bing・YouTube・Amazon・楽天などのサジェストキーワード取得
・独自データベースからの関連キーワード・よくある質問の取得

・Google検索順位の実測

It uses the complete 78-card Rider–Waite deck, including both the Major and Minor Arcana, and offers focused one-card readings or three-card spreads that explore the past, present, future, and the overall direction of your situation.

Free AI astrology that runs the real math. Give your birth date, time and city, and Astrology Doctor Fortune finds your zodiac signs and draws a full birth chart — Sun, Moon and Rising, all ten planets, twelve houses and every major aspect — on an interactive chart wheel you can explore right inside the chat.

release.description:
CNA provides a trusted, source-based news search and research service that allows users to search Central News Agency reporting directly within ChatGPT, stay informed about recent developments, and organize the evolving context surrounding specific people, events, and public issues.

Using natural language, users can search CNA news reports as well as content from CNA almanac, special features, and multilingual news coverage in English, Japanese, Indonesian, and other languages. The service also supports searches for standardized translations of foreign names and proper nouns, news photographs, government information, and fact-checking materials, helping users compare information across multiple sources and clarify uncertain claims. It can also organize retrieved information into event timelines, concise topic briefs, newspaper-style layouts, and relationship maps of people and organizations. These capabilities are suitable for news research, event retrospectives, issue tracking, information verification, content planning, and background research.

Responses preserve news headlines, publication dates, source information, and links to original articles whenever possible, allowing users to review the original reporting and conduct further verification. Some search results may come from government agencies, fact-checking organizations, contributed content, or other image sources; the system identifies their origins where available. The use and licensing of images remain subject to the terms, copyright requirements, and other applicable rules of their original sources.

release.description:
GrowByData Compass helps teams track share of voice, search rankings, and visibility across both traditional search engines and AI search platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, and Perplexity.
Common tasks include monitoring keyword rankings and position history over time, comparing share of voice against competitors, and identifying keyword gaps where competitors rank but a domain doesn't. Users also track how their brand is mentioned and cited within AI-generated search answers, including sentiment, and analyze SERP feature ownership such as featured snippets and above-the-fold placements. On the advertising side, it supports monitoring competitor text ads, shopping ads, and ad placements within AI search results.
Example prompts a user might type:
 "How is our domain ranking for our top 20 keywords this month?"
 "Show me our share of voice versus our top 3 competitors over the last quarter."
 "Are we being mentioned in ChatGPT or AI Overviews for our category, and what's the sentiment?"
 "What keywords are our competitors ranking for that we're missing?"

release.description:
HOJA is a business operations platform used by teams in Vietnam for sales, CRM, inventory, accounting, HR and marketing. Connect it to work with your own workspace in plain language: look up customers and orders, check inventory and receivables, review attendance, and draft marketing content.

Every request runs inside your own HOJA account's permissions — what you cannot open in HOJA, the assistant cannot read here. Writes are off by default for a new connection and can be turned on per connection. Everyday changes that are easy to undo, such as creating or editing a record, run as soon as you ask; anything hard to undo, such as deleting a record, approving or publishing, waits for your explicit confirmation before it runs. Payroll finalisation, payment execution, refunds and permission changes are never executed through the plugin; the assistant links you to the HOJA screen instead.

release.description:
Cartoply is scheduling software for teams that meet customers by appointment, including teams that travel to the customer.

Connect your Cartoply account to run scheduling from a conversation. Set up your weekly availability and date-specific overrides, create event types with durations, buffers, minimum notice and custom intake questions, and share the resulting public booking link.

For organizations it also manages the routing behind those bookings: service territories defined by ZIP code, city, county, radius or drive time; reusable groups of team members; and round-robin assignment across the reps who are actually free. You can list and filter bookings, approve or decline booking requests, reschedule, cancel, reassign a booking to a different rep, mark no-shows, and pull booking reports by person or group.

Changes take effect on your live booking pages. Actions that email or text a guest are labelled as such, so ChatGPT confirms with you before running them.

release.description:
social.plus Agentry connects ChatGPT to the first-party data your app already generates. Ask questions about your community, users, content, activity, and growth in plain language, and get a clear answer ready to visualize, tabulate or dig into with follow-up questions.

Ask things like:
- I'm prepping a campaign brief. What content formats drove the most activity last month, and which user segments engaged the most?
- We launched a new feature last Tuesday. How did user activity change in the days after compared to the week before?
- I have a QBR in an hour. Give me a snapshot of growth, active users, and top-performing content in this quarter.
- What are the trending topics this week? Any notable shifts in what users are talking about?
- Break down our most active user segments by how they engage. Who posts, who comments, who reacts?

Your data stays yours: Agentry is read-only. It never posts, modifies, or deletes anything. Data refreshes daily and covers roughly the last 90 days of activity.

To connect, you'll need a social.plus network with Agentry enabled and a connect code from a Console super admin.
